text: [Kneeling. Pours oil into a bag.] This is a little trick I picked up from my father. I seal the lamp oil inside an animal skin casing, Shyu lights the oil soaked twine and, [Picks up bag, holds it proudly before him.] ta-da! Fake firebending!

speaker: Katara
text: [Impressed.] You've really outdone yourself this time, Sokka.

speaker: Shyu
text: This might actually work.

speaker: Shyu
text: [Time skip. Sokka places his last bag into the dragon's mouth.] The sages will hear the explosion, so as soon as they go off, you rush in!

speaker: Katara
text: [Hides behind a column with her brother. Holds Momo. Glances to the next column where Aang hides.] It's almost sunset. Are you ready?

speaker: Aang
text: Definitely.

Shyu thrusts his finger forward, sending a small flare racing across the door to light all five bags at once. Shyu hurries to take cover. There is an intense explosion, producing a lot of smoke. Aang bursts forward and runs for the door. Aang strains to open the door, which has not budged.

speaker: Aang
text: [Surprised.] They're still locked!

speaker: Shyu
text: [Sadly sighs. Sokka rises from hiding behind his sister.] It didn't work. [Aang falls to his knees.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Time skip. Everyone stands in front of the door. Aang beats upon it furiously with consecutive airbending slices.] Why, won't, it, open?!

speaker: Katara
text: [Presses forward. Seizes Aang's arm.] Aang! Stop! [Relaxes, releasing his arm.] There's nothing else we can do ...

speaker: Aang
text: [Glumly.] I'm sorry I put you through all of this for nothing.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Examining the explosion. Runs his finger across the black soot.] I don't get it. That firebending looked as strong as any firebending I've seen.

speaker: Katara
text: [A moment passes. Sudden excitement.] Sokka, you're a genius!

speaker: Aang
text: [Confused.] Wait. How is Sokka a genius? His plan didn't even work.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Pleasantly.] Come on, Aang. Let her dream.

speaker: Katara
text: You're right. Sokka's plan didn't work. But it looks like it did.

speaker: Aang
text: [Dubiously.] Did the definition of genius change over the last hundred years? [Katara grasps her chin, slyly grinning toward Aang.]

speaker: Shyu
text: [Time skip. Fire Sages run toward Shyu in front of the door.] Come quickly! The Avatar has entered the sanctuary!

speaker: Great Fire Sage
text: How did he get in?

speaker: Shyu
text: I don't know. But look at the scorch marks! And down there! [Points to a shadow visible at the bottom of the door.]

speaker: Great Fire Sage
text: He's inside! Open the doors, immediately! Before he contacts Avatar Roku!

Aang slides into position behind a nearby column as the five sages firebend the doors locks open. As the door opens, a sooty Momo is revealed sitting on the floor. Momo sneezes, blowing the soot off himself.

speaker: Great Fire Sage
text: It's the Avatar's lemur. He must have crawled through the pipes! We've been tricked!

Momo springs into action, leaping atop the Great Fire Sage's head and clinging to his hat. Katara charged forward, pulling a nearby sage's tunic over his head to blind him. Sokka grabs the lower skirt of a sage's outfit, lifting it completely over his body to cover his face.

speaker: Shyu
text: [Grabs the last free sage and hauls him into his grip, pinning him.] Now, Aang!

speaker: Katara
text: [A moment of silence.] Aang! Now's your chance!

speaker: Zuko
text: [Steps out from behind column. Grips Aang from behind, pinning Aang's arms behind him.] The Avatar's coming with me! [The captured sages use their captors' surprise to reclaim the upper hand, pinning their captors down. Momo flies off with the Great Fire Sage's hat.] Close the doors! Quickly!

Walking down steps, Aang glances over his shoulders to see Sokka and Katara being chained to a column. He breaks free, spinning behind Zuko to send him down the stairs with an airbending blast. Aang runs for Katara and Sokka.

speaker: Katara
text: [Chained. Sees him coming toward her. Turns head toward the closing door.] Go!

Aang listens without hesitation, turning to charge for the door guarded by two sages. He leaps into the air to avoid the Great Fire Sage's fire punch. Aang bounces off his hands from each of the two sage's heads before sailing through the door just as it closes.

speaker: Katara
text: [Pleased.] He made it!

Everyone looks away as the door seals with a blinding flash of white light. Inside, Aang is kneeling and looks up to a tall statue of Avatar Roku. A beam of red sunlight enters the room and strikes a glistening red jewel held by the statue.

speaker: Aang
text: [Stands. Confused.] The light hits the statue and I talk to Roku. So why isn't anything happening?

speaker: Zuko
text: [He and four sages launch fire blasts into the door's locks. Nothing happens. Frustrated.] Why isn't it working? It's sealed shut!

speaker: Great Fire Sage
text: It must have been the light. Avatar Roku doesn't want us inside.

speaker: Aang
text: [Exasperated. Standing in the middle of the room, facing the statue.] Why isn't anything happening? I don't know what I'm doing! All I know is airbending! Please Avatar Roku, talk to me!

Roku's statue turns red as sunlight engulfs it. Its eyes glow white. View of Aang as smoke fills the room. When the white smoke dissipates Avatar Roku is standing before him, they are on a mountaintop and only clouds are visible below.

speaker: Roku
text: It's good to see you Aang. What took you so long? [Aang respectfully places a fist into his palm, bowing his head to the Avatar before him.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [Firmly to Shyu, who is kneeling before him with his hands behind his back.] Why did you help the Avatar?

speaker: Shyu
text: [Sadly and proudly.] Because it was once the sages' duty. It is still our duty.

speaker: Zhao
text: [Claps. Interrupts interrogation. Approaches with six firebender guards.] What a moving and heartfelt performance. I'm certain the Fire Lord will understand, when you explain why you betrayed him.

speaker: Great Fire Sage
text: [Places palms together. Bows head forward.] Commander Zhao.

speaker: Zhao
text: And Prince Zuko. It was a noble effort, but your little smokescreen didn't work. [Zuko scowls sharply. Firebenders step behind him, seizing his arms.] Two traitors in one day, the Fire Lord will be pleased.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Strains against his captor, snaps at Zhao.] You're too late, Zhao! The Avatar's inside and the doors are sealed.

speaker: Zhao
text: No matter. [Grins confidently.] Sooner or later, he has to come out. [Katara and Sokka share a worried glance.]

speaker: Roku
text: I have something very important to tell you, Aang. That is why, when you were in the Spirit World, I sent my dragon to find you.

speaker: Aang
text: [Interested, curious.] Is it about that vision? The one of the comet?

speaker: Roku
text: Yes.

speaker: Aang
text: What does it mean?

speaker: Roku
text: One hundred years ago, [Viewers see a visual of a comet in the dark sky.] Fire Lord Sozin used that comet to begin the War. He and his firebending army harnessed its incredible power, and dealt a deadly first strike against the other nations.

speaker: Aang
text: [Close-up.] So the comet made them stronger?

speaker: Roku
text: [Close-up.] Yes. Stronger than you could even imagine.

speaker: Aang
text: [Close-up.] But that happened a hundred years ago. What does the comet have to do with the War now?

speaker: Roku
text: Listen carefully. [Viewers see silhouette of Fire Lord Ozai standing amid flames, fists taut.] Sozin's Comet will return by the end of this summer, and Fire Lord Ozai will use its power to finish the War, once and for all. [Visual and audio of Ozai's silhouette roaring upward, fire streaming from his mouth.] If he succeeds, even the Avatar won't be able to restore balance to the world. Aang. You must defeat the Fire Lord, before the comet arrives.

speaker: Aang
text: [Counters anxiously.] But I haven't even started learning waterbending! Not to mention earth and fire!

speaker: Roku
text: Mastering the elements takes years of discipline and practice. But if the world is to survive, you must do it by summer's end. [Close-up of a shocked Aang.]
Firebenders, including Zhao and his crew, circle around the door's perimeter, assuming a firebending form. A monk chant begins for the audience only. They wait patiently for the door to open.

speaker: Zhao
text: When those doors open, [Shouts.] unleash all your firepower!

speaker: Katara
text: [Worried.] How's Aang gonna make it out of this?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Troubled, questioning.] How are we gonna make it out of this?

speaker: Aang
text: [Terrified.] What if I can't master all the elements in time? What if I fail?

speaker: Roku
text: I know you can do it Aang. [Close-up of half his face.] For you have done it before. [Close-up of half of Aang's now-smiling face.] The solstice is ending. We must go our separate ways, for now.

speaker: Aang
text: But I won't be able to come back to the temple. What if I have questions? How will I talk to you?

speaker: Roku
text: I am a part of you. When you need to talk to me again, you will find a way. [Closes his eyes, providing Aang a vision of Fire Navy ships surrounding the island. Speaks to his mind without words.] A great danger awaits you at the temple. [Provides a vision of the awaiting firebenders on the other side of the door.] I can help you face the threat. But only if you are ready.

speaker: Aang
text: [Eyes and arrows glow.] I'm ready.

Scene switches to the guard surrounding the door. The door glows bright white once again. Smoke streams come through into the room. The door unlocks itself, beginning to open. As it opens, a blinding white light forces all present to look away.

speaker: Zhao
text: Ready ... [Light fades, revealing a pair of glowing white eyes in the darkness.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Sokka struggles against his chains. Katara is terrified.] No! Aang!

speaker: Zhao
text: Fire! [He and his guards cooperate in blasting fire onto the unseen target.]
The wall of fire amasses, circling its new host as Avatar Roku, eyes aglow, is revealed behind the flames, untouched. Close-up of a shocked and horror-stricken Zhao.

speaker: Shyu
text: [In awe.] Avatar Roku ...

Avatar Roku draws the circling fire together in one motion. He sends it forward in one powerful wave that sears the room, blasting the offenders off their feet and melting the chains binding Katara, Sokka, Shyu, and Zuko with precision. View of outside the temple as the blast destroys the outer wall. Close-up of ghostly Avatar Roku, turning his glowing glare upon the offending sages. The sages panic, all turning to run from his wrath.

speaker: Shyu
text: [Implores.] Avatar Roku is going to destroy the temple! We have to get out of here!

speaker: Katara
text: Not without Aang!

Roku kneels into a forward strike, melting the floor with a molten firebending trail. He steadily lifts his hand, causing the stream of lava below to erupt into maddened explosions. The lava soars through the temple, tearing it apart. Zhao and his firebenders are shown fleeing for the temple's exit.

Katara and Sokka huddle together, arm-in-arm, behind a column. Sokka kneels over his sister, protecting her in a brotherly fashion. The destruction ceases momentarily as Roku lowers his hands, exhaling soundly. The solstice' beam of sunlight is shown leaving his statue; its eyes no longer glow. As this happens all smoke in the room draws in upon Avatar Roku, his form disappearing to leave behind a weary Aang.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Aang sighs weakly and drops to his knees. Sokka and Katara approach Aang's sides, supportively lifting him back to his feet.] We got your back.

speaker: Aang
text: [Weakly.] Thanks. Where's Shyu?

speaker: Katara
text: [ Walking away with Sokka, helping Aang.] I don't know.

Visual of the temple as it begins to lean, due to the destruction caused. Aang, Katara and Sokka stare in horror upon seeing the stairwell leading to the exit filled with lava. They quickly turn to the only exit; the hole in the wall Roku had created. There is no escaping, as they are on the top level of the temple.

All three gasp in surprise as they notice Appa and Momo swiftly closing in. They run out of the temple, leaping into Appa's saddle. Scene of them flying away on Appa, gazing back at the destruction. Momo pops up wearing the Great Fire Sage's hat. Scene of Zhao watching the bison fly away.

speaker: Zhao
text: [Turns angrily, snapping.] No Prince, no Avatar! Apparently, the only thing I do have is five traitors!

speaker: Great Fire Sage
text: [Interjects.] But Commander! Only Shyu helped the Avatar.

speaker: Zhao
text: [Close-up.] Save your stories for the Fire Lord. As far as I'm concerned, you are all guilty! [Orders.] Take them to the prison hold!

The scene changes to show Zuko spying with his telescope toward Appa flying away. He lowers the telescope and sails off in his vessel.

Night time falls. Appa flies through the clouds. Scene from behind, a mourning Aang with his head hung. Katara and Sokka stand and approach their friend, kneeling behind him to support him. Katara puts her hand around Aang's shoulders.
Fades to credits.
Scene opens with the camera zoomed out showing Appa flying in above the mountains with a few viewable trees, carrying Aang, Katara, Sokka, and Momo.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Aang is pacing around on Appa's saddle, breathing heavily.] Would you sit down? [Turns around from his perch on Appa's head.] If we hit a bump, you'll go flying off. What's bugging you anyway?

speaker: Aang
text: [Worriedly.] It's what Avatar Roku said. I'm supposed to master all four elements before that comet arrives.

speaker: Sokka
text: [In a sarcastic, amused tone while facing Aang.] Well, let's see. You pretty much mastered airbending and that only took you a hundred and twelve years. I'm sure you can master three more elements by next summer.

speaker: Aang
text: [Frightfully.] I haven't even started waterbending and we're still weeks away from the North Pole. What am I gonna do?

speaker: Katara
text: [Grabs Aang's arm.] Calm down, it's going to be okay. [Aang sits down in front of her.] If you want, I can try to teach you some of the stuff I know.

speaker: Aang
text: [Smiling.] You'd do that?

speaker: Katara
text: [Nods and looks over the side of Appa's saddle.] We'll need to find a good source of water first.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Grinning; sarcastically.] Maybe we can find a puddle for you to splash in.
Cuts to Aang, Katara, Sokka, and Momo standing in front of a large waterfall and river.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Frowning beside Aang and Katara's ecstatic faces.] Nice puddle.
Appa flies down into the river and creates a huge splash that soaks and almost knocks Momo of the rock he is standing on, turns over, and floats on his back.

speaker: Aang
text: [Takes off his shirt, smiling.] Yeah! Don't start without me, boy! [Begins to run toward the water.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Somewhat blankly.] Remember the reason we're here.

speaker: Aang
text: [Stops short and looks at Katara.] Oh right. Time to practice waterbending. [Puts his clothes back on.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Sarcastically.] Great. So what am I supposed to do?

speaker: Aang
text: You could ... clean the gunk out of Appa's toes. [Hands Sokka a branch with a bushel of leaves at the end.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Frowns and crosses his arms.] So, while you guys are playing in the water, I'm supposed to be hard at work picking mud out of a giant bison's feet?

speaker: Aang
text: [Smiles; somewhat cheerfully.] Mud and bugs!

speaker: Sokka
text: Okay. [Takes stick and walks over to Appa who is floating in the water.]
Scene changes to Zuko's ship in the ocean. On the deck, Zuko is practicing firebending with his  Lieutenant Lee when the boat turns and they are thrown to one side on their backs.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Close-up of his face; he glares at the tower.] Someone's changing our course.
Cuts to a crew member steering the ship at the top of the boat.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Storming in, yelling.] What is the meaning of this mutiny? No one told you to change course! [Shows Iroh and the rest of the crew playing Pai Sho behind them.]

speaker: Iroh
text: Actually, someone did. I assure you, it is a matter of utmost importance, Prince Zuko. [Scratches beard.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [Hopefully.] Is it something to do with the Avatar?

speaker: Iroh
text: Even more urgent. It seems, I- [Rubs forehead in stress.] -I have lost my lotus tile. [Moves a piece of his across the Pai Sho board.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [Confused.] Lotus tile?

speaker: Iroh
text: For my Pai Sho game. Most people think the lotus is insignificant, but it is essential for the unusual strategy that I employ.

speaker: Zuko
text: [In disbelief.] You've changed our course for a stupid lotus tile?

speaker: Iroh
text: See, you, like most people, underestimate its value. Just give me ten minutes to check the merchants at this port of call. [Excitedly.] Hopefully, they will have the lotus tile in stock and I can get on with my life. [Zuko breathes fire up at the ceiling in anger and Iroh smiles.] I'm lucky to have such an understanding nephew.

The room fills with smoke of Zuko's outburst, clouding the scene from view.

Cut to a scene of a content Appa floating in the river while Sokka stands on his stomach and brushes in between his toes with the branch.

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah, don't get too happy. You've got to do me next. [Appa moans happily.]
Shows Katara and Aang by the shore.

speaker: Katara
text: This is a pretty basic move, but it still took me months to perfect. So don't get frustrated if you don't get it right away. [She moves her hands back and forth and makes small waves in the water, while Aang looks up, smiling.] Just push and pull the water like this. The key is getting the wrist movement right.

speaker: Aang
text: [Stands up.] Like this? [Does the hand movements Katara is doing, but nothing is happening yet.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Kindly.] That's almost right. If you keep practicing I'm sure eventually—

speaker: Aang
text: Hey, I'm bending it already! [Shows Aang making much bigger waves than Katara's on his first try.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Surprised.] Wow, I can't believe you got that so quickly. It took me two months to learn that move.

speaker: Aang
text: [Shrugs shoulders.] Well, you had to figure it all on your own. I'm lucky enough to have a great teacher.

speaker: Katara
text: [Smiles.] Thanks.

speaker: Aang
text: So, what's next?

speaker: Katara
text: This is a more difficult move. I call it streaming the water. [She moves her hands and raises a stream of water from the river into the air and moves it around.] It's harder than it looks, so don't be disappointed if- [Shows Aang already controlling a stream of water, moving it around and above his body and neatly coiling it back into the river, much to Katara's dismay.] Nice work. [She frowns.] Though the over-the-head flare was unnecessary.

speaker: Aang
text: Sorry. [Excited.] Well, don't stop now! Keep 'em coming!

speaker: Katara
text: [Looks up sadly.] Well I kind of know this one other move, but it's pretty hard. I haven't even totally figured it out yet. The idea is to create a big, powerful wave. [She moves her hands up, shaking, and starts to get a big mass of water to rise out of the river, but it pops before forming into anything substantial.]

speaker: Aang
text: So, like this? [He raises his hands and creates a massive wave that towers over their heads.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Still working on cleaning up Appa, he looks up and stares at Aang's wave crashing toward him in fear.] Aang?! [The wave throws Sokka off into the water and his head slowly rises out, annoyed.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Smiling.] Looks like I got the hang of that move! What else do you got?

speaker: Katara
text: [Angry at Aang's quick success.] That's enough practicing for today.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Head still sticking out of the water.] Yeah, I'll say! [Points to the left.] You just "practiced" our supplies down the river. [Shows a group of bags floating away.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Looking guilty.] Uh, sorry. [Smiles worriedly.] I'm sure we can find somewhere to replace all this stuff.

speaker: Sokka
text: My life was hard enough when you were just an airbender. [Sinks back underwater.]
Cuts to Katara, Sokka, and Aang walking through the streets of a city market and port. Shows many armed men staring at the trio. Sokka and Katara look nervous while Aang looks around in wonder.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Walking back from alleyway with a bag over his shoulders.] We've got exactly three copper pieces left from the money that King Bumi gave us. Let's spend it wisely.

speaker: Aang
text: Uh, make that two copper pieces, Sokka. I couldn't say no to this whistle! [Pulls out a white whistle that looks like a bison, takes a huge breath and blows into it, but it barely makes a sound.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Pulls out fingers over his ears after expecting a loud noise.] It doesn't even work. [Aang stops blowing when Momo squawks at him.] See? Even Momo thinks it's a piece of junk.

speaker: Katara
text: No offense Aang, but I'll hold the money from now on. [Aang hands her the two copper coins.]
Cuts to the other side of the port where a man is talking in front of his boat docked in the water.

speaker: Oh
text: [Moving hands and shouting excitedly.] Earth Nation! Fire Nation! Water Nation! So long as bargains are your inclination, you're welcome here! Don't be shy, come on by! [Sokka, Katara, and Aang walk by and he runs up to them.] Oh! You there, I can see from your clothing that you're world-traveling types. Perhaps I can interest you in some exotic curios?

speaker: Aang
text: [Walks back to the man.] Sure! What are curios?

speaker: Oh
text: [Looks confused and thinks.] I'm not entirely sure. But we got 'em! [Puts his hand on Aang's shoulder and smiles, walking him into the ship.]
Cuts to the inside of the boat where strange collectibles are lined up on shelves on the walls. Aang, Katara, and Sokka walk in.

speaker: Aang
text: [Looks up close at an item on a shelf, confused.] Huh?
Katara stares at an ornate monkey statue on one of the shelves eerily.

speaker: Pirate captain
text: [Standing in a dark doorway as Aang passes by with Momo on his back.] I've never seen such a fine specimen of lemur. [Walks into the light, an iguana parrot on his shoulder.] That beast would fetch me a hefty sum if you'd be interested in bartering. [The iguana parrot squawks at them.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Grabbing Momo protectively.] Momo's not for sale.
Shows Katara walking over to a shelf where a number of scrolls are kept. She grabs one with the waterbending symbol on it and opens it to see lines of waterbending diagrams and writing.

speaker: Katara
text: [Smiling.] Look at this, Aang. It's a waterbending scroll! [Aang walks over.] Check out these crazy moves.

speaker: Aang
text: [Turns to the captain, excited.] Where did you get a waterbending scroll?

speaker: Pirate captain
text: [Slams his hand onto the scroll and pulls it away.] Let's just say I got it up North, at a most reasonable price, free. [Rolls the scroll back up and puts it away back in its shelf.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Turns around and looks at the captain from the other side of the room.] Wait a minute ... Sea loving traders, with suspiciously acquired merchandise, [Raises eyebrows, almost yelling.] and pet reptile birds? [Turns around to Oh, almost spitting in his face.] You guys are pirates!

speaker: Oh
text: [Puts his arm around a terrified Sokka's shoulders.] We prefer to think of ourselves as "high risk traders."
Cuts to Katara holding their two copper pieces next to Aang, with the captain on the other side of the counter they are leaning on.

speaker: Katara
text: So, how much for the, uh, traded scroll?

speaker: Pirate captain
text: I've already got a buyer, a nobleman in the Earth Kingdom. [Voice turns less serious.] Unless of course, you kids have two hundred gold pieces on you right now.

speaker: Aang
text: [Turns around and whispers to Katara.] I know how to deal with these guys, Katara. Pirates love to haggle. [Katara drops the final coins in his hand.] Watch and learn. [Walks over to the counter, leans against it, and talks in a pirate voice.] What say ye to the price of... one copper piece? [Smiles, and dramatically presents the single coin.]

speaker: Pirate captain
text: [Laughs hysterically.] The price is two hundred gold pieces. I don't haggle on items this rare.

speaker: Aang
text: [Still smirking and talking like a pirate.] Okay, two copper pieces!

speaker: Pirate captain
text: [Aggravated.] It's not as amusing the second time, boy!

speaker: Katara
text: [Whispering.] Aang, can we get out of here? I feel like we're getting weird looks.

speaker: Aang
text: Aye, we be casting off now! [Walks away.]
Cuts back to outside, Aang, Katara, and Sokka are walking off the boat and back down the street.

speaker: Aang
text: What was that all about, Katara?

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah, I was just starting to browse through their boomerang collection.

speaker: Katara
text: [Worried, holding her arms.] I'll just feel a lot better once we get away from here.
Cuts back to the pirate ship. Oh is running across the deck looking for them.

speaker: Oh
text: Hey you! Get back here!

speaker: Aang
text: [Calmly turns around.] Well, well. Look who's come to their senses. Told you the haggling would pay off.
Suddenly, the group of armed pirates jump out of the boat and run to Aang, Katara, and Sokka, whispering menacingly and swinging their weapons.

speaker: Katara
text: [Scared.] I don't think these pirates are here to trade with us. [Turns around and runs, Aang and Sokka follow and the pirates chase behind them. Half of the group runs down one street while the other goes down the one next to it.]

speaker: Oh
text: This way. Let's cut 'em off!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Turning a corner with Aang and Katara.] Whoa! [Katara freezes a puddle behind them that a pirate slips on.]

Cuts to peaceful scene of the cabbage merchant with his cart of cabbages in an alleyway. Sokka, Katara, and Aang run past him and almost knock his cart over. Aang sends a blast of wind that throws the cart into the group of pirates behind them.

speaker: Cabbage merchant
text: [Angry.] My cabbages! This place is worse than Omashu!
Group of pirates jump out of another street and chase Aang, Sokka, Katara, and Momo.

speaker: Pirate
text: I hope that lemur of yours has nine lives!

speaker: Oh
text: [Him and the pirates corner them in the dead end of a street.] Now, who gets to taste the steel of my blade first?

speaker: Aang
text: No thanks. [Spins and hurls a blast of air at the pirates that send them backward, and runs toward them with his glider out.] Grab on tight!

speaker: Katara
text: Aang! I thought we were running away from the pirates! [Jumps on to Aang's glider with Sokka and they lift off into the air.]

speaker: Aang
text: Just hang on! [Flies over the pirates' heads and into the distance.]
Cuts back to their camp by the river, where Aang, Sokka, and Katara stand by the shore.

speaker: Aang
text: [Putting his glider away.] I used to kind of look up to pirates, but those guys are terrible.

speaker: Katara
text: [Mischievously.] I know. That's why I took this. [Holds out the waterbending scroll they saw in the shop.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Surprised.] No way!

speaker: Katara
text: [Excited.] Isn't it great?

speaker: Sokka
text: No wonder they were trying to hack us up! You stole their waterbending scroll!

speaker: Katara
text: [Jokingly.] I prefer to think of it as high risk trading.

speaker: Aang
text: [Laughs.] Good one, Katara.

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka, where do you think they got it? They stole it from a waterbender!

speaker: Sokka
text: It doesn't matter. You put all of our lives in danger just so you could learn some stupid, fancy splashes.

speaker: Katara
text: These are real waterbending forms. You know how crucial it is for Aang to learn waterbending!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Walks away.] Whatever.

speaker: Aang
text: Well, what's done is done. We have it, we might as well learn from it.
The scene cuts to show Zuko and Iroh standing in the market place.

speaker: Iroh
text: I've checked all the shops on this pier. Not a lotus tile in the entire marketplace.

speaker: Zuko
text: It's good to know this trip was a complete waste of time for everyone!

speaker: Iroh
text: Quite the contrary. I always say, the only thing better than finding something you are looking for [Crew members begin to walk past carrying Iroh's purchases.] is finding something you weren't looking for at a great bargain! [A crew member walks past the two playing a tsungi horn.]

speaker: Zuko
text: You bought a tsungi horn?

speaker: Iroh
text: For music night on the ship. Now, if we only had some woodwinds. [Pointing to the ship.] Oh, this place looks promising! [The monkey statue is shown again.] Oh, that is handsome! Wouldn't it look magnificent in the galley?

speaker: Oh
text: [To pirate captain.] We lost the Water Tribe girl and the little bald monk she was traveling with.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Turning.] This monk, did he have an arrow on his head? [Iroh turns around, making a face similar to the monkey's.]
The camera cuts show Katara looking at the scroll.

speaker: Katara
text: I just want to try this one move first and then it's all yours. [Gives it to Aang.] Here, hold it open for me. The single water whip. Looks doable. [Attempts the move, but ends up hitting herself in the forehead.] Ow!

speaker: Sokka
text: Ha, ha, ha!

speaker: Katara
text: [Glaring at Sokka.] What's so funny?

speaker: Sokka
text: I'm sorry, but you deserved that. [To Aang.] You've been duped; she's only interested in teaching herself.

speaker: Katara
text: [Angrily.] Aang will get his turn once I figure out the water whip. [She tries again, but hits Momo instead, who screeches.] Ugh, why can't I get this stupid move?

speaker: Aang
text: You'll get it. [Katara glares at him.] You just gotta shift your weight through the stances. [He tries and does it perfectly on the first try.] There, see, the key to bending is—

speaker: Katara
text: [Screaming.] Will you please shut your air hole? [Frustrated.] Believe it or not your infinite wisdom gets a little old sometimes! Why don't we just throw the scroll away since you're so naturally gifted! [Sokka glares at her.] What? [She looks back at Aang, giving him a disgusted look, who has tears in his eyes.] Oh my gosh, Aang, I am so sorry, I don't know what came over me. But you know what, it won't happen again. [She gives the scroll to Aang.] Here, this is yours. I don't want to have anything to do with it anymore.

speaker: Aang
text: It's okay Katara.

speaker: Sokka
text: What about Momo? He's the real victim here.

speaker: Katara
text: [Bends down to pet Momo as he rubs his hind end.] I'm sorry, Momo.

speaker: Sokka
text: And what about me? There was that time you—

speaker: Katara
text: No more apologies!
The camera fades to show a much smaller boat being launched out of Zuko's ship. The camera fades again to show the boat and the pirate ship sailing down a river.

speaker: Pirate captain
text: Shouldn't we stop to search the woods?

speaker: Zuko
text: We don't need to stop. They stole a waterbending scroll, right?

speaker: Pirate captain
text: Mm-hm.

speaker: Zuko
text: Then they'll be on the water.

The scene fades to show Katara, Sokka, and Aang sleeping by the campfire. Katara quietly takes the scroll and sneaks away from the camp. However, when she turns around she comes face-to-face with Momo, who starts chattering.

speaker: Katara
text: [Whispering.] Shhh, Momo! Go back to sleep. Shh! [The camera fades to show her standing by the river, attempting but failing to perfect the water whip, frustrated.] Ugh, ugh, ugh! Shoot! Come on water, work with me here! Okay, what if I just, ow! Stupid scroll! [The pirate captain and Zuko are shown hearing her.] Okay Katara, shift your weight through the stances. [She drops the water again and hears the ship pulling up onto the river bank. She peeks through the bushes to see what the noise was, and gasps upon seeing the pirates. She turns to run, but it grabbed by a pirate.] No! Let go of me! [She bends water up into the pirate's face, and he releases her, she runs but is grabbed again on the wrists by Zuko.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [He glares at her as she looks frightfully at him.] I'll save you from the pirates.
The scene cuts to show Katara tied to a tree with Zuko standing in front of her.

speaker: Zuko
text: Tell me where he is and I won't hurt you or your brother.

speaker: Katara
text: [Furiously.] Go jump in the river!

speaker: Zuko
text: Try to understand. I need to capture him to restore something I've lost, my honor. [Katara jerks her head away from Zuko.] Perhaps in exchange I can restore something you've lost. [He holds her mother's necklace up to her neck.]

speaker: Katara
text: My mother's necklace! How did you get that?

speaker: Zuko
text: I didn't steal it, if that's what you're wondering. Tell me where he is. [Points at Katara.]

speaker: Katara
text: No!

speaker: Pirate captain
text: Enough of this necklace garbage! You promised a scroll!

speaker: Zuko
text: I wonder how much this is worth ... [The pirates gasp as he takes it out and holds it over a fire in his hand, smirking.] A lot, apparently. Now you help me find what I want, you'll get this back, and everyone goes home happy. Search the woods for the boy and meet back here!

speaker: Pirate captain
text: Fine.
The scene cuts to the campsite, where Sokka is waking up.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Notices Katara's missing.] Huh? Where did she go? [Looks through the bag.] I don't believe it.

speaker: Aang
text: [Yawns.] What's wrong?

speaker: Sokka
text: She took the scroll! She's obsessed with that thing. It's just a matter of time before she gets us all in deep- [Yells as a pirate throws a rope around his arms and drags him forward. He rolls away and charges at the pirate while another pirate captures Aang in a net and drags him away.]

speaker: Pirate
text: I got him, come on!

speaker: Sokka
text: Oh, what? I'm not good enough to kidnap? Ah! [The pirate shoots another net at Sokka and drags him away too.]
Cuts back to the place where Zuko and the pirates are gathered. The pirates are holding Aang and Sokka, who are tied up. Sokka is struggling with the ropes.

speaker: Zuko
text: Nice work.

speaker: Katara
text: Aang, this is all my fault.

speaker: Aang
text: No Katara, it isn't.

speaker: Iroh
text: Yeah, it kind of is. [Katara glares at Iroh.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [To the pirate captain.] Give me the boy.

speaker: Pirate captain
text: You give us the scroll.

speaker: Sokka
text: You're really gonna hand over the Avatar for a stupid piece of parchment?

speaker: Zuko
text: Don't listen to him, he's trying to turn us against each other!

speaker: Pirate captain
text: [Turns to Aang.] Your friend is the Avatar?

speaker: Sokka
text: Sure is, and I'll bet he'll fetch a lot more on the black market than that fancy scroll.

speaker: Zuko
text: Shut your mouth, you Water Tribe peasant!

speaker: Aang
text: Yeah, Sokka, you really should shut your mouth.

speaker: Sokka
text: I'm just sayin' it's bad business sense. Think how much the Fire Lord would pay for the Avatar. You guys would be set for life. [The pirates smile, intrigued by the idea]

speaker: Pirate captain
text: [To Zuko.] Keep the scroll; we can buy a hundred with the reward we'll get for the kid. [The pirates turn to leave.]

speaker: Zuko
text: You'll regret breaking a deal with me. [He and two of his soldiers send a blast of fire at the pirates. The pirates jump back and Oh runs out, throwing smoke bombs and jumping into the cloud as the fight ensues. Some of the soldiers run out to Sokka and Aang, who are struggling with their ropes, but are stopped by several pirates. Momo runs down the tree and frees Katara.]

speaker: Katara
text: Thanks, Momo. I owe you a bushel of apples. [She runs to join the fight. Aang is shown lost in the smoke, a thrown knife narrowly misses him and cuts through his ropes. Zuko finds his way out of the smoke cloud and hides the scroll behind his back, but the pirate captain sees him and the two begin to fight. The scroll flies into the air and his caught by Momo, the iguana parrot sees him and hits Momo. The scroll flies back down to the ground. A knife narrowly misses Sokka's head, and he uses it to cuts the ropes on his hands.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shouting.] Aang, are you there?

speaker: Aang
text: I'm over here! Follow my voice!

speaker: Sokka
text: Where? I can't find you!

speaker: Aang
text: I'm right here! [Airbends the dust away, revealing the pirates surrounding him, and immediately airbends it back around himself.] Uh, never mind! I'll find you! [Sokka climbs out of the dust cloud on his hands and knees. Aang vaults over him in a full sprint.] Run! [They find Katara, who is trying to push the pirate boat back into the water.] Katara, you're okay!

speaker: Katara
text: Help me get this boat back in the water so we can get outta here. [They join her in trying to push the boat, but can't.]

speaker: Sokka
text: We'd need a team of rhinos to budge this ship.

speaker: Aang
text: A team of rhinos, or two waterbenders.
Cuts to Aang and Katara pushing and pulling the water until the boat rises up.

speaker: Katara
text: Everybody in!
Cuts to show Iroh breaking up the fight between the pirate captain and Zuko.

speaker: Iroh
text: Are you so busy fighting you cannot see your own ship has set sail?

speaker: Zuko
text: We have no time for your proverbs, Uncle!

speaker: Iroh
text: It's no proverb! [Points to Team Avatar who has hijacked the pirate ship.]

speaker: Pirate captain
text: Bleeding hog monkeys! [Zuko laughs while pointing at him. His laughter dissipates as the pirates hijack his own boat. The pirates taunt him and the screen pans to a steaming Zuko.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [Angrily.] Hey! That's my boat! [Goes chasing after the hijacked boat.]

speaker: Iroh
text: [Pondering.] Maybe it should be a proverb ...

speaker: Zuko
text: [Off camera.] C'mon, Uncle! [Iroh runs after Zuko.]

speaker: Aang
text: Sokka, can't you make it go any faster?

speaker: Sokka
text: I don't know how. This thing wasn't made by the Water Tribe!
Several of the pirates jump onto the ship, but are quickly swept away by Aang's waterbending. Determined, Katara performs a perfect water whip to throw the last pirate off.

speaker: Aang
text: Hey, you did the water whip!

speaker: Katara
text: I couldn't have done it without your help.
Sokka is shown being held in place by two pirates.

speaker: Sokka
text: Would you two quit congratulating each other and help me out?
Momo is shown still being chased by the iguana parrot; he flies up to the top mast and entangles the bird in the ship's flag. Sokka is shown being thrown by one of the pirates.

speaker: Oh
text: That's good ... [Aang lands behind him and airbends him and the other pirate off the ship before jumping down to Sokka.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Pointing.] Aang, look! [The ship is shown headed toward a huge waterfall.]

speaker: Aang
text: Oh no ...
Oh comes up behind him with a knife, Aang turns and blows the bison whistle. Oh stands confused while Sokka comes up behind him and pushes him off the ship.

speaker: Sokka
text: Have you lost your mind? This is no time for flute practice! [Katara and Aang stare in horror at the approaching waterfall.]

speaker: Katara
text: We can stop the boat! Aang, together, push and pull the water! [They create a small Whirlpool that stops the boat.] It's working, it's slowing down! We're doing it!

speaker: Sokka
text: But we have another problem. [Zuko's boat is shown sailing straight toward their ship. The boat rams into the ship and Sokka, Aang, and Katara are forced to jump as the boat goes over the falls.]

speaker: Together
text: Jump! [Appa is shown flying toward them. They land on him and fly to safety.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Holding up the whistle.] I knew a bison whistle would come in handy! Thanks Appa.

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah, we owe you one. [Appa roars and the scene cuts to show Zuko running to the cliff in horror at the fact that his boat has gone over the falls.]

speaker: Zuko
text: My boat!

speaker: Iroh
text: [Chuckles.] Prince Zuko, you're really going to get a kick out of this. That lotus tile was in my sleeve the whole time! [Has a big smile on his face.]
Zuko snatches the lotus tile and furiously throws it down the waterfall.
Cuts back to Appa flying through the clouds.

speaker: Katara
text: Aang, I still owe you an apology. You were just so good at waterbending without really trying. I got so competitive that I put us all in danger, I'm sorry.

speaker: Aang
text: That's okay Katara.

speaker: Katara
text: Besides, who needs that stupid scroll anyway?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Holding the scroll. Sarcastically.] Is that really how you feel?

speaker: Katara
text: The scroll!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Puts his hand in front to keep Katara from grabbing it.] First, what did you learn?

speaker: Katara
text: Stealing is wrong. [Snatches scroll.] Unless it's from pirates.

speaker: Aang
text: [Laughing.] Good one, Katara.
Fades to credits.

The episode opens in a forest. Momo is chasing a bug through the trees. In his pursuit he lands on the ground to see a neatly stacked pile of lychee nuts. When he runs toward it, Momo is pulled into the air by a cage trap, joining two other caged animals. Camera changes focus to find the rest of Team Avatar camping.

speaker: Aang
text: Where's Momo? [Camera zooms in to close-up shot of Aang, Katara, and Sokka, the siblings sitting next to each other with bored faces, and Aang standing with his back to the camera. Momo screeches and the gang looks around.]
Camera fades to find Aang as he spots the three animals in their cage traps hanging by rope on tree limbs.

speaker: Aang
text: Hang on, Momo! [Aang uses his airbending to fly to the top of the tree, jumping from trunk-to-trunk to get higher. He finds the traps' mechanisms, undoes them, and carefully lowers Momo to the ground where Katara and Sokka are waiting. They open the trap together and the lemur runs out with one of the lychee nuts in his mouth. Katara and Sokka look on as Momo gets on his hind legs and eats it as though nothing has happened. Sokka grunts in frustration and facepalms. When Aang lands, he looks up to see the other two animals seemingly crying out to him for help.] All right, you too. [Jumps up to them.]

speaker: Sokka
text: This is gonna take forever. [Throws his boomerang to simply cut the animals free.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Inching his way upside-down to the traps on the tree branch. They fall before he can reach them.] That works.

The hog monkeys run and out of the camera's view and Aang slides back down from the tree, dirt flying from the ground as he lands. Everyone gathers around two of the traps and Sokka kneels down to examine them.

speaker: Sokka
text: These are Fire Nation traps. [Camera zooms to upward shot of the gang looking at the trap.] You can tell from the metalwork. We'd better pack up camp and get moving.
They gather their things and begin to pack them onto Appa's saddle.

speaker: Sokka
text: Uh-uh! No flying this time.

speaker: Aang
text: [Confused.] What? Why wouldn't we fly?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Takes the sleeping bag from Aang's hands.] Think about it: Somehow Prince Zuko and the Fire Nation keep finding us. It's because they spot Appa, he's just too noticeable.

speaker: Katara
text: What? Appa's not too noticeable!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Points dramatically at Appa; condescendingly.] He's a gigantic fluffy monster with an arrow on his head! It's kinda hard to miss him! [The bison yawns and the camera flashes to Aang sitting comfortably on the animal's head.]

speaker: Aang
text: [To Appa.] Sokka's just jealous 'cause he doesn't have an arrow.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Camera closes in on Sokka and Katara next to each other.] I know you all wanna fly, but my instincts tell me we should play it safe this time and walk.

speaker: Katara
text: [Leans forward at her brother and smiles.] Who made you the boss?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Points his finger at his chest; to Katara.] I'm not the boss, I'm the leader.

speaker: Katara
text: [Amused.] You're the leader? But your voice still cracks!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Voice cracks.] I'm the oldest, and I'm a warrior! So [Deepens voice.] I'm the leader!

speaker: Katara
text: [Close-up shot of Katara's face.] If anyone's the leader, it's Aang. I mean, he is the Avatar. [Pan back to Sokka.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Are you kidding? He's just a goofy kid!

speaker: Aang
text: [While hanging upside-down from Appa's right horn with feet sticking out in the air.] He's right.

speaker: Katara
text: Why do boys always think someone has to be the leader? I bet you wouldn't be so bossy if you kissed a girl.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Close-up on Sokka; defensively.] I've kissed a girl, you just haven't met her.

speaker: Katara
text: [Back to Sokka; mischievously.] Who? Gran-Gran? I've met Gran-Gran.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Throws arms into the air.] No! Besides Gran-Gran. Look, my instincts tell me we have a better chance of slipping through on foot, and a leader has to trust his instincts.

speaker: Katara
text: [Sarcastically.] Okay, we'll try it your way, oh wise leader.

speaker: Aang
text: [Aang steps over, now wearing a backpack. Momo is sitting on the top.] Who knows? Walking might be fun. [Cut to the forest at a later time. Between trees the group trudges along, with Sokka in front, followed by Aang and Momo, Katara, and Appa.] Walking stinks! How do people go anywhere without a flying bison?

speaker: Katara
text: [Sarcastically.] Well I don't know, Aang. Why don't you ask Sokka's instincts? They seem to know everything.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Sarcastically.] Ha ha, very funny.

speaker: Aang
text: [Complaining.] I'm tired of carrying this pack.

speaker: Katara
text: You know who you should ask to carry it for a while? Sokka's instincts. [Sokka's eyes turn to her in irritation.]

speaker: Aang
text: That's a great idea. Hey, Sokka's instincts, would you mind--

speaker: Sokka
text: [Annoyed.] Okay, okay, I get it! Look, guys, I'm tired too. But the important thing is that we're safe from the [Walks through a bush and sees something in front of him.] Fire ... Nation.

Sokka sees a Fire Nation campsite with a lot of soldiers; most of them are seated or crouched near the fire with bowls in hand and a couple of them sit close to the tents, which have the Fire Nation emblem on the doorflap. One of these soldiers has a patch over his left eye. They all notice the group and get up.

speaker: Sokka
text: Run! [They turn to run but a firebender blocks them off by setting the bushes behind them on fire.] We're cut off!

speaker: Aang
text: Sokka, your shirt! [Sokka yells; Katara clears a fire on Sokka's shirt with waterbending.]

speaker: Sokka
text: If you let us pass, we promise not to hurt you.

speaker: Katara
text: [Whispers.] What are you doing?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Whispers.] Bluffing.

speaker: Eye-patch soldier
text: You, promise not to hurt us? [A whooshing sound is heard and the soldier is knocked out by an unseen tranquillizer dart on his back.]

speaker: Aang
text: Nice work, Sokka! How'd you do that?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shrugs; confused.] Uh, instinct?

speaker: Katara
text: [Points up a tree.] Look!

In a tall tree, a young man named Jet, tosses his blowpipe and unsheathes two hook swords. He jumps and takes down two soldiers on landing. He runs forward and takes down two more using his hook swords.

speaker: Jet
text: Down you go. [Katara looks amazed, Aang shocked, and Sokka confused.]
Another soldier charges at Jet, but he is defeated.

speaker: Fire Nation soldier
text: They're in the trees!

A young boy lands on top of the soldier and turns his helmet around to blind him, before riding him around while laughing. Another boy launches arrows at the soldiers while more boys come out of the trees. Aang and Katara are shown fighting the soldiers. Sokka holds up his boomerang and yells as one approaches him, but stops when Jet takes him down first.

speaker: Sokka
text: Hey, he was mine!

speaker: Jet
text: Gotta be quicker next time.

Sokka looks dismayed and the camera cuts to show a huge boy fall out of the trees and easily take down two soldiers as Jet skilfully takes down one more, causing this soldier's spear to hit another soldier, who was going to battle Sokka, in the head, making that soldier also fall down.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Angrily.] Man!
Jet disarms another soldier and runs up to Katara.

speaker: Jet
text: Hey.

speaker: Katara
text: Hi.
They look around to see a now empty camp.

speaker: Aang
text: [Amazed.] You just took out a whole army almost single-handed.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Disdainfully.] Army?! Pfft! There were only like, twenty guys. [Jet introduces himself.]

speaker: Jet
text: My name is Jet, and these are my Freedom Fighters. Sneers, Longshot, Smellerbee, The Duke, and Pipsqueak.

speaker: Aang
text: [Laughing; looking at The Duke.] Ha ha! Pipsqueak, that's a funny name. [The Duke sniffs his nose, as the camera pans upward to Pipsqueak.]

speaker: Pipsqueak
text: [Looming over Aang in a threatening manner; in a low, growling tone of voice.] You think my name is funny?

speaker: Aang
text: [Side-shot; Aang looks taken aback for a second before replying in an upbeat tone.] It's hilarious!

Facial shot of Pipsqueak, still looming forward with a frown on his face. He suddenly starts laughing. The camera moves back, showing Aang and The Duke following suit. Pipsqueak pats the Avatar on the back in a friendly manner, though the hit was hard enough to knock Aang flat on the ground. The Duke stops laughing and looks down at Aang sprawled on the ground before his feet, face flat in the dirt, though when Aang raises his head and continues laughing, so does The Duke.

The scene fades to the Fire Nation camp, and the camera cuts to show the Freedom Fighters raiding the empty camp. Sokka feels a little uncomfortable as he see Smellerbee carrying weapons with her.

speaker: Katara
text: [Approaching Jet by the tree.] Umm, thanks for saving us, Jet. We're lucky you were there.

speaker: Jet
text: I should be thanking you. We were waiting to ambush those soldiers all morning. We just needed the right distraction, and then you guys stumbled in.

speaker: Katara
text: [Eyeing Sokka.] We were relying on instincts.

speaker: Jet
text: You'll get yourself killed doing that.
Sokka looks at them disdainfully as The Duke and Pipsqueak look through the barrels. The Duke touches a jelly-like substance on his finger and sniffs it.

speaker: The Duke
text: Hey, Jet, these barrels are filled of blasting jelly.

speaker: Jet
text: That's a great score.

speaker: Pipsqueak
text: [Holds up a wooden box.] And these boxes are filled with jelly candy!

speaker: Jet
text: Also good. Let's not get those mixed up.

speaker: The Duke
text: We'll take this stuff back to the hideout.

speaker: Aang
text: You guys have a hideout?

speaker: Jet
text: You wanna see it?

speaker: Katara
text: [Very excitedly.] Yes, we wanna see it!
Jet smiles at her and the camera fades to show them standing on the forest floor.

speaker: Jet
text: We're here.

speaker: Sokka
text: Where? There's nothing here.

speaker: Jet
text: Hold this. [Gives a rope to Sokka.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Skeptically.] Why? What's this do? [Screams as he is pulled up into the branches.]

speaker: Jet
text: Aang? [Offers Aang another rope.]

speaker: Aang
text: I'll get up on my own. [Leaps up into the trees with airbending.]

speaker: Jet
text: Grab hold of me, Katara.

Katara blushes as she takes his hand and they rise up through the tree together in a romantic setting. They come to a landing on a wooden platform in the trees. Once up there, Aang is seen zip lining through the trees.

speaker: Aang
text: [While passing through with Momo.] Nice place you got!

speaker: Katara
text: It's beautiful up here!

speaker: Jet
text: It's beautiful, and more importantly, the Fire Nation can't find us. [Smellerbee lands near the two.]

speaker: Smellerbee
text: They would love to find you. Wouldn't they, Jet?

speaker: Jet
text: [Smirking.] It's not gonna happen, Smellerbee. [Katara, the Freedom Fighters, and Sokka follow Jet across a bridge.]

speaker: Katara
text: [As Aang zips by again.] Why does the Fire Nation want to find you?

speaker: Jet
text: I guess you could say I've been causing them a little trouble. See, they took over a nearby Earth Kingdom town a few years back.

speaker: Pipsqueak
text: We've been ambushin' their troops, cutting off their supply lines, and doing anything we can to mess with 'em. [Sokka is now seen comically hopping around trying to get past Pipsqueak.]

speaker: Jet
text: One day, we'll drive the Fire Nation out of here for good and free that town.

speaker: Katara
text: That's so brave. [Sokka manages to get by Pipsqueak.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Sarcastically.] Yeah, nothing's braver than a guy in a tree house.

speaker: Katara
text: Don't pay any attention to my brother.

speaker: Jet
text: No problem. He probably had a rough day.

speaker: Katara
text: So, you all live here? [Sokka who is being ignored comically sinks back behind them.]

speaker: Jet
text: That's right. Longshot over there? [The screen cuts to Longshot and The Duke walking not making a sound.] His town got burned down by the Fire Nation. And we found The Duke trying to steal our food. I don't think he ever really had a home.

speaker: Katara
text: What about you?

speaker: Jet
text: [Katara and Jet come to a halt as the rest pass the bridge.] The Fire Nation killed my parents. I was only eight years old. That day changed me forever.

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka and I lost our mother to the Fire Nation.

speaker: Jet
text: [Sympathetically.] I'm so sorry, Katara.

The screen fades from the two of them alone on the suspension bridge to the blue sky above the canopy. A cloud of cawing birds is disturbed as Appa raises his head with a roar. In the hideout, ropes with lanterns hang between branches. Sentries keep watch on several upper platforms while the group sits at a banquet table. While the group eats, Jet stands on the table.

speaker: Jet
text: Today, we struck another blow against the Fire Nation swine. [Everyone cheers. Katara and Aang smile while Sokka cops an attitude and a scowling face.] I got a special joy from the look on one soldier's face, when The Duke dropped down on his helmet and rode him like a wild hog monkey. [The Duke, without his helmet, climbs up the table. He marches on the table with his arms in the air.] Now, the Fire Nation thinks they don't have to worry about a couple of kids hiding in the trees. [He prepares to take a drink from his wooden cup.] Maybe they're right. [A very loud and long boo is heard; with an angry face.] Or maybe ... they're dead wrong. [A loud and long cheer is heard.]

speaker: Katara
text: Hey, Jet, nice speech.

speaker: Jet
text: [Sits down next to Katara.] Thanks. By the way, I was really impressed with you and Aang. That was some great bending I saw out there today.

speaker: Katara
text: Well, he's great. He's the Avatar. [Blushes.] I could use some more training.

speaker: Jet
text: [Flattered.] Avatar, huh? Very nice.

speaker: Aang
text: Thanks, Jet.

speaker: Jet
text: So I might know a way that you and Aang can help in our struggle.

speaker: Sokka
text: Unfortunately, we have to leave tonight. [Sokka starts walking away.]

speaker: Jet
text: Sokka, you're kidding me! I needed you on an important mission tomorrow. [Sokka turns around, feeling unsure.]

speaker: Sokka
text: What mission?

The scene changes to the top of the forest the next day. Jet and Sokka are in branches of the same tree. Jet cups his hands and makes a birdcall; several trees down Pipsqueak and Smellerbee step into view from their branches. They reply with another birdcall. Sokka jams his jawbone knife into the trunk of the tree.

speaker: Jet
text: What are you doing?

speaker: Sokka
text: Shh ... It amplifies vibrations.

speaker: Jet
text: [Impressed.] Good trick.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Sokka puts his ear to the handle of his knife.] Nothing yet. [Whispers.] Wait! Yes, someone's approaching.

speaker: Jet
text: [Whispers.] How many?

speaker: Sokka
text: I think there's just one.

speaker: Jet
text: [Does a another birdcall.] Good work, Sokka. Ready your weapon. [Sokka takes his knife out of the tree. His eyes spot an old man.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Whispers.] Wait, false alarm ... He's just an old man.
Jet ignores Sokka and prepares to attack the old man, leaping to the ground in front of the traveler. Sokka watches with horror.

speaker: Jet
text: What are you doing in our woods, you leech?

speaker: Old Fire Nation civilian
text: Please sir, I'm just a traveler.

Jet takes a step, and with one swipe, sends the man's cane flying from his hand. The old man backs away, but when he tries to flee the way he came, he runs face first into Pipsqueak's chest. The force of the impact knocks him to the ground; Pipsqueak looms over him. He tries to crawl away, but Pipsqueak's foot on his backside effectively pins him.

speaker: Jet
text: Do you like destroying towns? Do you like destroying families? Do you?!

speaker: Old Fire Nation civilian
text: Oh ... Please, let me go ... have mercy ...

speaker: Jet
text: [Snaps down on him viciously.] Does the Fire Nation let people go?! Does the Fire Nation have mercy?!
Jet is about to kick the man, but his foot is snagged by Sokka's club before it can be delivered. Sokka releases him.

speaker: Sokka
text: Jet, he's just an old man!

speaker: Jet
text: He's Fire Nation! Search him! [Pipsqueak holds the prisoner and Smellerbee steps up to search the poor man.]

speaker: Sokka
text: But he's not hurting anyone!

speaker: Jet
text: [Argues at Sokka angrily.] Have you forgotten that the Fire Nation killed your mother? Remember why you fight!

speaker: Smellerbee
text: We've got his stuff, Jet. [She holds up the old man's bag. The old man is thrown back on the ground.]

speaker: Sokka
text: This doesn't feel right.

speaker: Jet
text: [Coldly.] It's what has to be done. Now let's get outta here.
Jet pushes past Sokka. Pipsqueak and Smellerbee follow. Sokka looks at the old man still on his hands and knees in pity.

speaker: Jet
text: Come on, Sokka!
Sokka slowly turns and runs to catch up with the others. At the hideout, Aang and Momo are playing with the ziplines again. He leaps near Sokka.

speaker: Aang
text: Sokka! Look what The Duke gave me! [Aang is wearing a bag and pulls a small pellet from it. With a sly grin, he tosses it next to Momo, where it explodes with a pop. Momo puffs up like a startled cat. He hisses and lunges for the bag. Momo sits on Aang's shoulder and tosses several pellets at his feet. Aang dances about wildly.] Ow! Quit it!
Sokka is oblivious of it all. He's sitting with his back to the trunk and staring at the ground, glaring. Katara walks up.

speaker: Katara
text: Hey, Sokka. Is Jet back?

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah, he's back. But we're leaving.

speaker: Aang
text: What?

speaker: Katara
text: But I made him this hat. [She shows a cap made out of stitched leaves with a flower on top.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Your boyfriend Jet's a thug.

speaker: Katara
text: [Shocked.] What?! No, he's not.

speaker: Sokka
text: He's messed up, Katara.

speaker: Aang
text: He's not messed up, he's just got a different way of life, a really fun way of life.

speaker: Sokka
text: He beat and robbed a harmless old man!

speaker: Katara
text: [Crosses her arms; doubtfully.] I wanna hear Jet's side of the story. [The scene changes to Jet in a room.]

speaker: Jet
text: Sokka, you told them what happened, but you didn't mention that the guy was Fire Nation?
Jet is sitting on a hammock-bed, the others stand. Sokka stands grumpily as far away as he can get. Aang is wearing the hat Katara made; he looks ridiculous and goofy.

speaker: Katara
text: No, he conveniently left that part out.

speaker: Sokka
text: Fine! But even if he was Fire Nation, he was a harmless civilian!

speaker: Jet
text: He was an assassin, Sokka.

Jet pulls out a knife and thrusts it into a nearby stump. It is a sinister-looking curved blade. There are four spikes evenly spaced along the grip, with enough space for fingers to go between them. There is a ring on the butt of the knife.

speaker: Jet
text: See? There's a compartment for poison in the knife. [He pulls on the ring and removes a small glass tube filled with red liquid.]. He was sent to eliminate me. You helped save my life, Sokka.

speaker: Katara
text: I knew there was an explanation.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Suspiciously.] I didn't see any knife!

speaker: Jet
text: That's because he was concealing it.

speaker: Katara
text: See, Sokka? I'm sure you just didn't notice the knife.

speaker: Sokka
text: There was no knife! I'm going back to the hut and packing my things. [Sokka stomps away.]

speaker: Jet
text: Tell me you guys aren't leaving yet. I really need your help.

speaker: Aang
text: What can we do?

speaker: Jet
text: The Fire Nation is planning on burning down our forest. If you both use waterbending to fill the reservoir, we could fight the fires. But if you leave now, they'll destroy the whole valley.
Aang and Katara look at each other. Fade to them entering their hut. Sokka is tying up a mat on the floor.

speaker: Katara
text: We can't leave now with the Fire Nation about to burn down a forest!

speaker: Sokka
text: I'm sorry, Katara. Jet's very smooth, but we can't trust him.

speaker: Katara
text: You know what I think? You're jealous that he's a better warrior and a better leader!

speaker: Sokka
text: Katara, I'm not jealous of Jet. It's just that my instinct--

speaker: Katara
text: Well, my instincts tell me we need to stay here a little longer and help Jet. Come on, Aang.

speaker: Aang
text: Sorry, Sokka.

They leave the hut. Fade to the night sky above the canopy. A full moon shines on Appa, who is on his back and snoring extremely loud as he sleeps. Inside the Trio's hut, Sokka sleeps propped up against his still-packed gear while the others sleep in their sleeping bags.

speaker: Jet
text: [Whispers offscreen.] Let's go.

Sokka wakes up. He pulls the door flap aside enough to see some of Jet's followers descending on the rope lines. Sokka grabs a rope line down to a lower branch. On the ground below him, Jet's Freedom Fighters are quietly pushing the loaded wagon as Jet leads them out of the camp. Sokka stealthily follows. In the dark valley. Upstream, and up toward the wall of the valley there is an old falls, and beyond that a man-made dam. A bare cliff off to the reservoir's left provides the view. Jet and his boys emerge from the forest. He goes to the edge and looks down on the dam below. The reservoir behind it is low. He turns back to the wagon.

speaker: Jet
text: Now listen, you are not to blow the dam until I give the signal. If the reservoir isn't full, the Fire Nation troops could survive. [The Duke jumps off the wagon.]

speaker: The Duke
text: But what about the people in the town? Won't they get wiped out, too? [Jet places a hand on The Duke's shoulder.]

speaker: Jet
text: Look, Duke, that's the price of ridding this area of the Fire Nation. [To Longshot.] Now don't blow the dam until I give the signal. Got it? [Longshot nods.]
Sokka watches incredulously from the bushes. He frowns, and hears rustling just before Pipsqueak drags him out by his wolf-tail. Smellerbee's knife is instantly at his throat.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: [Sneering.] Where do you think you're going, ponytail?
Scene transitions to early morning. Jet is standing near the edge of the cliff. As he watches, Pipsqueak and Smellerbee drag Sokka between them. Pipsqueak still has a handful of Sokka's wolf-tail.

speaker: Jet
text: Sokka, I'm glad you decided to join us. [Pipsqueak and Smellerbee send Sokka to his knees. He rubs his shoulder.]

speaker: Sokka
text: I heard your plan to destroy the Earth Kingdom town.

speaker: Jet
text: Our plan is to rid the valley of the Fire Nation.

speaker: Sokka
text: There are people living there, Jet; mothers and fathers and children.

speaker: Jet
text: We can't win without making some sacrifices. [Sokka points an accusing finger at Jet.]

speaker: Sokka
text: You lied to Aang and Katara about the forest fire!

speaker: Jet
text: Because they don't understand the demands of war. Not like you and I do.

speaker: Sokka
text: I do understand. I understand that there's nothing you won't do to get what you want.

speaker: Jet
text: [Feeling disappointed.] I was hoping you'd have an open mind, but I can see you've made your choice.
Pipsqueak and Smellerbee grab for Sokka. Before he can even react, Jet has his wrist pinned with the hooks of his shuang gou. Sokka's other hand is forced behind his back.

speaker: Jet
text: I can't let you warn Katara and Aang. [Jet releases Sokka's hand; it is immediately forced behind his back.] Take him for a walk, a long walk.

speaker: Sokka
text: You can't do this!

speaker: Jet
text: Cheer up, Sokka. We're gonna win a great victory against the Fire Nation today.

The screen pans to the riverside upriver from the dam. The collected water behind it is much less than the larger cavity of the reservoir. The river leading to down to it is a thread compared to its 'rainy season' gully. Jet, Katara, and Aang are seen walking upriver along its west bank.

speaker: Katara
text: Jet, I'm sorry about how Sokka's been acting.

speaker: Jet
text: No worries, he already apologized.

speaker: Aang
text: Really? [Aang and Katara stop and look at one another.] Sokka apologized?

speaker: Jet
text: Yeah, I was surprised too. I got the sense that maybe you talked to him or something.

speaker: Katara
text: Yeah, I did.

speaker: Jet
text: I guess something you said got through to him. Anyhow, he went out on a scouting mission with Pipsqueak and Smellerbee.

speaker: Katara
text: I'm glad he cooled off. He's so stubborn sometimes.
They are now walking in the gully, beside the 'river'. Aang pauses after noticing something strange, and is launched into the air by a blast from the geyser he was standing on.

speaker: Jet
text: All right, we're here. Underground water's trying to escape through these vents. I need you guys to help it along.

speaker: Katara
text: I've never used bending on water I can't see. I don't know ... [Jet stands behind her and places his hands on her shoulders.]

speaker: Jet
text: Katara. You can do this.

speaker: Aang
text: [Airbends himself back on the ground.] What about me?

speaker: Jet
text: I know the Avatar can do this.

Aang and Katara stand on one of the many geysers in the gully. While Jet looks on, they bend the water up. After a few minutes, a stream of water emerges from the hole. They pull it to their height and send it toward the river where it continues to flow like a waterfall. The water quickly joins the river.

speaker: Jet
text: Yes! Good job! This river empties into the reservoir--a few more geysers and it'll be full.

speaker: Aang
text: Look, there's another steam vent. [Aang and Katara walk off in its direction.]

speaker: Jet
text: Okay. You two keep it up, I'll go check on things at the reservoir. [He turns and walks away.]

speaker: Katara
text: When we're done, we'll meet you over there.

speaker: Jet
text: Actually ... probably better if you meet me back at the hideout when you're done. [Jet resumes walking away Aang and Katara bend the next geyser into another fountain.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Later.] I bet that's enough, and I'm not just saying that to be lazy. [Around them, over a dozen geysers flow into the river.]

speaker: Katara
text: Let's catch up with Jet at the reservoir.

speaker: Aang
text: I thought we agreed to meet Jet back at the hideout.

speaker: Katara
text: Well, we finished early. I'm sure he'll be happy to see us.
The screen changes to a path in the forest. Pipsqueak and Smellerbee follow Sokka, who has his hands tied behind his back. Smellerbee gives Sokka a shove; Sokka stumbles but remains on his feet.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Come on, move along!

speaker: Sokka
text: How can you stand by and do nothing while Jet wipes out a whole town?

speaker: Pipsqueak
text: Hey, listen, Sokka, Jet's a great leader. We follow what he says, and things always turn out okay. [Sokka notices a couple of snare leaf-piles nearby identical to the one that enticed Momo, right down to the pile of lychee nuts.]

speaker: Sokka
text: If that's how Jet leads ... then he's got a lot to learn! [Sokka sprints off in the direction of the snares. Smellerbee makes a grab for him, but misses.]

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Hey! [They give chase. Sokka leaps over the leaf piles. Pipsqueak and Smellerbee don't, and end up snared and hanging many feet up in the air.]

speaker: Sokka
text: While you two are up there, you might want to practice your knot work. [He holds up his now-worthless bindings, turns, and walks away.]

speaker: Pipsqueak
text: Hey, Smellerbee. You gonna eat your lychee nuts? [Smellerbee hits him in the head with a lychee nut and it lands in the pile he's holding.] Ooh. [He picks one up and licks his lips.]
Katara and Aang are standing on the edge of the cliff. At the base of the dam, four of Jet's people are unloading barrels from the wagon and arranging them.

speaker: Katara
text: What are they doing?

speaker: Aang
text: Hey, those are the red barrels he got from the Fire Nation.

speaker: Katara
text: Why would they need blasting jelly? [Zooms on Aang, who is horrified.]

speaker: Aang
text: Because Jet's gonna blow up the dam.

speaker: Katara
text: What? No, that would destroy the town. Jet wouldn't do that. [Aang opens his glider.]

speaker: Aang
text: I've gotta stop him. [He takes off.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Less convinced.] Jet wouldn't do that.
Before Aang can reach the edge, Jet crosses his path from behind and snatches the glider. Aang is left wobbling precariously on the edge, and uses airbending to get himself back on stable footing.

speaker: Jet
text: Yes, I would.

speaker: Katara
text: Jet, why?

speaker: Jet
text: Katara, you would too if you just stopped to think. Think about what the Fire Nation did to your mother. We can't let them do that to anyone else ever again.

speaker: Katara
text: This isn't the answer!

speaker: Jet
text: I want you to understand me, Katara. I thought your brother would understand, but--

speaker: Katara
text: Where's Sokka? [Tears fall from her eyes. Jet reaches out and touches her face.]

speaker: Jet
text: Katara.
She lowers her head, and with an angry shout, sends Jet flying with the water from her waterskin. She draws it back into the skin when she's done.

speaker: Aang
text: I need to get to the dam.
Aang's closed glider is on the ground. As he reaches for it, one of Jet's hook swords pins it. Jet has the two swords hook to hook; with a yank he pulls Aang's glider to him.

speaker: Jet
text: You're not going anywhere without your glider.
Jet swings the swords at Aang. Aang somersaults backward to avoid the extra reach. Aang finishes his retreat in a nearby tree.

speaker: Aang
text: I'm not gonna fight you, Jet!

speaker: Jet
text: [Taunting.] You'll have to if you want your glider back.

Aang retreats back into the forest, as Jet hooks the branch and pulls himself up. Katara follows on the ground. Jet attacks; Aang defends himself with balls of air, which Jet ducks. Jet attacks head on, but Aang blocks with his arms and sends his opponent flying into a tree trunk with an air kick. Jet combines his swords again and advances. Aang avoids the flail-like move and sends another air blast. Jet stoops down and lets the air flow over and past him before lunging.

They continue the chase through the many levels of the forest. Jet catches up to Aang and sends them both freefalling, attacking as they go. They both end up on a branch. Jet continues his attack. Aang avoids it all. Jet charges again, but Aang hits him with a jetstream of air. Jet falls. He recovers, but loses the glider in the process. Before Aang can get to the ground Jet kicks him into a trunk. He lands with a thud next to his glider.

A small tributary flows past him. Aang is slow to get up. Before Jet can take more than a step however, he his hit by a large water strike. Katara is there; she uses water from the river to throw Jet against the trunk of the tree. Over and over she attacks; Jet is unable to cut the water and its force plasters him against the trunk. She freezes Jet from toe to neck.

speaker: Katara
text: Why, Jet? I can't believe I trusted you. You lied to me, you're sick and I trusted you! [A birdcall is heard. Katara and Aang are startled, and look to the valley beyond where it's coming from. Jet gives an answering birdcall.] What are you doing?

speaker: Jet
text: You're too late.

speaker: Katara
text: [Horrified.] No!
Aang opens his glider and runs for the nearby cliff. His glider's wings are damaged to the point that he has no lift, and slams back into the ground near the edge. Katara runs over to help him.

speaker: Aang
text: [In pain from the fall.] Sokka's still out there, he's our only chance.

speaker: Katara
text: Come on, Sokka. I'm sorry I ever doubted you, please.
Longshot stands on a branch, his bow pulled. He has a flaming arrow on the string. He takes aim and fires. It arcs down to the base of the dam. Katara watches in horror.

speaker: Katara
text: [Whispers.] No ...

The center of the dam explodes in a cloud of smoke and fire. Katara and Aang watch a massive wall of water go to the town. Inside the town the streets are empty except for the occasional barrels and the Cabbage Merchant's cabbage cart. The water rushes through the open gate, as a cresting wave dwarfs it. The wall and gate are swallowed as the wave strikes the town. The flotsam carried away includes a smiling doll in a purple dress.

speaker: Aang
text: Sokka didn't make it in time.

speaker: Katara
text: All those people ... [She turns in rage back to Jet.] Jet, you monster!

speaker: Jet
text: This was a victory, Katara. Remember that. The Fire Nation is gone and this valley will be safe.

speaker: Sokka
text: It will be safe, without you. [In shock, Jet looks up to see Sokka, Appa, and Momo rise from below the level of the cliff.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Overjoyed.] Sokka!

speaker: Sokka
text: I warned the villagers of your plan, just in time.

speaker: Jet
text: [Outraged.] What?!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Fades to an illustrated set of flashback stills each being panned through.] At first they didn't believe me. The Fire Nation soldiers assumed I was a spy. But one man vouched for me, the old man you attacked. He urged them to trust me, and we got everyone out in time.

The flashback ends and the townsfolk are seen on high ground above the river, on the bank opposite the town. A little girl, who was seen in the flashback, runs down to the water's edge as the doll floats by. She retrieves it.

speaker: Little girl
text: [Happily.] Misses Pretty! [She hugs her doll.]
Scene cuts back to Jet stuck to the tree, embittered and resentful. He berates Sokka with strong animosity.

speaker: Jet
text: Sokka, you fool! We could've freed this valley! [Aang leaps onto Appa's saddle as Sokka prepares to fly.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Who would be free? Everyone would be dead.

speaker: Jet
text: [Contorts his face with spite.] You traitor!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shows a little sympathy to Jet.] No, Jet. You became the traitor when you stopped protecting innocent people.

speaker: Jet
text: Katara. Please, help me.

speaker: Katara
text: [Closes her eyes; devastated.] Goodbye, Jet. [She leaves on Appa. Sokka gives Appa's reigns a flick.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Yip yip. [Jet is left behind, still frozen to the tree.]
The sky they fly in is empty, save a few wispy clouds.

speaker: Aang
text: We thought you were going to the dam. How come you went to the town instead?

speaker: Katara
text: Let me guess, your instincts told you.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shrugs his right shoulder.] Hey, sometimes they're right.

speaker: Aang
text: Um ... Sokka? You know we're going the wrong way, right? [Sokka is surprised, but quickly recovers.]

speaker: Sokka
text: And sometimes they're wrong. [With a grin, he pulls Appa's reigns. They fly off screen before reappearing, going in the opposite direction.]
Fades to credits.

Opening shot of the sun setting behind some tall rock outcroppings. The sky is mostly cloudy and the clouds reflect the light of the dying sun. Pan down to show a patched up tent being jostled about from the inside. A rolled up tarp lies next to the tent. Sokka is inside a tent, trying to assemble it. Sokka can be heard grunting and fussing about as he tries to finish setting up the shelter. Katara walks in the frame, her back to the camera, with a pile of fire wood in her arms.

speaker: Katara
text: Um, aren't you forgetting the tarp?

speaker: Sokka
text: Right, got it ... [Tosses the wrapped up tarp inside the tent.]

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka, you're supposed to put the tarp on top of the tent. You know, so we don't get rained on? [Cut to an overhead shot of the two, Sokka gesturing widely as he replies to his sister.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Ordinarily, you'd be right, but seeing how it's the dry season, you're not. Besides that tarp makes a pretty warm blanket.

speaker: Katara
text: But what if it does rain?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Spreading his arms wide in exasperation.] What if it doesn't? Then I would have put up the tarp for nothing.

speaker: Katara
text: [Stomps the ground angrily.] You're infuriating!

speaker: Sokka
text: Katara, why don't you worry about gathering firewood, because that kindling is looking pretty sorry.

speaker: Katara
text: [Angered.] Well, if you don't like my firewood- [Throws the sticks at Sokka who shields himself from the wood. He stands in anger after the hail of sticks subsides.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Angry.] Fine by me, if you're not gonna do your job- [He tears the tent down and the two stare at each other angrily as Aang approaches.]

speaker: Aang
text: Okay, I got the grub if you guys got the- [The siblings turn away from each other in anger with their arms folded.] hey, where's the campfire? And what happened to the tent?

speaker: Sokka
text: Why don't you ask Miss Know-It-All, Queen of the Twigs.

speaker: Katara
text: Oh yeah? Well, you're Mister Lazy Bum, King of the [Picks up and throws a twig at Sokka's head.] Tents! [Sokka turns around, looking angrily at her.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Laughs.] Okay, listen guys, harsh words won't solve problems, action will. Why don't you just switch jobs?

speaker: Katara
text: Sounds good.

speaker: Sokka
text: [At the same time.] Whatever.

speaker: Aang
text: [Grinning while gloating.] You see that? Settling feuds and making peace, all in a day's work for the Avatar. [Turns his head to see Momo and Appa fighting over a watermelon. Momo continuously tries to fly away with it, while Appa pins it down. Aang takes the melon and uses airbending to slice it. Momo seems to be complaining about how he got the much smaller half and Appa got the bigger half.] Come on, Momo, that's fair. Appa's got five stomachs. [Appa eats his half of the melon.]
