speaker: Ticket lady
text: Well, normally it's only one ticket per passport, but this document is so official ... I guess it's worth four tickets. [Stamps an approval seal on the tickets.]

speaker: Toph
text: Thank you very much.

speaker: Sokka
text: All right, we scammed that lady good!
Suddenly, a security guard, actually Suki without makeup, grabs Sokka.

speaker: Suki
text: Tickets and passports please.

speaker: Sokka
text: Is there a problem?

speaker: Suki
text: Yeah, I got a problem with you! I've seen your type before. Probably sarcastic, think you're hilarious and let me guess, you're traveling with the Avatar.

speaker: Sokka
text: Do I know you?

speaker: Suki
text: You mean you don't remember? Maybe you'll remember this! [Kisses Sokka on the cheek.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Suki! [Embraces her.]

speaker: Suki
text: Sokka, it's good to see you!
Later, in a different location of the station. The gang and Suki talk.

speaker: Katara
text: You look so different without your makeup! And the new outfit.

speaker: Suki
text: That crabby lady makes all the security guards wear them. And look at you, sleeveless guy. Been working out?

speaker: Sokka
text: Ahhh, I'll grab a tree branch and do a few chin touches every now and then. Nothing major.

speaker: Aang
text: Are the other Kyoshi Warriors around?

speaker: Suki
text: Yeah. After you left Kyoshi, we wanted to find a way to help people. We ended up escorting some refugees and we've been here ever since. [Momo jumps up next to her.] Hi, Momo! Good to see you too! [Scratches his head near his ear.] So why are you guys getting tickets for the ferry? Wouldn't you just fly across on Appa?

speaker: Katara
text: Appa is missing. We hope to find him in Ba Sing Se.

speaker: Suki
text: I'm so sorry to hear that. [To Aang.] Are you doing okay?

speaker: Aang
text: I'm doing fine. Would everybody stop worrying about me?

speaker: Ying
text: Avatar Aang, you have to help us! Someone took all of our belongings; our passports, our tickets, everything's gone!

speaker: Aang
text: I'll talk to the lady for you.
Back at the desk.

speaker: Ticket lady
text: No passports, no tickets! [Stamps a "denied" stamp on Aang's forehead.]

speaker: Aang
text: But she's pregnant and all of her stuff was stolen! You have to make an exception!

speaker: Ticket lady
text: No exceptions! If I just gave away tickets willy-nilly to anyone, there would be no more order! You know what that means, no more civilization!

speaker: Aang
text: What if we gave them our tickets?

speaker: Ticket lady
text: No!

speaker: Aang
text: But ...

speaker: Ticket lady
text: Next!

speaker: Aang
text: Don't worry, you'll get to the city safely. I'll lead you through the Serpent's Pass.
Moments later.

speaker: Sokka
text: I can't believe we gave up our tickets and now we're going through the Serpent's Pass.

speaker: Toph
text: I can't believe you're still complaining about it.

speaker: Suki
text: [In her normal Kyoshi Warrior attire.] I'm coming too!

speaker: Sokka
text: Are you sure that's a good idea?

speaker: Suki
text: Sokka, I thought you'd want me to come.

speaker: Sokka
text: I do, it's just–

speaker: Suki
text: Just what?

speaker: Sokka
text: Nothing. I'm glad you're coming.
Outside, at the pass.

speaker: Sokka
text: This is the Serpent's Pass? I thought it would be a little more wind-y, you know, like a serpent. Huh, I guess they misnamed it.

speaker: Ying
text: Look at this writing! How awful!

speaker: Toph
text: What does it say?

speaker: Katara
text: It says, "abandon hope".

speaker: Ying
text: How can we abandon hope? It's all we have!

speaker: Aang
text: I don't know. The monks used to say that hope was just a distraction, so maybe we do need to abandon it.

speaker: Katara
text: What are you talking about?

speaker: Aang
text: Hope is not going to get us into Ba Sing Se and it's not going to help find Appa. We need to focus on what we're doing right now and that's getting across this path.

speaker: Katara
text: Okay, if you say so.
Within the pass.

speaker: Suki
text: The Fire Nation controls the western lake. Rumor has it they're working on something big on the other side of it and don't want anyone to find out what it is.
They all pass by a sailing Fire Nation ship. A part of the rock gives out, causing Than to fall. Toph stops it from falling and lifts him back up with earthbending.

speaker: Than
text: I'm okay! [The rock falls to the water, which the Fire Nation ship notices. It fires.]

speaker: Sokka
text: They've spotted us! Let's go, let's go!

Aang gets on his glider and deflects the fireball back. Another fireball hits the mountain, causing several pieces of rock over Suki to fall. Sokka pushes her out of the way. Toph bends out a part of the mountain to keep the rocks from falling on Sokka.

speaker: Sokka
text: Suki, are you okay? You have to be more careful! Come on!

speaker: Toph
text: [Pretending to be Sokka.] "Thanks for saving my life, Toph." Hey, no problem, Sokka.
Hours later, at sunset, the travelers set up their camp. Sokka approaches Suki.

speaker: Sokka
text: Suki, you shouldn't sleep there. Who knows how stable this ledge is, it could give away at any moment! [Moves her sleeping bag.]

speaker: Suki
text: Sokka, I'm fine, stop worrying!

speaker: Sokka
text: You're right, you're right, you're perfectly capable of taking care of yourself! Wait! Oh, never mind, I thought I saw a spider, but, you're fine.
Back on the ferry. Zuko, Jet, and Smellerbee sneak up to the food storage area. Jet breaks the door open with his twin tiger hook swords, and he and Zuko take some food.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Guard's coming!

Longshot fires an arrow with a rope attached to it, allowing the three to slide down it. Longshot pulls it away before the guard notices. Back at the pass, Aang is standing at the edge of the rock, looking out at the ocean, blankly. Katara approaches him.

speaker: Katara
text: You know, it's okay to miss Appa. [Aang remains silent.] What's going on with you? In the desert, all you cared about was finding Appa and now it's like you don't care about him at all.

speaker: Aang
text: You saw what I did out there. I was so angry about losing Appa that I couldn't control myself. I hated feeling like that.

speaker: Katara
text: But now you're not letting yourself feel anything. I know sometimes it hurts more to hope and it hurts more to care. But you have to promise me that you won't stop caring. [ Holds out her arms.] Come on, you need a hug.

speaker: Aang
text: [Bows before her.] Thank you for your concern, Katara. [Exits.]

Katara shows visible concern.

In another part of the Pass, Sokka stands by himself, until Suki approaches.

speaker: Suki
text: It's a beautiful moon.

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah, it really is.

speaker: Suki
text: Look, I know you're just trying to help, but I can take care of myself.

speaker: Sokka
text: I know you can.

speaker: Suki
text: Then why are you acting so overprotective?

speaker: Sokka
text: It's so hard to lose someone you care about. Something happened at the North Pole and I couldn't protect someone. I don't want anything like that to ever happen again.

speaker: Suki
text: I lost someone I care about. He didn't die, he just went away. I only had a few days to get to know him, but he was smart and brave and funny ...

speaker: Sokka
text: [Jealous.] Who is this guy? Is he taller than me?

speaker: Suki
text: No, he's about your height.

speaker: Sokka
text: Is he better-looking?

speaker: Suki
text: It is you, stupid!

speaker: Sokka
text: Oh!
The two prepare to kiss, but Sokka pulls back at the last moment.

speaker: Sokka
text: I can't.

speaker: Suki
text: I'm sorry.

speaker: Sokka
text: No, you shouldn't be. [Exits.]
Back on the ferry. Jet passes out food to other travelers. The other Freedom Fighters, Zuko, and Iroh sit together.

speaker: Iroh
text: So, Smellerbee. That's an unusual name for a young man.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Maybe it's because I'm not a man ... I'm a girl! [Walks away.]

speaker: Iroh
text: [Calling out to her.] Oh, now I see. It's a beautiful name for a lovely girl!
Longshot approaches Smellerbee and gestures at her.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: I know, you're right. As long as I'm confident with who I am, it doesn't matter what other people think. Thanks, Longshot.
Longshot nods at her. Jet approaches Zuko and Iroh.

speaker: Jet
text: From what I heard, people eat like this every night in Ba Sing Se. I can't wait to set my eyes on that giant wall.

speaker: Iroh
text: It is a magnificent sight.

speaker: Jet
text: So you've been there before?

speaker: Iroh
text: Once. When I was a ... different man.

speaker: Jet
text: I've done some things in my past that I'm not proud of, but that's why I'm going to Ba Sing Se: for a new beginning. A second chance.

speaker: Iroh
text: That's very noble of you. I believe people can change their lives if they want to. I believe in second chances.
Back at the Serpent's Pass. The travelers notice that a section of the pass is below the sea level, and not able to be navigated.

speaker: Katara
text: Everyone single file! [She divides the water, allowing everyone to walk through the drowned out path.] Aang, I need help! [Aang helps by creating an air bubble.]
Momo's curiosity is aroused by the fish. He dives in the water, only to return back when he sees a large shadow. The rest of them notice.

speaker: Katara
text: What is that thing?

The shadow breaks through the water, breaking the divide. Toph quickly uses her earthbending to raise the ground they are standing on above the water. The shadow is actually a large serpent, which appears from the water with a shriek.

speaker: Sokka
text: I think I just figured out why they call it the Serpent's Pass! Suki, you know about giant sea monsters, make it go away!

speaker: Suki
text: Just because I live near the unagi doesn't mean I'm an expert!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Holds up Momo.] Oh great and powerful sea serpent, please accept this humble and tasty offering. Thank you.

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka!

speaker: Aang
text: [Blasts the Serpent back with a burst of air.] I'll distract it. Katara, get everyone across! [Takes off on his glider.]
Katara freezes the water to create an ice trail. Everyone except for Toph crosses. Katara tries to ice up the serpent, but it fails.

speaker: Sokka
text: Toph, come on, it's just ice!

speaker: Toph
text: [Feels the ice but her sense of sight is restricted.] Actually, I'm going to stay on my little island, where I can see! [The serpent takes out half the island.] Okay, I'm coming! [Slowly crosses the ice.]

speaker: Sokka
text: You're doing great! Just follow the sound of my voice!

speaker: Toph
text: It's hard to ignore.

speaker: Sokka
text: You're almost there!
The serpent slams down the ice trail, dropping Toph into a struggle to stay above water.

speaker: Toph
text: Help! I can't swim!

speaker: Sokka
text: I'm coming, Toph!
Before he can do anything, Suki jumps in for the save.

speaker: Toph
text: Help!
Toph falls below the water, but Suki pulls her up before she drowns.

speaker: Toph
text: [Thinking it is Sokka.] Oh Sokka, you saved me! [Kisses Suki on the cheek.]

speaker: Suki
text: Actually, it's me.

speaker: Toph
text: Oh ... well ... [Chuckles. Embarrassed.] you can go ahead and let me drown now.

Meanwhile, the serpent is caught in a whirlpool created by Aang and Katara. The force of it slams the serpent into the mountain, causing it to fall back below water. Upon seeing the two return, the rest of the travelers cheer. Moments later, near Ba Sing Se's wall.

speaker: Sokka
text: There's the wall! Now it's nothing but smooth sailing to Ba Sing Se.

speaker: Ying
text: [Groans in pain.] Oh no!

speaker: Sokka
text: What's wrong?

speaker: Ying
text: The baby's coming!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Panicked.] What? Now? Can't you hold it in or something?

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka, calm down. I helped Gran-Gran deliver lots of babies back home.

speaker: Sokka
text: This isn't the same as delivering an arctic seal! This is a real ... human ... thing!

speaker: Katara
text: It's called a baby and I helped her deliver plenty of those, too. Aang, get some rags. Sokka, water. Toph, I need you to make an earth tent, a big one. [Toph earthbends the rock to form a tent.] Suki, come with me.
Back on the ferry. Jet approaches Zuko.

speaker: Jet
text: You know, as soon as I saw your scar, I knew exactly who you were. You're an outcast, like me. And us outcasts have to stick together. We have to watch each other's backs. Because no one else will.

speaker: Zuko
text: I've realized lately that being on your own isn't always the best path.

The ferry closes in on the walls. 
Back at the pass. Ying is breathing heavily as the baby delivery continues.

speaker: Katara
text: You're doing great, Ying. Sokka, where's that water? Now get ready to push. One ... two ... [Sokka enters.] ... three, push!
Ying groans; Sokka passes out. Moments later, the baby arrives and begins to cry. Aang, Toph, and Sokka are all outside the tent.

speaker: Katara
text: [From inside the tent.] It's a girl!

speaker: Toph
text: So, you want to go see the baby, or are you going to faint like an old lady again?

speaker: Sokka
text: No, no, I'm good this time. [Toph and Sokka enter the tent.]

speaker: Katara
text: Aang, you have to come see this.
Aang enters to see the new life.

speaker: Toph
text: She sounds healthy.

speaker: Katara
text: She's beautiful.

speaker: Sokka
text: It's so ... squishy looking.
Aang begins to smile.

speaker: Than
text: What should we name her?

speaker: Ying
text: I want our daughter's name to be unique. I want it to mean something.

speaker: Aang
text: [Sheds some tears.] I've been going through a really hard time lately. But you've made me ... hopeful again.

speaker: Ying
text: I know what I want to name our baby now. Hope.

speaker: Than
text: That's a perfect name. Hope.
Outside the tent. Aang meets with Katara. Suki, Sokka, and Toph stand next to the tent.

speaker: Aang
text: I thought I was trying to be strong. But really I was just running away from my feelings. Seeing this family together, so full of happiness and love, it's reminded me how I feel about Appa ... and how I feel about you.
Katara sheds some tears. Aang and Katara embrace, Katara's eyes still watering. The other three approach.

speaker: Aang
text: I promise, I'll find Appa as fast as I can. I just really need to do this.

speaker: Sokka
text: See you in the big city.

speaker: Toph
text: Say hi to that big fuzzball for me. [Punches Aang in the arm.]

speaker: Katara
text: You'll find him, Aang.

speaker: Aang
text: I know. Thank you, Katara. You ready, Momo? [Aang and Momo fly off. The rest wave goodbye.]
Suki approaches Sokka.

speaker: Suki
text: Sokka, it's been really great to see you again.

speaker: Sokka
text: Whoa, hold on. Why does it sound like you're saying goodbye?

speaker: Suki
text: I came along because I wanted to make sure you got through the Serpent's Pass safely. But now I need to get back to the other Kyoshi Warriors.

speaker: Sokka
text: So you came along to protect me?

speaker: Suki
text: Listen, I'm really sorry about last night. We were talking ... and saying things ... and I just got carried away and before I knew it -

speaker: Sokka
text: [Kisses Suki.] You talk too much.
The two share a deep kiss. Aang and Momo fly to the top of the Outer Wall of Ba Sing Se. However, Aang quickly notices a large drill with a Fire Nation insignia, heading for the wall.

speaker: Aang
text: Sorry Momo, Appa's going to have to wait.
Fade to credits.

The episode opens where several Fire Nation tanks rumble across the terrain, a large metal mechanism following close behind. The camera zooms out to a shot of the Fire Nation drill slowly moving its way toward the Outer Wall of Ba Sing Se. Several sections of the drill extend forward, releasing steam as spikes are driven into the ground. The drill's command module ascends where inside are Princess Azula, her friends, Mai and Ty Lee, War Minister Qin and several operators of the drill.

speaker: Qin
text: This drill is a feat of scientific ingenuity and raw destructive power. Once it tunnels through the wall, our troops will storm their city. The Earth Kingdom will finally fall, and you can claim Ba Sing Se in the name of your father. Nothing can stop us.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: [Looking through the telescope.] Hmmm, what about those muscle-y guys down there?
She peers through a periscope at several Earth Kingdom troops using earthbending to create large trenches, Fire Nation forces following them in hot pursuit.

speaker: Qin
text: [Strikes the periscope roughly alarming Ty Lee.] Please. The drill's metal shell is impervious to any earthbending attack.

speaker: Azula
text: Oh, I'm sure it is, War Minister Qin, but just to be on the safe side ... [Sharply while looking at the two girls.] Mai and Ty Lee, take the earthbenders out!

speaker: Mai
text: [Swinging a knife around her finger; relieved.] Finally, something to do. [Rises and walks out.]
The scene changes to where Katara, Sokka and Toph are escorting Than and his family to the city. Aang appears, flying in on his glider with Momo behind him. He lands, Momo perched on his shoulder.

speaker: Katara
text: [Surprised.] Aang, what are you doing here? I thought you were looking for Appa.

speaker: Aang
text: I was, but something stopped me. Something big.
The scene switches to the base of the Outer Wall where Aang and Toph use earthbending to transport everyone up the wall.

speaker: Sokka
text: Now what's so big that Appa has to wait?

speaker: Aang
text: [Camera zooms out to drill.] That.
The group arrives at the top of the Outer Wall.

speaker: Ying
text: [Despairingly.] We made it to Ba Sing Se and we're still not safe. No one is! [Huddles with family members.]

speaker: Earthbender guard
text: What are you people doing here? Civilians aren't allowed on the wall!

speaker: Aang
text: I'm the Avatar. Take me to whoever is in charge.
The scene changes to a portion of the Outer Wall where a roof rises overhead, supported by tall arches. An Earth Kingdom general sits behind a desk.

speaker: General Sung
text: [Happily.] It is an honor to welcome you to the Outer Wall, young Avatar, but your help is not needed.

speaker: Aang
text: Not needed?

speaker: General Sung
text: [Calmly.] Not needed. I have the situation under control. I assure you the Fire Nation cannot penetrate this wall. Many have tried to break through it, but none have succeeded.

speaker: Toph
text: What about the Dragon of the West? He got in.

speaker: General Sung
text: [Slightly taken aback.] Well ... uh, technically yes, but he was quickly expunged. [Confidently.] Nevertheless, that is why the city is named Ba Sing Se. It's the "impenetrable city". They don't call it Na Sing Se. [Laughs, but subsequently turns serious.] That means "penetrable city."

speaker: Toph
text: Yeah, thanks for the tour, but we still got the drill problem.

speaker: General Sung
text: Not for long. To stop it, I've sent an elite platoon of earthbenders called the Terra Team.

speaker: Sokka
text: That's a good group name. Very catchy.
The scene cuts to where the Terra Team is launching their assault on the Fire Nation drill. They manage to overthrow one tank and get closer to the drill.

speaker: Terra Team leader
text: Ready ... attack!

The earthbenders wedge large earth spikes into the metal shell of the drill to halt it. However, the drill's segments separate, reducing the columns to crumbles. The Terra Team narrowly manages to conjure earth shields to defend themselves against an assault of flying daggers hurled by Mai. She and Ty Lee are seen sliding down the shell of the drill. The scene cuts to the side of the drill where Ty Lee lands gracefully onto the ground. She effortlessly manages to defeat the earthbenders through an acrobatic display, utilizing chi-blocking.

speaker: General Sung
text: [Upon witnessing the defeat of the Terra Team.] We're doomed! [Flails arms in panic.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Slaps him across the face.] Get a hold of yourself, man!

speaker: General Sung
text: [Rubbing cheek.] You're right. I'm sorry.

speaker: Toph
text: Maybe you'd like the Avatar's help now?

speaker: General Sung
text: [Meekly stands before the Avatar. Humbly.] Yes, please.
The scene changes to where Aang and the rest are overlooking the wall at the drill.

speaker: Aang
text: The question is, how are we going to stop that thing? [All turn their heads to Sokka.]

speaker: Sokka
text: Why are you all looking at me?

speaker: Aang
text: You're the idea guy.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Complaining.] So I'm the only one who can ever come up with a plan? That's a lot of pressure.

speaker: Katara
text: And also the complaining guy.

speaker: Sokka
text: That part I don't mind.
The scene changes to where a ticket woman is inspecting Zuko and Iroh's tickets.

speaker: Ticket woman
text: So, Mr. Lee and Mr. ummm ... Mushy, is it?

speaker: Iroh
text: It's pronounced Mushi.

speaker: Ticket woman
text: [Annoyed.] You telling me how to do my job?

speaker: Iroh
text: [Approaches the ticket booth.] Uh, no, no. But may I just say you're like a flower in bloom. Your beauty is intoxicating.

speaker: Ticket woman
text: [Flirtatiously.] You're pretty easy on the eyes yourself, handsome. Raorr! Welcome to Ba Sing Se. [Stamps their tickets.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [Disgusted.] I'm going to forget I saw that. [Grabs ticket and walks away.]
Camera changes to view of Jet, overlooking Zuko, now under the adopted alias, Lee.

speaker: Jet
text: I think Lee would make a good Freedom Fighter. He's just trying to find his way in the world, like us.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: You don't know anything about him, Jet.

speaker: Jet
text: I know he didn't get that scar from a waterbender.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Besides, I thought we were going straight now.

speaker: Jet
text: We are, and the new Freedom Fighters could use a guy like Lee. What do you think, Longshot?
Longshot looks over at him silently with a meaningful look on his face and blinks his eyes.

speaker: Jet
text: I can respect that.
Meanwhile, back at the Outer Wall, Katara attempts to heal a member of the Terra Team.

speaker: General Sung
text: What's wrong with him? He doesn't look injured.

speaker: Katara
text: His chi is blocked. [Stops healing.] Who did this to you?

speaker: Terra Team member
text: Two girls ambushed us. One of them hit me with a bunch of quick jabs and suddenly I couldn't earthbend anymore and I could barely move. Then she cartwheeled away.

speaker: Katara
text: [Eyes widen in realization.] Ty Lee. She doesn't look dangerous, but she knows the human body and its weak points. It's like she takes you down from the inside.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Excitedly.] Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh! Ooh!

speaker: Katara
text: Yes?

speaker: Sokka
text: What you just said! That's how we're going to take down the drill! The same way Ty Lee took down all those big earthbenders!

speaker: Toph
text: By hitting its pressure points!

speaker: Aang
text: [Looking out over the wall with a determined look.] We'll take it down from the inside.
The scene cuts to the Fire Nation drill. The camera pans to where Aang, Katara, Sokka and Toph are crouching together in one of the abandoned trenches of the Terra Team.

speaker: Toph
text: [Gesturing toward the drill.] Once I whip up some cover, you're not going to be able to see. So, stay close to me.
She steps outside the trench and with a powerful stomp of her foot, sending a mass of flying debris clouding toward the drill.

speaker: Toph
text: Run!
The group races into the dust cloud behind Toph. The scene cuts to the command module where Ty Lee is peering at the cloud through the periscope.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: Hey, look at that dust cloud. [Periscope view shows front of drill and billowing cloud.] It's so ... poofy. [Cut back to Ty Lee who looks away from the periscope with a spaced-out expression.] Poof.

speaker: Qin
text: Don't worry, Princess. I'm sure it's nothing. [Azula casts a doubtful look.]
The scene changes to outside where the group is standing in the midst of the dust beside the drill. Toph earthbends a hole into the ground.

speaker: Toph
text: Everyone into the hole!
She and the others jump into the hole and the ground above them closes shut. The camera pans to underground where it is pitch black.

speaker: Sokka
text: It's so dark down here, I can't see a thing!

speaker: Toph
text: [Sarcastically.] Oh no, what a nightmare!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Sheepishly.] Sorry.
They make their way to the surface underneath the drill, where Sokka spots an opening.

speaker: Sokka
text: There!

Aang leaps up to the bar hanging from the opening and, dangling upside-down from his legs, hoists himself and Katara into the drill. He realizes Toph is not following them. Sokka sticks his head out of the drill.

speaker: Sokka
text: Toph, come on!

speaker: Toph
text: No way am I going in that metal monster. I can't bend in there. I'll try to slow it down out here.

speaker: Sokka
text: Okay, good luck! [He and Aang disappear into the drill.]

Toph earthbends a wedge of rock into the drill, however, it is proving to be a difficult task as it pushes her back. The scene changes to inside the drill where Sokka is leading the others through a tunnel of valves and pipes.

speaker: Sokka
text: I need a plan of this machine. Some schematics that show what the inside looks like. Then we can find its weak points.

speaker: Aang
text: Where are we going to get something like that? [Sokka unexpectedly cuts off a steam valve with his machete.] What are you doing? Someone's going to hear us!

speaker: Sokka
text: That's the point. I figure a machine this big needs engineers to run it. And when something breaks ...

speaker: Katara
text: They come to fix it!
Aang and Katara smile at each other. Moments later, an engineer wearing a mask is seen walking down the misty hallway to the site of the damage.

speaker: Katara
text: [Appears behind him.] Hi.
She freezes the mist, covering the engineer in a thin layer of ice. Sokka runs up to the frozen engineer and takes his schematics.

speaker: Sokka
text: This'll work. Thanks!
The trio runs off, leaving the helpless engineer who drops his spear unintentionally. The scene changes to where Sokka and the others are studying the plans.

speaker: Sokka
text: It looks like the drill is made up of two main structures. There's the inner mechanism where we are now and the outer shell. The inner part and the outer part are connected by these braces. If we cut through them, the entire thing will collapse.

Aang and Katara nod in agreement. The scene changes to the train station where Zuko, Iroh and the three Freedom Fighters are awaiting their train. The camera focuses on Zuko and Iroh, who sit in the waiting area. Jet approaches and sits next to Zuko.

speaker: Jet
text: So, you guys got plans once you're inside the city?

speaker: Tea seller
text: Get your hot tea here! Finest tea in Ba Sing Se!

speaker: Iroh
text: [Waves hand.] Ooh! Jasmine please.
The tea seller pours tea into a leaf cup for Iroh. Iroh sips the tea, but soon grimaces at its repulsive taste.

speaker: Iroh
text: Blaugh! Ugh, coldest tea in Ba Sing Se is more like it! What a disgrace!

speaker: Jet
text: Hey, can I talk to you for a second?
He motions for Zuko to follow him. Zuko sighs and reluctantly rises. The two walk several feet away from Iroh's spot.

speaker: Jet
text: You and I have a much better chance of making it in the city if we stick together. You want to join the Freedom Fighters?

speaker: Zuko
text: Thanks, but I don't think you want me in your gang.

speaker: Jet
text: Come on, we made a great team looting that captain's food. Think of all the good we could do for these refugees.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Walking away.] I said no.

speaker: Jet
text: Have it your way.

He catches sight of Iroh, who is sipping his now steaming hot tea, causing his eyes to widen in shock and realization. Zuko, approaching Iroh, glances over his shoulder at Jet, who narrows his eyes and walks away. Angrily, he knocks the tea cup out of Iroh's hand.

speaker: Iroh
text: Hey!

speaker: Zuko
text: [Gritting in a whisper.] What are you doing firebending your tea? For a wise, old man, that was a pretty stupid move!

speaker: Iroh
text: [Mourning.] I know you're not supposed to cry over spilled tea, but ... [Sniffs. The cup is shown overturned in a puddle.] it's just so sad!
The scene switches to the interior of the drill where Sokka is leading the others through a door onto a massive steel beam.

speaker: Sokka
text: Wow, it looks a lot thicker in person than it does in the plans. We're going to have to work pretty hard to cut through that.

speaker: Katara
text: [Crosses her arms.] What's this "we" stuff? Aang and I are going to have to do all the work.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Turns and gestures to self.] Look, I'm the plan guy. You two [Makes rapid chop-chop gestures.] are the cut stuff up with waterbending guys. [Strikes a heroic pose.] Together, we're Team Avatar!

Katara and Aang shoot each other awkward looks. The scene cuts to one where the two are positioned on either side of one brace. Using waterbending, they slice through the metal sharply. The shot changes to when the brace is sliced halfway through. Both Katara and Aang are bent over and gasping in exhaustion.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Pumping arms in the air.] C'mon team. Don't quit now. [Katara grinds her teeth as she seethes with rage.] We're ...

speaker: Katara
text: [Explodes with frustration.] Grrr!
Katara shoots a menacing glare while pulling out her water whip and threatening to strike him with it. Cut to Sokka, who stands wide-eyed, arms still in air.

speaker: Sokka
text: I mean, [Recovers and points reassuringly.] you're almost there.

The two resume work slicing the brace. With every lash of the water whip, the cut through the brace enlarges and Sokka grows more and more eager. At last, a cut is made clean through the brace, however, to their disappointment, the brace budges mere inches from its position.

speaker: Katara
text: [Panting in exhaustion.] At this rate, we won't do enough damage before the drill reaches the wall.

speaker: Aang
text: I don't know how many more of those I have in me.
The drill suddenly creaks.

speaker: Sokka
text: Do you hear that? We took it down! We better get out of here fast!
The trio run for the door, only to halt upon hearing an announcement being made through overhead speaking tubes.

speaker: Qin
text: Congratulations, crew. The drill has made contact with the wall of Ba Sing Se. [Cuts to him standing in the command module.] Start the countdown to victory!

Cheers erupt from the crew. The camera cuts to Azula, a threatening look of determination on her face. Aang, Katara and Sokka look at each other in shock and dismay. The camera cuts to a scene of the drill hammering through the wall, sending loose boulders in every direction. The scene changes to one of a stream of a saturated rock and water solution traveling through tubes and making its way through the back entrance of the drill. Cuts to Sokka, who is desperately attempting to move the brace.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Pushing against brace.] C'mon brace ... budge! [Makes several more attempts to move it.]

speaker: Katara
text: This is bad, really bad.

speaker: Sokka
text: We're putting everything we've got into busting these braces, but it's taking too long!

speaker: Aang
text: [Struck with realization.] Maybe we don't need to cut all the way through. Toph has been teaching me that you shouldn't give one hundred percent of your energy into any one strike. [Rises.] Sokka, take a fighting stance. You've got to be quick and accurate. Hit a series of points and break your opponent's stance. [Strikes Sokka several times.] And when he's reeling back, you deliver the final blow. [Hits him softly on the head.] His own weight becomes his downfall, literally.
As Aang is speaking, Sokka kneels over.

speaker: Katara
text: So we just need to weaken the braces, instead of cutting all the way through.

speaker: Aang
text: Then I'll go to the top of this thing and deliver the final blow.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Rising.] And boom! It all comes crashing down!

speaker: Aang
text: Everyone inside that wall. The whole world is counting on us.

speaker: Sokka
text: The whole world minus the Fire Nation that is.

Sokka grins, while the other two simply stare at each other exasperated. The scene cuts to Toph under the drill, putting all her strength into keeping the rock column stable as she is slowly pushed back by the force of the drill.

speaker: Toph
text: [Straining as the drill continues to push her back.] C'mon, Twinkle Toes, hurry up!
The scene changes to where Aang and Katara are making rapid progress, slicing through several braces halfway to weaken them.

speaker: Aang
text: That's enough! We need to get to the next one!

The scene changes to outside the drill, where earthbenders are sending boulders down at the drill from the wall. The scene changes to the command module where the War Minister receives shocking news from engineers communicating through speaking tubes.

speaker: Engineer
text: War Minister, an engineer was ambushed! His schematics were stolen!
Qin is clearly surprised while Azula narrows her eyes in suspicion.

speaker: Second Engineer
text: War Minister, a brace on the starboard side has been cut clean through! It's sabotage, sir!

speaker: Azula
text: [Sharply.] Let's go, ladies!
The scene changes to where the trio continues to slice through the braces.

speaker: Sokka
text: Good work, Team Avatar! Now Aang just needs to ... [Glances up in horror.] duck!
He ducks just in time to evade the blue fire blast sent his way by Azula, who runs out and stands on another brace followed by her friends.

speaker: Aang
text: [Barely misses another fire blast.] Whoa!

speaker: Ty Lee
text: Wow, Azula, you were right! It is the Avatar! [Cut to a close-up of Ty Lee; she smiles flirtatiously at Sokka.] ... and friends.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Smiles and waves.] Hey.

Katara approaches her brother and drags him away, clearly annoyed. Ty Lee swings herself forward toward Aang who quickly airbends her away. The trio escape the scene and race through the drill's hallways. They come to an intersection.

speaker: Aang
text: Guys, get out of here. I know what I need to do.

speaker: Katara
text: Wait. [Throws him her water skin.] You need this water more than I do!
Aang catches the water skin and starts running again. Azula and her team reach the intersection.

speaker: Azula
text: Follow them! The Avatar's mine!
Mai and Ty Lee begin chasing Katara and Sokka while Azula chases after Aang. Meanwhile, the two siblings have arrived at the end of the hallway where there is a closed hatch.

speaker: Katara
text: [Reads a sign nearby, while Sokka struggles to open the hatch.] Slurry pipeline? What does that mean?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Having successfully opened hatch which leads to a canal channeling slurry.] It's rock and water mixed together. It means our way out!

The two begin descending into the pipe when Mai and Ty Lee arrive. They manage to escape into the canal just as a flurry of daggers is sent their way. The camera cuts to a shot of them floating through the slurry. Mai and Ty Lee run over and peer into the pipeline.

speaker: Mai
text: [Holds her hands over the slurry.] Ugh, disgusting!

speaker: Ty Lee
text: C'mon! You heard Azula. We have to follow them!

speaker: Mai
text: She can shoot all the lightning she wants at me. I am not going in that wall sludge juice. [Shivers in disgust.]

Ty Lee shrugs and leaps through the pipeline into the slurry. Mai shudders with a final expression of disgust and closes the hatch. The scene cuts to where Aang races past several engineers through the drill. The camera cuts to the rear of the drill where a flood of slurry is continually being released. Katara and Sokka slide through the slurry onto the ground with Ty Lee following them in hot pursuit. Katara uses waterbending to stop the flow of slurry and plug up the back entrance of the drill, thus trapping Ty Lee.

speaker: Katara
text: [Hatefully and tauntingly.] Why don't you try blocking my chi now, circus freak?

speaker: Sokka
text: Katara, keep that up. The pressure will build up in the drill. Then when Aang delivers the final blow, it'll be ready to pop!
The scene changes to where Aang and Momo have made their way to the top of the drill.

speaker: Aang
text: [Halting.] This looks like a good spot, Momo. [Looks up to find boulders being hurtled down the wall, nearly crushing him. Yelling.] General Sung, tell your soldiers to stop shooting rocks down here!

speaker: General Sung
text: [Frantically.] Soldiers, whatever you do, don't stop shooting rocks down there!

The soldiers nod and launch another round of rocks toward the drill. Aang leaps out of the way of the oncoming boulders and begins slicing at the hull of the metal using water from Katara's water skin. The scene changes to where Katara continues to hold Ty Lee captive in the slurry.

speaker: Sokka
text: Good technique, little sister! Keep it up! Don't forget to breathe!

speaker: Katara
text: [Irritated.] You know, I'm just about sick and tired of you telling me what to do all day! You're like a chattering hog-monkey!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Screaming.] Just bend the slurry, woman!
Frustrated, Katara bends a wave of slurry into her brother with her free hand, knocking him down into the foul muck.

speaker: Toph
text: [Approaching Katara.] You guys need some help?

speaker: Katara
text: Toph, help me plug up this drain.

The two cooperate with each other to bend the slurry, sending Ty Lee farther into the drill and causing the pipes to begin to expand under the pressure. The scene cuts to where Aang continues to slice the metal of the drill.

speaker: Aang
text: [Exhausted.] What I'd give to be a metalbender.
Momo suddenly shrieks and Aang deflects a blue fire blast just in time.

speaker: Aang
text: [Assuming a fighting stance.] Momo, get out of here!

Azula appears before the Avatar and a battle ensues between the two. Azula shoots fire blasts at Aang, who manages to block them using airbending. She continues the fire attacks only to have each one of her strikes deterred by water whips. She eventually manages to vaporize the water, sending Aang back. The two narrowly dodge the several boulders that are hurtled toward them at that moment. Aang uses earthbending and airbending to send rocks at Azula, who manages to avoid them all. Azula sends another powerful firebending assault that slams Aang into the Outer Wall of Ba Sing Se, leaving him unconscious.

The camera view briefly changes to where the front of the drill is seen having completely dug its way through the Outer Wall. Camera changes to Azula as she walks over to him with fire in her right hand, preparing to deal a deadly final strike, but Aang awakens and sends her skidding back using an earthbending gauntlet. A flood of slurry is released as the drill bores deeper into the wall, coating the two. Azula slides toward a helpless Aang, attempting to halt herself by windmilling only to collide with him. The force of the collision sends both sliding off opposite sides of the drill. Azula is able to stop her descent by grinding her feet into the drill's side while Momo drags Aang up to the top with the help of Aang's airbending.

speaker: Aang
text: Thanks, Momo. I owe you one. [Runs over to the wedge he sliced in the drill.] Now all I need ... [A boulder falls before him.] Actually, that is what I need for once.

He uses airbending to position the boulder over the X mark in the drill. Using earthbending, he cuts the rock several times, creating a wedge that fits inside the middle of the hole. He begins sprinting toward the wall, scales up its side by riding an air scooter and, once he arrives at his highest point, rockets at lightning speed toward the bottom. As he propels himself downward, Azula catches sight of him and fires at him. She misses by mere seconds and is sent back forcefully as Aang leaps and slams down on the wedge, creating a large ripple effect. The impact of the blow causes the sliced braces inside the drill to collapse and the pipes to burst, releasing a torrent of slurry. Slurry begins to seep from the drill. The scene cuts to Katara and Toph, who remain in their bending stances.

speaker: Sokka
text: Woohoo!

speaker: Toph
text: Here it comes!

She earthbends Katara, Sokka, and herself onto a rock pillar to avoid the flood of slurry. Slurry gushes from the rear of the drill, and Ty Lee slams into the wall of the rock pillar as she is forcefully pushed forward by the flood. The drill begins to release steam and its segments begin to collapse. On the other side of the wall, the drill is seen coming to a halt.

The camera zooms out on the destroyed drill. The scene cuts to Aang covered in slurry, Momo licking him as he wipes it away near his face, a huge smile spread across his face. Cut to War Minister Qin, who stares at the slurry from inside the command module, completely shocked. Cuts to General Sung atop the Outer Wall, covered in the muck. Cuts to Ty Lee as she attempts to clear away the mess. Cut to shot of Azula, skidding down the drill also covered in slurry. She lands by Ty Lee, causing the acrobat to be covered in slurry once again. A hatch opens, revealing Mai, who is completely clean.

speaker: Mai
text: [Dryly.] We lost.
The scene changes to the train station.

speaker: Train conductor
text: Last call for Ba Sing Se!
Scene shifts to Jet, who is storming toward the train, Longshot and Smellerbee following close behind.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Jet, relax. So the old guy had some hot tea. Big deal.

speaker: Jet
text: He heated it himself! [Darkly.] Those guys are firebenders!
Iroh and Zuko board the train, Jet and his groups eying them. Iroh and Zuko seat themselves next to Than and his family. Iroh notices Hope.

speaker: Iroh
text: What a handsome baby. [Strokes the infant.]

speaker: Ying
text: Thank you.

Camera closes up on Hope, who is sleeping. Scene cuts to outside where two earthbenders begin moving the train out of the station. Scene changes to Team Avatar standing at the top of the wall, overlooking the sunset.

speaker: Sokka
text: I just want to say, good effort out there today, Team Avatar!

speaker: Katara
text: [Unamused.] Enough with the Team Avatar stuff. No matter how many times you say it, it's not going to catch on.

speaker: Sokka
text: How about ... [Pulls out boomerang.] the Boomeraang Squad! See it's good because it's got "Aang" in it. Boomeraang.

speaker: Aang
text: [Grins.] I kind of like that one.

speaker: Katara
text: [Begins walking away.] Let's talk about this on our way into the city.

speaker: Sokka
text: The Aang Gang?

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka ...

speaker: Sokka
text: The Fearsome Foursome?

speaker: Toph
text: [Also walking away.] You're crazy.

speaker: Sokka
text: Why? We're fearsome!
He runs after them.
Fades to credits.

The episode opens to two fox antelopes, grazing on a hill side. They look up at the monorail tracks behind them as a monorail goes past, pushed by two earthbenders. Cut to inside the car where Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph, and Momo are awaiting their arrival at Ba Sing Se. Katara looks out from the window and notices the Inner Wall of the Earth Kingdom capital drawing closer.

speaker: Katara
text: [Excitedly.] Look, the Inner Wall! [Cut to a shot of the monorail approaching the wall. Cut back inside monorail.] I can't believe we finally made it to Ba Sing Se in one piece.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Slightly skeptically.] Hey, don't jinx it! We can still be attacked by some giant exploding Fire Nation spoon. Or find out the city's been submerged in an ocean full of killer shrimp!

speaker: Toph
text: [Slightly annoyed, yet still jokingly.] You been hitting the cactus juice again?

speaker: Sokka
text: I'm just sayin', weird stuff happens to us.
A man, sucking a corn plant in his mouth, takes a seat between Toph and Sokka, startling them. The scene changes to Aang and Katara looking out the windows, the former closing his eyes sadly.

speaker: Katara
text: [Sympathetically.] Don't worry Aang, we'll find Appa.

speaker: Aang
text: [Doubtfully.] It's such a big city.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Somewhat optimistically.] He's a giant bison! Where could someone possibly hide him?
The scene shows the monorail entering the Inner Wall. Cut to Sokka, Katara, and Aang viewing the giant city through the windows.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Realizing the city's gigantic size.] Oh.
The three notice that Ba Sing Se stretches almost as far as their eyes can see, and it has many roads and buildings. Their train enters the monorail station, stopping there. All of them disembark.

speaker: Toph
text: [Sighs.] Back in the city. Great.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Excitedly.] What's the problem? It's amazing!

speaker: Toph
text: [Shot shows Sokka and Toph with Momo resting on her shoulder.] It's just a bunch of walls and rules. You wait, you'll get sick of it in a couple of days.
Scene changes to Aang looking at the bison whistle in his palm, and he blows it.

speaker: Aang
text: I'm comin' for ya, buddy. [Katara walks over to the downtrodden Aang, and places her hand on his shoulder. More confidently.] He's here; I can feel it.

The shot changes to the monorail departing, behind the team. Cut to the other side of the track, where there is a woman with long dark hair that billows in the wind. She approaches them with a strange smile on her face.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Excited.] Hello, my name is Joo Dee! I have been given the great honor of showing the Avatar around Ba Sing Se. And you must be Sokka, Katara, and Toph! Welcome to our wonderful city. Shall we get started?

speaker: Sokka
text: Yes. We have information about the Fire Nation army that we need to deliver to the Earth King, immediately.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: Great! Let's begin our tour. And then I'll show you to your new home here. I think you'll like it!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Slightly annoyed.] Ugh! [Walks up to Joo Dee.] Maybe you missed what I said. We need to talk to the king about the War, it's important.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up on Joo Dee's face.] You're in Ba Sing Se now. Everyone is safe here.

Team Avatar has a confused look on their faces regarding Joo Dee's strange statement. Cut to an overhead shot of the area of the city near the wall. An ostrich horse pulls a carriage through the streets. Many shops and refugees line the streets. Cut to a shot of the inside of the carriage containing Joo Dee and Team Avatar.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: This is the Lower Ring.

speaker: Katara
text: What's that wall for?

speaker: Joo Dee
text: Oh, Ba Sing Se has many walls! There are the ones outside protecting us, and the ones inside, that help maintain order. [Shot changes to outside the carriage as the camera pans across some refugees.] This is where our newest arrivals live, as well as our craftsman and artisans, people that work with their hands. [Shot changes back to inside the carriage.] It's so quaint and lively!

Cut to a shot of two men conversing in an alley. One of them is holding a large sword that glistens in the light. Both glare at the carriage as it passes. Cut back to the carriage, where Katara becomes unnerved, her face blanking out, while Momo, who was looking out of the window by hanging from the ceiling, quickly retreats completely into the carriage.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Nervously.] You do want to watch your step, though.

speaker: Katara
text: [Nervous look on her face.] Why do they have all these poor people blocked off in one part of the city?

speaker: Aang
text: [Upset and somewhat bored.] This is why I never came here before. I always heard it was so different from the way the monks taught us to live. [Looks out the window.]

The scene changes to another part of the Lower Ring. Cut to Zuko walking down the street. Iroh catches up to him from behind, holding a large vase with several orange flowers placed in it. Cut to a close-up of Zuko staring coldly at the flora and Iroh.

speaker: Iroh
text: I just want our place to look nice, in case someone brings home a lady friend! [He gives Zuko a nudge with the elbow.]

speaker: Zuko
text: [Bleakly.] This city is a prison. I don't want to make a life here.
Cut to overhead view of the street they are walking down.

speaker: Iroh
text: Life happens wherever you are, whether you make it or not. Now come on, I found us some new jobs, and we start this afternoon!
Cut to a shot from behind Zuko and Iroh as they walk away. Someone's feet step out in front. Cut to a close-up of Jet staring angrily at the two firebenders.

speaker: Jet
text: Look at them, firebenders living right under everyone's nose.
Longshot and Smellerbee walk up to Jet from an alley.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Jet, you saw a man with a hot cup of tea. It doesn't prove he's a firebender. And what if he is, are we supposed to attack them‌? I thought we were starting over here, changing our ways.

speaker: Jet
text: We are. When I get the evidence I need, I'll report them to the police and let them handle it. [Walks forward a bit and turns his head to face the pair.] Ok‌ay?
Smellerbee and Longshot exchange glances. Cut to a shot of the Middle Ring, where Joo Dee is continuing the tour in the carriage.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: This is the Middle Ring of Ba Sing Se, home to the financial district, shops and restaurants, and the university.
Cut to side-view of carriage. Aang and Sokka looks out of the windows, bored.

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah, we met a professor from the Ba Sing Se University. He took us to an ancient underground library where we discovered information about the war that is [Cut to inside carriage. Leaning toward Joo Dee, losing his patience.] absolutely crucial for the King to hear!

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Smiling; excitedly.] Isn't history fascinating? Look, here's one of the oldest buildings in the Middle Ring, Town Hall!
The carriage stops and Joo Dee exits. Sokka stares at her, annoyed.

speaker: Sokka
text: Is that woman deaf? She only seems to hear every other word I say.

speaker: Toph
text: It's called "being handled". Get used to it. [Crosses her arms as everyone else glares sadly at Sokka.]

The scene changes to a small tea shop in the Lower Ring, with Jet leaning against the shop's wall. He turns around and peeks inside the window, spotting Zuko and Iroh speaking with the shop's owner. Cut to Jet's view.

speaker: Pao
text: Well, you certainly look like official tea servers. [Cut to close-up of Pao.] How do you feel‌?
Cut to Zuko and Iroh wearing aprons. Iroh desperately attempts to tie the string behind his back, but his effort is in vain.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Annoyed.] Ridiculous.

speaker: Iroh
text: Uh, does this possibly come in a larger size? [Cut to a view behind Iroh with the apron strings not quite long enough to tie.]
Cut to side-view of the threesome.

speaker: Pao
text: I have extra string in the back. Have some tea while you wait!

Pao pours some tea in two cups, hands them to his new employees, and heads to the back of the shop. Cut to frontal view of Iroh and Zuko. Iroh takes a sip from his cup, but his face contorts in disgust.

speaker: Iroh
text: [Quickly holds the cup at a distance.] Blech! [Looks at it in disgust.] This tea is nothing more than hot leaf juice!

speaker: Zuko
text: [Iroh closely examines his cup. In an annoyed tone.] Uncle, that's what all tea is.

speaker: Iroh
text: [Angrily.] How could a member of my own family say something so horrible?! We'll have to make some major changes around here.

Iroh angrily takes the tea pot and heads over to the window Jet is spying through. Jet gasps and moves away just in time as Iroh dumps the tea out the window. Jet slowly stalks around the corner of the shop and leaves. The scene changes to the carriage in which Team Avatar is touring in, which is now in the Upper Ring.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: The Upper Ring is home to our most important citizens. Your house is not too far from here!
Fade to the carriage passing by another wall with a tall gate. Behind it, the roof of an enormous building can be seen.

speaker: Katara
text: [Close-up.] What's inside that wall?

Cut to a closer view of the tall gate. Three men are standing in the gateway, wearing dark robes and wide brimmed hats turn their eyes toward the group, looking somewhat hateful at them. Cut to inside the carriage.

speaker: Sokka
text: And who're the mean-looking guys in robes?

speaker: Joo Dee
text: Inside is the Royal Palace. Those men are agents of the Dai Li, the cultural authority of Ba Sing Se. They are the guardians of all our traditions!

speaker: Aang
text: [Close-up view. Bored and annoyed.] Can we see the king now?

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up view.] Oh no, one doesn't just pop in on the Earth King!
Overhead view of inside of carriage. Aang nods his head, sadly. Cut to a shot of sky, with Momo flying, and descending and landing on the roof of a small house.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: Here we are! Your new home.
Cut to behind the gang looking down at Joo Dee. A messenger comes, gives Joo Dee a scroll, and leaves.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up view.] More good news! Your request for an audience with the Earth King is being processed, and should be put through in about month. [Cut to behind the gang looking down at Joo Dee.] Much more quickly than usual!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Close-up view of Team Avatar. Surprised.] A month?

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up view. Smiling widely.] Six to eight weeks, actually. [Closes her eyes and grins.]
The scene changes to a brief shot of the house before cutting to the inside.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up side-view.] Isn't it nice? I think you'll really enjoy it here.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Cut to view of entire room from the back.] I think we would enjoy it more if we weren't staying for so long. Can't we see the Earth King any sooner?

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up view over Sokka's shoulder. Smiling.] The Earth King is very busy running the finest city in the world! [Close-up on Sokka, as an annoyed expression covers his face.] But he will see you as soon as time permits.

speaker: Aang
text: [Cut to Momo and Aang. Aang turns to look out the window determined.] If we're going to be here for a month, we should spend our time looking for Appa. [At the sound of Appa's name, Momo wakes up.]

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Side-view of Aang with Joo Dee behind. Bows.] I'd like to escort you anywhere you'd like to go.

speaker: Toph
text: [Cut to Katara and Toph. Annoyed.] We don't need a babysitter.
Cut to view of room from the back. Toph gets up and walks toward the door.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: Oh, I won't get in the way. [She takes a step, blocking Toph's path.] And to leave you alone would make me a bad host! [Close-up of Toph, from behind, with Joo Dee in front.] Where shall we start?

Toph turns around in annoyance. The scene changes to a brief overhead shot of the city before changing to a bowl of food tied to a pole. Momo jumps on the bowl and starts to eat, but is scared by a cat owl, who screeches at him. Cut to a shot of the room, where Team Avatar, accompanied by Joo Dee, is in a pet store and speaking with the owner at the counter.

speaker: Pet store owner
text: [Close-up shot.] I'm sorry, but I haven't heard anything about a flying bison. I didn't even know there were any.

speaker: Aang
text: [Cut to shot of Aang and Sokka, Joo Dee lurking behind.] If someone wanted to sell a stolen animal without anyone knowing, where would they go‌?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Slightly frustrated.] Where's the black market? Who runs it? [Pointing at him accusingly.] Come on, you know!

speaker: Pet store owner
text: [Close-up shot. Nervous and perspiring.] Uh ... [Looks at Joo Dee, who is standing behind Sokka and Aang, shaking her head.] That would be illegal. You'll have to leave now; your lemur is harassing my sparrowkeets.

Cut to a shot of Momo eating the birds' food while defending himself from the sparrowkeets. The scene fades to an overhead shot of Ba Sing Se University, and cuts to Team Avatar standing in front of a student. A few students are walking around.

speaker: University student
text: Hmm ... I've never seen any sandbenders or nomads around here. [Frontal shot.] You should ask Professor Zei, he teaches the class on desert cultures.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Annoyed.] Right. And which of your professors could we ask about the war with the Fire Nation?

speaker: University student
text: [Nervously.] Uh ...
The student looks at Joo Dee, behind Sokka, who shakes her head at him. Sokka notices this from the corner of his eye, but she quickly stops before he can see it fully.

speaker: University student
text: [Close-up shot. Still very nervous.] I don't know. I'm not a political science student ... I've got to get to class.

He stands up and goes away, but trips, dropping his scrolls. He quickly picks them back up, and hurries to go. Joo Dee waves at him, smiling.

Cut to a shot of Aang, Katara, Sokka, and Toph standing at the steps of their house. Joo Dee is still sitting in the carriage, and talking to them through the window.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: Well, I'm sorry no one has seen your bison. Why don't you go get some rest‌? [Smiling.] Someone will be over with dinner, later.

As the carriage drives off, Sokka, followed by the rest of the gang, notices a man in the house across from them peeking through a window at them. Close-up shot of the man's door as his head recedes back. Cut back to the gang from behind.

speaker: Sokka
text: [He gestures to the rest of Team Avatar to follow him.] Hey, come with me.
Everyone follows Sokka across the street. Cut to a shot of Sokka knocking on the front door. The same man appears and opens the door, smiling at them.

speaker: Pong
text: You're the Avatar! [Side-view of gang.] I heard you were in town. [Overhead view.] I'm Pong.

speaker: Aang
text: [Side-view of gang. Smiles.] Nice to meet you, Pong.

speaker: Sokka
text: So, Pong, what's goin' on with this city? Why is everyone here so scared here to talk about the war?

speaker: Pong
text: [Frontal view. Shifts his eyes to the sides.] War? Scared? What do you mean?

speaker: Toph
text: [Frontal view. Slightly annoyed.] I can feel you shaking.

speaker: Pong
text: [Frontal view.] Look, I'm just a minor government official. [Looks to the sides to confirm that no one is present except them.] I've waited three years to get this house. I don't want to get into trouble.

speaker: Katara
text: [Tight side-view of the gang and Pong.] Get in trouble with who?!

speaker: Pong
text: [Puts his finger on his mouth, and whispers.] Shh, listen, you can't mention the War here. [Overhead view.] And whatever you do, stay away from the Dai Li.

As he closes the door, everyone looks at each other's faces in confusion. Fade to a shot of some apartments. Jet spies on Zuko and Iroh, from a balcony in the shadows, hiding behind a clothesline in the apartment across theirs.

speaker: Iroh
text: Would you like a pot of tea?

speaker: Zuko
text: [Close-up of Jet.] We've been working in a tea shop all day! [View from the outside in to the window where Zuko lays on a bed.] I'm sick of tea!

speaker: Iroh
text: [Pan across to Iroh through another window.] "Sick of tea?" That's like being sick of breathing! [He rummages through the cupboard beneath the counter, where he is standing. Close-up view of kettle.] Have you seen the spark rocks to heat up the water?

speaker: Jet
text: [Side-view. Whispering to himself.] They're not there. [Opens his fist to show some emerald colored rocks. Close-up side-view.] You'll have to firebend, old man. [He sees Iroh going inside, and narrows his eyes.] Where're you going?

speaker: Iroh
text: [View through window. Coming back to the counter.] I borrowed our neighbors'. Such kind people.

Close-up of kettle. He strikes the rocks near a pile of twigs below the teapot, and creates a flame. Jet, frustrated, ducks behind the clothesline and leaves.

Fade the next morning, and the scene changes to a blue jay chirping, before the camera pans down to Team Avatar's house. Cut to Katara coming out from the door, yawning and stretching. She takes a roll of papers on a mail slot attached to the wall, and reads it briefly, gasping with excitement, before running back inside. The others are all lounging around the upper part of the living room, and she runs to inform them about the information in the roll.

speaker: Katara
text: I got it! I know how we're going to see the Earth King!

speaker: Toph
text: [Frontal view.] How are we supposed to do that? [Mimicking Joo Dee.] "One doesn't just pop in on the Earth King!"

speaker: Katara
text: [Side-view of her and Aang. Reading from the papers.] The king is having a party at the palace tonight for his pet bear.

speaker: Aang
text: You mean, platypus bear?

speaker: Katara
text: No, it just says 'bear'.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Close-up view. He is lying upside down.] Certainly you mean his pet skunk bear.

speaker: Toph
text: [Frontal view.] Or his armadillo bear.

speaker: Aang
text: [Frontal view.] Gopher bear?

speaker: Katara
text: [Side-view of room.] Just ... bear.

speaker: Toph
text: This place ... is weird.

speaker: Katara
text: [Growing excited again.] The palace will be packed. We can sneak in with the crowd!

speaker: Toph
text: [Lies down.] Won't work.

speaker: Katara
text: [Frontal view. Slightly confused.] Why not?

speaker: Toph
text: [Over Katara's shoulder view.] Well, no offense to you simple country folk, but a real society crowd will spot you a mile away. You've got no manners! [Takes a pastry from a bowl and eats it.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Frontal view.] Excuse me? I've got no manners?! You're not exactly "lady fancy fingers!"

speaker: Toph
text: [Burps. Over Katara's shoulder view.] I learned proper society behavior and chose to leave it. [Throws the half eaten pastry to the side.] You never learned anything. And frankly, it's a little too late. [She picks her nose and flicks the snot off her finger.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Side-view of room. Excitedly.] Aha, but you learned it! You could teach us!

speaker: Aang
text: Yeah, I'm mastering every element. How hard could manners be‌?
Aang grabs a nearby curtain and puts it around himself like a noble's robe, and talks in a very sophisticated manner.

speaker: Aang
text: Good evening, Mr. Sokka Water Tribe, Ms. Katara Water Tribe, Lord Momo of the Momo Dynasty. Your Momo-ness. [Frontal view of Momo as he peeks at Aang from under the carpet and slightly bows.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Stands up also wearing a curtain like a robe. Mimicking a typical high class person.] Avatar Aang, how you do go on!

Aang bows to Sokka, and Sokka, trying to outdo Aang's bow, bows back. Aang tries to further out do Sokka's bow with a deeper bow and Sokka returns this bow with an even deeper bow. Both of them try to bow at the same time, but they knock each other's foreheads' together and fall down.

Toph walks toward Katara with the legs of Aang and Sokka seen on the floor.

speaker: Toph
text: Katara might be able to pull it off, but you two would be lucky to pass as busboys!
Cut to Sokka and Aang, who are still on the ground with curtains still on top of them.

speaker: Sokka
text: But I feel so fancy! [Toph's snot falls on Sokka's forehead.]
The scene changes to a shot of house, at dusk, and changes to inside the house, where Sokka and Aang are playing a game. Close-up of their hands.

speaker: Aang
text: [Closing his hands into a fist.] Earth!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Wriggling his hands.] Fire!

Sokka grumbles at losing the game, while Aang raises his hands, triumphantly, and flicks Sokka's forehead while grinning. Katara and Toph enter the room from a door, wearing makeup, exquisite Earth Kingdom dresses, and holding a fan each. Toph and Katara stare at the boys calmly before giving in to a fit of giggles. Aang blushes and stares dreamily at the sight of Katara.

speaker: Aang
text: [Stunned.] Wow, you look beautiful.
Sokka flicks Aang's forehead. Katara opens her mouth to reply to Aang's compliment, but is stopped by Toph placing her fans in front of her mouth.

speaker: Toph
text: Don't talk to the commoners, Katara. First rule of society.
Cut to a view of the room as Aang and Sokka watch the two girls leave.

speaker: Katara
text: [To Sokka and Aang.] We'll get in the party, and then find a way to let you in through the side gate.

The sound of a gong is heard as Momo walks past them, wearing one of the curtains as a cape. Aang looks at Sokka, who merely shrugs.

Cut to outside the tea shop where Iroh and Zuko are working. A man walks in through the door. Jet is shown to be spying on the shop from an alley. Cut to close-up of Jet's face with an expression of suspicion. Cut to a view behind him. Smellerbee and Longshot walk up behind Jet.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: Jet, we need to talk.

speaker: Jet
text: What‌? Oh great, it's you guys. Where have you been‌? [Overhead view of alley.] I could use some help with surveillance here!

speaker: Smellerbee
text: We've been talking, [Cut to side-view of the threesome, tea shop in background.] and we think you're becoming obsessed with this. It's not healthy.

speaker: Jet
text: [Close-up shot.] Oh, really? You both think this?
Frontal view of Longshot and Smellerbee. Longshot places his arm on Smellerbee's shoulder in agreement with her statement.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: We came here to make a fresh start. But you won't let this go. Even though there is no real proof!

speaker: Jet
text: Well, maybe if you'd help me!

speaker: Smellerbee
text: [Side-view of threesome.] Jet, you gotta stop this.

speaker: Jet
text: Maybe you've forgotten why we need to start over. [View of Longshot and Smellerbee from behind Jet. Longshot and Smellerbee look down, guiltily.] Maybe you've forgotten about how the Fire Nation left us all homeless‌. How they wiped out all the people we loved. If you don't want to help me, I'll get the evidence on my own. [He goes toward the tea shop.]
Cut to outside of tea shop, before switching to its interior, where Iroh is pouring tea to a customer.

speaker: Customer
text: This is the best tea in the city!

speaker: Iroh
text: [Frontal view.] The secret ingredient is love. [He waves a hand through the steam coming from the teapot and walks toward the back of the shop where the owner is, while Zuko gives him a disgusted look.]

speaker: Pao
text: [Side-view. Turning to Iroh.] I think you're due for a raise.
Cut to the door as it is suddenly slammed open by Jet; he enters.

speaker: Jet
text: I'm tired of waiting! [Pointing an accusing finger at Iroh and Zuko.] These two men are firebenders!

Jet unsheathes his hook swords and prepares to fight. View from behind Jet. Iroh and Zuko quickly exchange a look, not knowing what to do. Cut to view of Iroh at the back of the tea shop with Jet at the entrance.

speaker: Jet
text: I know they're firebenders, I saw the old man heating his tea!

speaker: Customer
text: [Frontal view. Bleakly.] He works in a tea shop.

speaker: Jet
text: [Frontal view.] He's a firebender! I'm telling you!

speaker: Customer
text: [Frontal view. Stands up, along with another man.] Drop your swords, boy. Nice and easy.

speaker: Jet
text: [Frontal view. To Zuko.] You'll have to defend yourself. Then everyone will know. Go ahead, show them what you can do.
Jet slowly walks toward Zuko and Iroh with his swords. Just as one of the customers is about to draw his swords, Zuko steps in front and grabs them instead.

speaker: Zuko
text: You want a show? I'll give you a show!

Zuko takes the customer's broadswords and enters a fighting stance. He pulls a table in front of him with his foot and kicks it at Jet, who slices the table with his swords and jumps over it. As he lands, he swings both hook swords at the Fire Nation prince, who deflects the attack and jumps backward on to another table, which is sliced in half by Jet, swinging one sword through the middle of the table. Zuko steps onto one half of the table and balances on one foot. Jet continues his attack by cutting the legs on the half of the table Zuko is standing on. Zuko quickly jumps up, and as he lands, he swings both broadswords at Jet's feet, and Jet somersaults away and lands in a crouching position before charging forward at Zuko again. Zuko swings both of his swords at Jet. Just as both weapons clash together, the scene freezes and cuts to the Ba Sing Se Palace. Several high class citizens are lined up and being admitted inside by a guard, who is checking the invitation of one group before letting them pass. Toph and Katara are next in line and approach him.

speaker: Guard
text: Invitation please.

speaker: Toph
text: [Formally.] I think this will do.
Toph shows the official seal of the Beifong family to the guard. The camera cuts to a closer, detailed shot of the seal, before cutting to the guard.

speaker: Guard
text: No entry without an invitation. Step out of line, please.

speaker: Toph
text: [Irritated.] Look, the Pangs and the Yumsoon-Hans are waiting in there for us. I'm going to have to tell them who didn't let me in.

speaker: Guard
text: [Unyielding.] Step out of line please.

As the guard points his finger to the side, Katara and Toph move out disappointedly, when Katara notices a carriage, from which Long Feng comes out, and two Dai Li agents bow to him. Katara has an idea, and she, along with Toph, go to the leader of the Dai Li.

speaker: Katara
text: [Side-view.] Sir, I'm sorry to bother you, but my cousin lost our invitations. [Whispering.] She's blind. [Again, normally.] Do you think you could help us? Our family's inside and I'm sure they're very worried.

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Close-up view as he smiles and bows his head.] I am honored, please come with me.

Long Feng walks toward the guard at the entrance with Toph and Katara following him. The guard bows to him and the three of them go into the palace. As they are walking in, Toph and Katara stick their tongues out at the guard while his back is turned. The scene changes to an overhead shot inside the palace. At one end of the table is Bosco the bear eating a steak, his drool dripping of his chin. Seated to either side of him are two guests.

speaker: Older guest
text: He's taking all the good stuff!

speaker: Younger guest
text: Quiet! You don't know what I had to do to get seats this near the bear!

Bosco slightly hits the younger guest before pouncing onto the table and eating a large plate of meat in front of him. Cut to a close shot of the bear gorging. As he moves his head, Toph, Katara, and Long Feng walk into the hall.

speaker: Long Feng
text: It's beautiful, isn't it? [Close-up shot. Turning to the girls.] By the way, I'm Long Feng. I'm a cultural minister to the king.

speaker: Katara
text: [View of her and Toph.] I'm Hwamei, and this is Dung. [Toph frowns and pulls a string hanging from Katara's headdress, causing her pain.] Ow!

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Close-up shot.] Now where is your family? I'd love to meet them.

speaker: Katara
text: [Side-view. Feigning looking around.] Uh ... I don't see them right now, but I'm sure we'll find them soon. [Smiles.] Thanks for all your help.
As they walk away, Long Feng appears in front of them.

speaker: Long Feng
text: Don't worry, as your escort it would be dishonorable to abandon you ladies without finding your family first. We'll keep looking. [He turns around and leads the two girls, while Katara glances at Toph, nervously.]
Cut to outside the palace. Aang peeks around the pedestal of a statue of a lion. Cut to a shot of Aang and Sokka peeking around both sides of the pedestal.

speaker: Aang
text: [Worried and nervous.] Where are they?
Aang and Sokka duck behind the pedestal.

speaker: Sokka
text: Look, I came up with a back-up plan. [He picks Momo up.] We dress Momo like a ghost, okay? [Moves Momo in a circle.] He flies by the guards, creating a distraction. Then, we blast a hole in the wall-
Aang stands up and looks over the pedestal, and points to some busboys, as Sokka stands up. Cut to some busboys unloading supplies from a carriage and taking them inside.

speaker: Aang
text: Or we could go in as these guys. Toph said we might pass as busboys!
Cut to a shot of Aang and Sokka.

speaker: Sokka
text: Okay ... [Rolls his eyes.] But remember that Momo ghost plan. I think it's a winner. [Smiling, he and Aang sink behind the pedestal.]

The scene changes to outside the tea shop, as Zuko bursts out through the door and tumbles onto the street. Jet runs after him and strikes at Zuko with both swords. Zuko defends the strike and both combatants lock swords.

speaker: Jet
text: [Close-up shot with a sinister grin.] You must be getting tired of using those swords. [Close-up shot of Zuko with a look of annoyance.] Why don't you go ahead and firebend at me?
View behind the fighters as they move off screen to reveal Zuko at the door to the tea shop.

speaker: Iroh
text: Please, son, you're confused! You don't know what you're doing!

Cut back to Jet and Zuko, fighting. Zuko swings at Jet, but Jet stops Zuko's broadsword with the ends of his hook swords, spins around and deflects it to the side. Zuko spins with his swords and tries to counterattack, but Jet hooks the ends of his swords together and begins to swing them at Zuko in large circular motions. Zuko retreats back a few steps to defend himself.

speaker: Jet
text: Bet you wish he'd help you out with a little fire blast right now.
As Jet swings at Zuko's feet, Zuko stabs one of his broadswords through the hilt, pinning it to the ground. Jet looks at it with annoyance before focusing back on Zuko.

speaker: Zuko
text: You're the one who needs help.

Both the combatants lose a sword, and continue fighting with only one. He turns in a circle and tries to swipe at Zuko, but Zuko quickly advances and swings his sword at Jet. Jet pulls his attack just in time to bend backward and avoid Zuko's blade, cutting the straw sticking out of Jet's mouth in half. The scene replays, but the second time, zooms in on the straw. Jet regains balance, and jumps backward onto the edge of a well.

speaker: Jet
text: You see that‌?! [Aerial view.] The Fire Nation is trying to silence me. [View behind Zuko looking at Jet.] It'll never happen.

Jet begins to attack again, hooking his sword to the top of the well and sending a flying kick toward Zuko.

The scene cuts back inside to the palace, where Aang and Sokka are seen, standing back to back, fully dressed as busboys, serving refreshments to the guests of the party. Aang begins pouring a drink while Sokka is serving food to people who pass by.

speaker: Aang
text: [A little worried.] Where are Toph and Katara?

speaker: Sokka
text: Forget about them! Just keep an eye out for the king. [He grows slightly annoyed as Momo's tail, which has been sticking out of Aang's hat, begins to wag in his face.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Slightly nervous.] I don't know what he looks like.

speaker: Sokka
text: You know, royal, flowing robe, fancy jewelry. [He grabs Momo's tail, still wagging in his face, and vigorously stuffs it back into Aang's hat.]
The camera pans around the room to show the party guests, all fitting Sokka's description. They are all adorned in fancy, flowing robes and headpieces, chatting and eating food.

speaker: Aang
text: That could be anyone!
Cut back to Aang and Sokka as the camera pans right to show Toph, walking up to the duo.

speaker: Toph
text: [Trying to speak in a fancy voice.] Another crab puff, please. [Sokka leans in, eyes closed, with his tray to hand her a puff, unaware it's her.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Surprised and happy.] You found us!

speaker: Toph
text: [Back to her normal voice.] I'd know your little footsteps anywhere, Twinkle Toes.
Katara catches up to the group, and Aang blushes when he sees her.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Opening his eyes, realizing who they are. Sarcastically.] Thanks for letting us in!

speaker: Katara
text: [Close-up of her face.] Sorry, but the guy who escorted us in won't let us out of his sight!
The camera pans out to show all of the party guests, none of which seem to be following them.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Slightly confused, not seeing anyone following them.] What guy?
Cut to an overhead shot of the group. As they look around for Long Feng, Joo Dee approaches the group, and is anxious to see them.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: What are you doing here? You have to leave immediately, or we will be in terrible trouble!
Joo Dee tries to push Sokka, but he blocks her with his tray.

speaker: Sokka
text: Not until we see the king.

speaker: Joo Dee
text: [Close-up of her face.] You don't understand. You must go.
Joo Dee shoves Sokka on Aang, causing him to spill the water inside the pitcher he was carrying on a guest.

speaker: Guest
text: Aarrrh! Oh!

speaker: Aang
text: Sorry. No, don't shout.

Aang uses his hands and foot to airbend a gust at the guest. His hat is blown off, along with Momo. It dries the water on her, but also turns her hair, clothes, and makeup into a mess, leading Aang to smile sheepishly. The guest is briefly shocked, but smiles in amazement.

speaker: Guest
text: [Amazed.] The Avatar! I didn't know the Avatar would be here.

All the guests' attention is now focused on Aang. Joo Dee's large, happy smile quickly turns sour and is replaced by a frown and a look of dread. Aang looks around at the guests as Momo hides back under the hat on the floor and slinks away. Aang blushes and waves at the crowd, laughing nervously, as Sokka leans in toward Aang.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Whispers.] You keep their attention while I look for the king.

speaker: Aang
text: [View of Aang from above.] Watch this, everybody!

Wide-view of the room. Aang jumps out of his busboy clothes and lands on the long dining table as Sokka walks off into the crowd. Aang swings his arms over the guests' drinks, waterbending the liquid out of the cups. He jumps onto a pitcher and balances on top of it, while continuing to waterbend. Aang brings the liquid above his head and creates a swirling multicolored ball. The crowd cheers and claps as he spins around. Bosco growls with delight at Aang's antics.

Scene changes to outside the tea shop, where Zuko and Jet are fighting. Zuko growls as he swings his sword at Jet, who dodges the attack. He moves on to Zuko's side, and they end up back-to-back. Zuko and Jet attempt to strike the opponent behind them, but neither can get past the other's defense. Cut to a shot of two Dai Li agents walking toward the fight.

speaker: Dai Li agent
text: Drop your weapons.
Aerial view. Zuko and Jet step away and face each other. Zuko lowers his sword, as Jet points at Zuko and Iroh.

speaker: Jet
text: Arrest them! [Frontal view.] They're firebenders!

speaker: Iroh
text: [Panning view from behind Jet facing Iroh and Zuko.] This poor boy is confused. We're just simple refugees.

speaker: Pao
text: [Pointing to Jet.] This young man wrecked my tea shop, and assaulted my employees!

speaker: Customer
text: It's true, sir. We saw the whole thing. This crazy kid attacked the finest tea maker in the city.

speaker: Iroh
text: [Frontal view. Blushing.] Oh, ho, ho. That's very sweet.
The two Dai Li agents walk up to Jet, who looks at them angrily.

speaker: Dai Li agent
text: Come with us, son.

Jet swings his hook sword at the agent, who catches the sword with his rock gloves.
