text: [Looking at map.] Far, very far. [Puts the map on the ground as they all gather round.] Here it is. It's near the South Pole, almost all the way back home.

speaker: Katara
text: Aang, it will take us weeks just to get to the tip of the Earth Kingdom. And then we'll need to find a boat to get to the island.

speaker: Aang
text: I don't care. We have a chance to find Appa! We have to try!

speaker: Old Sweepy
text: Must be nice to visit an island. I haven't had a vacation for years.

speaker: Katara
text: Don't you have some more hair to clean up?

speaker: Old Sweepy
text: Shuffle on, I get you. No more need for Old Sweepy ...

speaker: Katara
text: You're right Aang, right now our first concern has to be finding Appa. We can come back when we have him.

speaker: Sokka
text: All right, let's get moving.

speaker: Jet
text: I'll come with you.

speaker: Katara
text: We don't need your help!

speaker: Jet
text: Why won't you trust me? [Walks after Sokka and Aang.]

speaker: Katara
text: Gee, I wonder.

speaker: Toph
text: [After Jet walks away.] Was this guy your boyfriend or something?

speaker: Katara
text: What ... no! [She folds her arms and looks away defiantly.]

speaker: Toph
text: [Smiles.] I can tell you're lying ... [Katara runs away from her, embarrassed.]
Back within the city

speaker: Sokka
text: We can take the train out to the wall but then we'll have to walk.

speaker: Aang
text: Don't worry, on the way back we'll be flying!

speaker: Toph
text: We're finally leaving Ba Sing Se. [Spreads her arms outward in celebration.] Worst ... city ... ever!
Smellerbee and Longshot appear in the background and notice Jet.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: [Surprised.] Jet!

speaker: Katara
text: [Looks at Jet angrily.] I thought you said you didn't have your "gang" anymore!

speaker: Jet
text: [Turns to look at Smellerbee, confused.] I don't!

speaker: Smellerbee
text: [Runs up to Jet and hugs him.] We were so worried. How did you get away from the Dai Li? [Camera quickly zooms in to Katara's shocked face.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Shocked.] The Dai Li?!

speaker: Jet
text: I don't know what she's talking about!

speaker: Smellerbee
text: He got arrested by the Dai Li a couple of weeks ago. We saw them drag him away!

speaker: Jet
text: Why would I be arrested? I've been living peacefully in the city!

speaker: Toph
text: [Feeling the ground between Jet and Smellerbee.] This doesn't make any sense. They're both telling the truth.

speaker: Katara
text: That's impossible.

speaker: Sokka
text: No it's not! Toph can't tell who's lying because they both think they're telling the truth. Jet's been brainwashed!

speaker: Jet
text: That's crazy! It can't be! [Glances to the sides.] Stay away from me!
They all surround him. Cut to the moon in the night sky. Cut to a Dai Li agent walking the streets. Zuko, disguised as the Blue Spirit, runs by.

speaker: Zuko
text: Out of my way, skinny!

The agent prepares to use his rock glove, but pauses when the disguised man turns into an alley. The agent runs to the alley and sees a figure that appears to be him. He fires his rock gloves at the figure's chest and head, knocking off the stuffed figure's head and knocking it down.

speaker: Dai Li agent
text: Huh?
There is the whisper of a drawn blade behind him and Zuko, still disguised, captures him and places one of his swords to the agent's neck.

speaker: Zuko
text: If you don't want to end up like him, you'll do what I say.
Back in an unknown building, Team Avatar, Longshot, and Smellerbee all surrounding a seated Jet.

speaker: Katara
text: The Dai Li must have sent Jet to mislead us, and that janitor was part of their plot, too!

speaker: Aang
text: I bet they have Appa here in the city. Maybe he's in the same place they took Jet! Where did they take you?

speaker: Jet
text: Nowhere! I- I don't know what you're talking about!

speaker: Aang
text: We need to find a way to jog his real memories.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Teasingly.] Maybe Katara should kiss him. That should bring something back!

speaker: Katara
text: Maybe you should kiss him, Sokka!

speaker: Sokka
text: Hey, just an idea!

speaker: Aang
text: [Jealously.] A bad one.

speaker: Sokka
text: Ooh, wait! I've got it!
Sokka plucks a straw from his mattress, pokes it into Jet's mouth in trademark fashion and regards him thoughtfully.

speaker: Jet
text: I don't think it's working. [Spits it out.]

speaker: Toph
text: Try to think of something from your past that triggers your emotions.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: The Fire Nation! Remember what they did to your family!

speaker: Katara
text: Close your eyes. Picture it.

Jet closes his eyes, while sweat beads start to form on his forehead. His eyes suddenly snap wide open and he sees images of himself at a younger age watching his town burning down and Mongke looking back at him.

speaker: Jet
text: [Sweating.] No! It's too painful!

speaker: Katara
text: Maybe this will help. [Takes water and puts it around his ears, using healing to clear his mind.]

Jet looks up from the floor and sees an image of Long Feng standing above a lake. Long Feng stares at Jet, and Jet sinks down under the lake into an underground room. He sees an image of a Dai Li agent shining a spinning light in his face.

speaker: Jet
text: They took me to a headquarters under the water. Like a lake!

speaker: Sokka
text: Wait! Remember what Joo Dee said? She said she went on vacation to Lake Laogai!

speaker: Jet
text: [Stands up.] That's it! Lake Laogai.
Fade to an aerial shot of Lake Laogai. The camera pans down to show Team Avatar, Jet, Longshot, and Smellerbee standing at the edge of the lake.

speaker: Sokka
text: So where's this secret headquarters?

speaker: Jet
text: Under the water, I think.

speaker: Toph
text: There's a tunnel right there by the shore.

Toph points to the side and whistles as she walks to the edge of the shore. She uses her earthbending to bring up a slab of rock with an entrance. She moves the rock out the way with the same technique. They all look down at the tunnel and Momo flies away. Cut to them inside the secret headquarters. Jet checks to make sure the coast is clear and they walk down a long hallway.

speaker: Jet
text: It's all starting to come back to me!
Jet walks past a room where a member of the Dai Li brainwashes a group of women.

speaker: Brainwasher
text: I'm Joo Dee. Welcome to Ba Sing Se.

speaker: Joo Dees
text: [Simultaneously.] I'm Joo Dee. Welcome to Ba Sing Se.

speaker: Brainwasher
text: We're so lucky to have our walls to create order.

speaker: Joo Dees
text: [Simultaneously.] We're so lucky to have our walls to create order.

speaker: Jet
text: I think there might be a cell big enough to hold Appa up ahead. I think it's through here! [Opens a door.]
Cut to Appa chained up as a door opens in his cell and Appa wakes up. Cut to Zuko standing at the door, disguised as the Blue Spirit.

speaker: Zuko
text: Expecting someone else?
Jet opens the other door. An overhead shot reveals several Dai Li agents waiting on the ceiling. The door closes suddenly behind them. Lights turn on, revealing the agents.

speaker: Sokka
text: Now that's something different.

speaker: Long Feng
text: You have made yourselves enemies of the state. Take them into custody.

The Dai Li agents jump off the ceiling and surround them. Two agents fire rock gloves, but Toph breaks them up and sends the two agents flying through the air with rock pillars. Jet runs toward the agents and breaks two other gloves fired by agents with his swords, and trips another. A full battle ensues. Aang deals with a pair of Dai Li agents. Sokka and Katara destroy two Dai Li gloves, but a second pair grabs them.

Toph saves them by creating a rock wall and she raises ground up. Toph knocks away the four Dai Li agents that attack her, but a glove captures her and Jet swings by to free her. The agent fires his other rock glove, and Longshot fires an arrow, which destroys the glove. Jet jumps in front of Longshot to hold off more of their rock attacks. Long Feng escapes.

speaker: Aang
text: [Knocks away two agents with airbending.] Long Feng is escaping!
Jet and Aang chase him. They head into another part of the headquarters with many pipes of all sizes sticking out of the walls, with some of them pouring out water, but are sealed in by Long Feng.

speaker: Long Feng
text: All right, Avatar, you've caused me enough problems. This is your last chance ... if you want your bison back.

speaker: Aang
text: You do have Appa! Tell me where he is!

speaker: Long Feng
text: Agree to exit the city now, and I'll waive all charges against you and allow you to leave with your lost pet.

speaker: Jet
text: [Gets in a fighting position.] You're in no position to bargain.

speaker: Long Feng
text: Am I not?

speaker: Aang
text: [Gets into a fighting position.] You're definitely not!

speaker: Long Feng
text: Jet, the Earth King has invited you to Lake Laogai.

speaker: Jet
text: [Close-up of his eye, his iris dilates. In a monotonous voice.] I am honored to accept his invitation.
Jet attacks Aang. Cut to Appa growling at the disguised Zuko. Appa tries to strike Zuko, but his chained feet hold him back.

speaker: Zuko
text: You're mine now.
The door opens and Zuko gets into a fighting stance. Iroh enters.

speaker: Zuko
text: Uncle?

speaker: Iroh
text: So, the Blue Spirit. I wonder who could be behind that mask ...

speaker: Zuko
text: [Sighs and takes off the mask.] What are you doing here?

speaker: Iroh
text: I was just about to ask you the same thing. What do you plan to do now that you've found the Avatar's bison? Keep him locked in our new apartment? Should I go put on a pot of tea for him?

speaker: Zuko
text: First I have to get it out of here.

speaker: Iroh
text: [Starts yelling.] And then what!? You never think these things through! [Points at him.] This is exactly what happened when you captured the Avatar at the North Pole! You had him, and then you had nowhere to go!

speaker: Zuko
text: I would have figured something out!

speaker: Iroh
text: No! If his friends hadn't found you, you would have frozen to death!

speaker: Zuko
text: I know my own destiny, Uncle!

speaker: Iroh
text: Is it your own destiny, or is it a destiny someone else has tried to force on you?

speaker: Zuko
text: Stop it, Uncle! I have to do this!

speaker: Iroh
text: I'm begging you, Prince Zuko! It's time for you to look inward and begin asking yourself the big questions. Who are you, and what do you want?
Zuko screams loudly, throwing down his swords and Blue Spirit mask. Cut to the brainwashed Jet continuing to swing at Aang.

speaker: Aang
text: Jet, it's me, Aang! [Runs back.] You don't have to do this!

speaker: Long Feng
text: I'm afraid he no longer has a choice.
Jet resumes his attempts at attacking Aang, who dodges them and uses airbending to knock him back. Jet uses his hook swords to stop himself and he pants heavily.

speaker: Aang
text: Jet, I'm your friend! Look inside your heart!

speaker: Long Feng
text: Do your duty, Jet!

speaker: Aang
text: He can't make you do this! [Cut to a close-up of Jet's face as he hangs his head, while panting and sweating.] You're a Freedom Fighter!

At these final words, Jet straightens in shock. Everything goes white and he has a rapid flashback of his past as a Freedom Fighter, seeing Longshot, Smellerbee, Pipsqueak and the Duke, and him with Katara. The Freedom Fighters cheer fades to him with Smellerbee and Longshot, before showing him sitting down with Iroh and Zuko. Fade to him giving the passengers food, and quickly to him being dragged away by the Dai Li. Fade more rapidly to Jet's brainwashing, and to Long Feng on Lake Laogai. Cut to his burning village, to Iroh, to him with Zuko, to him with Katara, to him watching his burning village crying. Cut to him in a Fire Nation camp, to him with Katara, and to him being brainwashed. Cut back to him crying while watching his village burn as Mongke watches. The flashback ends and Jet's irises return to normal.

speaker: Long Feng
text: Do it! Do it now!
Jet fires a sword at Long Feng, which misses. Long Feng counters with an uplifted rock which strikes Jet down. Aang runs toward Jet as Long Feng escapes through a pipe in the wall.

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Escaping upward to a pipe.] Foolish boy. You've chosen your own demise. [Exits.]

speaker: Jet
text: [Weakly.] I'm sorry ... Aang.

speaker: Aang
text: [Sadly.] Don't be.

The rest of the group arrives, all struck with sorrow and shock as they gather around Jet. Katara stares open-mouthed at Jet, her hands hovering near her mouth in shock. Snapping out of it, she withdraws water from her water skin, with which she covers her hands, and it begins to glow as she kneels down next to him. Cut to a shot from over her shoulder, with Jet glancing at her while she rubs her hands over his chest in an attempt to heal him. After rubbing his chest three times, the glow fades, the water stains Jet's clothing, and Katara looks back over her shoulder toward the rest of the group.

speaker: Katara
text: This isn't good.

speaker: Smellerbee
text: You guys go and find Appa. We'll take care of Jet.

speaker: Katara
text: We're not going to leave you.

speaker: Longshot
text: There's no time. Just go. We'll take care of him. He's our leader.
They stare at Longshot in surprise.

speaker: Jet
text: Don't worry, Katara. I'll be fine. [Smiles a little.]
Katara closes her eyes in painful sadness and opens them again as she rises. Team Avatar begins to exit.

speaker: Toph
text: [Whispering to Sokka.] He's lying ...

Cut to a close-up of Smellerbee crying. Longshot watches Team Avatar completely leave through a tunnel that is earthbent open before turning the other way to the other exit and standing guard, prepping an arrow. Smellerbee is seen kneeling next to Jet, rubbing her hands back and forth over him, with her right hand on his forehead.

Team Avatar reaches Appa's hold, only to discover that it is empty.

speaker: Aang
text: Appa's gone! Long Feng beat us here.

speaker: Sokka
text: If we keep moving, maybe we can catch up with them!
They find an exit back to the beach. As they make their escape, several Dai Li agents jump out from behind them.

speaker: Sokka
text: You think we can outrun them?

speaker: Aang
text: I don't think it's gonna matter!
Another group of Dai Li agents, plus Long Feng, stand in front of them. All the agents box them in, lifting up the ground on both sides. Dai Li agents stand on all three walls. Momo flies to Aang.

speaker: Aang
text: What is it, Momo?
Momo flies to the sky and chirps excitedly. Suddenly, Appa flies down. Cut to the overjoyed looks on Team Avatar's faces.]

speaker: Aang
text: Appa!
Appa smashes through the rock walls, scattering the Dai Li agents. Aang and Toph use earthbending to knock other nearby agents off a cliff and into the lake. Appa confronts Long Feng.

speaker: Long Feng
text: I can handle you by myself.
Long Feng charges at Appa, but Appa grabs his leg and hurtles him skipping into the lake. Appa spits out Long Feng's shoe. The team cheers and they run toward Appa.

speaker: Sokka
text: Yeah! Appa!

speaker: Aang
text: [Happily crying.] I missed you, buddy.

Appa closes his eyes. A teary-eyed Katara somberly looks over Lake Laogai as they fly over it on Appa. Aang places his hand on her shoulder. The team all gathers in a group hug. Zuko and Iroh emerge from the Dai Li headquarters.

speaker: Iroh
text: You did the right thing, nephew. [Zuko looks at his Blue Spirit mask as Iroh rests a hand on its shoulder.] Leave it behind.
Zuko walks to the edge and tosses the mask into the water, where it slowly sinks to the bottom of the lake. Fade to credits.
The episode opens just outside the vast waters of Lake Laogai. Team Avatar has stopped on a tiny islet in the center of the lake. Aang is embracing Appa, happy upon reuniting with him.

speaker: Aang
text: I missed you more than you'll ever know, buddy. [Momo flies into Appa to hug him too. Appa licks Aang, which causes Aang to laugh.]
Sokka approaches Katara and Toph.

speaker: Sokka
text: Look, we escaped from the Dai Li. We got Appa back. I'm telling you, we should go to the Earth King now and tell him our plan. We're on a roll.

speaker: Katara
text: One good hour after weeks of trouble isn't much of a roll.

speaker: Sokka
text: We can build on it. If we want to invade the Fire Nation when the eclipse happens, we'll need the Earth King's support.

speaker: Toph
text: What makes you think we'll get it? I don't know if you've noticed, but things don't usually go that smoothly for our little gang.

speaker: Sokka
text: I know, but I've got a good feeling about this. This time will be different.

speaker: Katara
text: Sokka, Long Feng is in control of the city. His conspiracy with the Dai Li is too powerful. I think we should just keep flying and leave this horrible place behind us.

speaker: Toph
text: I'm with Sweetness. I've seen enough of Ba Sing Se. [Raises arms and opens eyes wide.] And I can't even see!
Aang flies into the shot.

speaker: Aang
text: But now that we have Appa back, there's nothing stopping us from telling the Earth King the truth. About the conspiracy and the War.

speaker: Sokka
text: See? Aang's with me. [Puts his arm around Aang and smiles.] It's the whole reason we came here in the first place. We have to try.

speaker: Katara
text: [Thinks for a moment.] Well, I guess if the Earth King knew the truth, things could change. [Sokka and Aang smile.]

speaker: Toph
text: [Stands up.] I don't trust the new positive Sokka. [Points at Sokka in an accusing manner.] Long Feng brainwashed you, didn't he!?
Aang notices a few ships in the lake.

speaker: Sokka
text: That's probably the Dai Li searching for us. [To Katara.] So?
Katara thinks for a moment before looking at Sokka.

speaker: Katara
text: [Determined.] Let's fly!
They fly toward the Palace, now with no saddle, holding onto Appa's fur for dear life, especially Toph.

speaker: Toph
text: Can we please buy a new saddle? Riding bareback is terrifying! [Buries face in Appa's back.]
They get closer to the palace.

speaker: Sokka
text: There it is! That whole thing is the palace! The Earth King's chamber should be in the center!

speaker: Katara
text: We have to be careful. Long Feng's probably warned the king that we're coming.

speaker: Sokka
text: Why would you assume that? If you ask me, I think we're just gonna sail right in and- [A giant rock almost hits them.] Aahh!

speaker: Toph
text: What was that?

speaker: Sokka
text: Surface-to-air rocks! [Sees more being launched.] More incoming!

They dodge a few more rocks. One gets launched right at Aang, but he destroys it with his hand. Another is launched at them head on, but Aang slices it cleanly in two by swinging his staff at the rock to augment his earthbending. He launches himself from Appa to the front of the palace and slams his staff into the ground, generating a massive earthen wave to knock back the palace guards. Appa lands and roars at the captain's ostrich horse, which causes it to drop the captain and run off. As they continue toward the Earth King, more guards appear and launch earth cubes at the gang. Toph and Aang use earthbending to block the attacks, while Katara uses waterbending to subdue the guards.

speaker: Katara
text: [Water whips two guards.] Sorry!

Katara turns around and strikes down more guards with her waterbending, though closes her right eye in a sympathetic flinch for a moment as she does so. As more guards rush toward them in an attempt to halt Team Avatar's progress, Toph uses her earthbending to flip the tiles of the walkway, trapping them between them and ensuring a clear passage for the team.

speaker: Katara
text: Sorry! We just need to get through to see the Earth King!

More guards appear on the opposite end of a bridge and launch two giant statues at them. Toph and Aang create an earth igloo to block the statues. Katara creates an ice ramp to jump to the other side of the bridge and water-whips the guards into the water. Aang freezes them in the water as the rest all jump across. More surface-to-air rocks appear as guards are coming down a giant staircase. Toph uses earthbending to change the stairs into a ramp, causing them all to fall. She and Aang use earthbending to escalate themselves up the stairs.

speaker: Sokka
text: Seriously, we're actually on your guys' side! [Pauses for a moment.] Sorry.
More guards come and Aang and Toph push them away with earthbending.

speaker: Sokka
text: In there! [They enter the palace.]
They come to an area with three doors. More guards appear and Toph easily defeats them all.

speaker: Sokka
text: Toph, which way to the Earth King?

speaker: Toph
text: How should I know? I'm still voting we leave Ba Sing Se.

Toph defeats more guards while Sokka opens the doors to find the Earth King. The first room is empty, as is the second; outside the second door, a royal guard goes flying to the right off-screen. Sokka bursts into a third room, startling a woman.

speaker: Palace woman
text: Burglar! [Tries to run, trips, and falls flat on her face.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shuts the door.] Sorry. Wrong door.
Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh return from Lake Laogai. The former seems ill.

speaker: Iroh
text: You did the right thing. Letting the Avatar's bison go free.

speaker: Zuko
text: I don't feel right. [Gets dizzy and passes out.]

speaker: Iroh
text: Zuko! [Rushes to him.]
Back at the palace, the team arrives at a pile of rubble. Sokka climbs atop it and sees a gigantic door.

speaker: Sokka
text: Now that's an impressive door. It's gotta go somewhere. [Drops down from the rubble and attempts to kick the door open.] Yaaah! [The door does not move even slightly. Sokka starts trying to push it open, but to no avail. Toph and Aang jump in from behind and bust the door down, knocking Sokka forward in the process. He starts rubbing the back of his head.] A little warning next time?
They arrive in the Earth King's chamber with Kuei sitting in his throne. Long Feng and his Dai Li agents stand in their way. The team takes fighting stances against them.

speaker: Aang
text: We need to talk to you.

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Turns to face the Earth King.] They're here to overthrow you.

speaker: Sokka
text: No, we're on your side. We're here to help.

speaker: Katara
text: You have to trust us.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Stands up with a rising aggravated tone.] You invade my palace, lay waste to all my guards, break down my fancy door, and you expect me to trust you?

speaker: Toph
text: He has a good point.

speaker: Kuei
text: If you are on my side, then drop your weapons and stand down!
They look at each other for a moment. Aang drops his staff, Katara puts her water whip back in her water skin, Sokka drops his machete, and Toph drops the boulder she is levitating.

speaker: Aang
text: [Smiles.] See? We're friends, Your Earthiness. [Gives a slight nervous chuckle.]
The king says nothing and just continues to frown grimly. Long Feng signals the Dai Li to cuff their arms with rock gloves.

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Smiles sinisterly.] Detain the assailants!
The Dai Li rush behind Team Avatar.

speaker: Sokka
text: But we dropped our weapons. We're your allies.

speaker: Long Feng
text: Make sure the Avatar and his friends never see daylight again. [The king looks at him shocked.]

speaker: Kuei
text: The Avatar? [Points at Sokka.] You're the Avatar?

speaker: Sokka
text: Uh, no. Him. [Nudges his head at Aang.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Effortlessly breaks free of his earth cuffs and raises his arms.] Over here. [Re-attaches the cuffs.]

speaker: Long Feng
text: What does it matter, Your Highness? They're enemies of the state.

speaker: Kuei
text: Perhaps you're right. [Sees Bosco sniff and lick Aang, who laughs, and smiles at Long Feng.] Though Bosco seems to like him. [Looks back at the team.] I'll hear what he has to say. [Long Feng glares at Aang.]

speaker: Aang
text: [Walks forward.] Well, sir, there's a war going on right now. For the past one hundred years in fact. The Dai Li's kept it secret from you. It's a conspiracy to control the city, and to control you.

speaker: Kuei
text: A secret war? That's crazy!

speaker: Long Feng
text: Completely!

speaker: Aang
text: Long Feng didn't want us to tell you, so he stole our sky bison to blackmail us. And blackmail is the least of his crimes; he brainwashed our friend!

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Quickly turns to face the king.] All lies. I've never even seen a sky bison, Your Majesty. Frankly, I thought they were extinct.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Sits down.] Your claim is difficult to believe. Even from an Avatar.

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Whispers in his ear.] These hooligans are part of an anarchist cell that my agents have been tracking for weeks. [Kuei looks shocked at what Long Feng is telling him.] If you listen to them, you're playing right into your own destruction.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Thinks for a moment.] I have to trust my advisor.
The agents start taking the team away, but Sokka stops for a moment.

speaker: Sokka
text: Wait! [Turns to face the king with a big smile.] I can prove he's lying. Long Feng said he's never seen a sky bison. Ask him to lift his robe.

speaker: Long Feng
text: What? I am not disrobing! [The king looks thoughtful before looking at Sokka suspiciously.]
Aang and Sokka smile slyly and nod at each other. Aang blows a large gust of air at Long Feng's legs, lifting his robe and revealing a bite mark left by Appa.

speaker: Aang
text: Right there! Appa bit him!

speaker: Sokka
text: Never met a sky bison, huh?

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Lowers his robe.] That happens to be a large birth mark. [Sarcastically.] Thanks for showing everyone.

speaker: Kuei
text: Well I suppose there's no way to prove where those marks came from.

speaker: Sokka
text: Of course there is!
The group gets Appa and brings him in. He opens his mouth. Aang points at the bison's teeth and at Long Feng's mark.

speaker: Kuei
text: Yup. That pretty much proves it. [Team Avatar cheers.] But it doesn't prove this crazy conspiracy theory. [Team Avatar becomes downcast.] Though, I suppose this matter's worth looking into. [Team Avatar look at each other approvingly, while Long Feng glares at the king before walking away with his agents.]
Back in Iroh and Zuko's apartment, Zuko is asleep. He wakes up.

speaker: Iroh
text: You're burning up. [Dips a cloth in water.] You have an intense fever. [Places the cloth on Zuko's forehead.] This will help cool you down.

speaker: Zuko
text: So thirsty. [Sits up, but Iroh makes him lie back down.]

speaker: Iroh
text: [Grabs a bucket with a spoon in it; takes out the spoon.] Here's some clean water to drink. [Sits him up slightly.] Stay under the blankets and sweat this out.

Zuko grabs the spoon from Iroh and drinks the water. He tosses the spoon aside and grabs the bucket. He drinks from it, while spilling some out. He tosses the bucket aside and lies back down. Iroh pulls the covers more over him. Meanwhile, on a train, passengers are shocked to see the Earth King, who is standing in the middle of the cart surrounded by guards.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Feeling strange from exposition.] So this is what a train is like? I didn't realize it would be this ... public.

speaker: Katara
text: So you've never been outside the Upper Ring before?

speaker: Kuei
text: I've never been outside the palace. [Katara and Sokka look at each other; the Earth King looks outside and sees Aang flying on Appa.] Now that's the way to travel. [Looks at Katara and Sokka.] So, may I ask where we're going?

speaker: Sokka
text: Underneath Lake Laogai, Your Kingliness. To the Dai Li's secret headquarters. You're about to see where all the brainwashing and conspiring took place.

Cut to the shores of Lake Laogai. The team stand on the shore beside the Earth King and his guards. Toph steps to the edge of the water, and with a hop, reveals the the secret path to the hatch door entrance, though discovers it has been destroyed.

speaker: Toph
text: It's gone!

speaker: Sokka
text: Oh don't tell me- ! [Gives a thumbs up and a fake smile.] That's okay. Still got my positive attitude.

speaker: Katara
text: The Dai Li must've known we were coming and destroyed the evidence!

speaker: Kuei
text: [Looks suspicious.] Hm ... [Sarcastically.] That seems awfully convenient.

speaker: Sokka
text: Hey, if anything, this proves the conspiracy exists even more. [Smiles and nods.]

speaker: Kuei
text: Long Feng was right. This was a waste of time. [Turns to leave.] If you'll excuse me, I'm going back to the palace.

speaker: Katara
text: [Smiles with realization.] The wall. They'll never be able to cover that up in time.

speaker: Aang
text: Oh, yeah. [Hops to in front of the king.] If you come with us to the Outer Wall, we can prove to you that the secret war is real.

speaker: Kuei
text: No Earth King has ever been to the Outer Wall. [Walks past Aang.] I don't have any more time for this nonsense. [Aang looks depressed.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Runs up to them.] If you come with us, this time you can ride on Appa. [The Earth King stops as Appa lows in the background. A pleased smile grows on his face.]
En route to the Outer Wall. The Earth King is riding on Appa, holding on for dear life and screaming at the top of his lungs in fear, his clothes flapping in the wind.

speaker: Toph
text: First time flying?

speaker: Kuei
text: It's both thrilling and terrifying!

speaker: Toph
text: Yeah. [Smiles.] I hate it, too.

speaker: Kuei
text: I have to be honest with you: part of me really hopes that what you're telling me about this war isn't true.

speaker: Aang
text: I wish it wasn't.

Meanwhile at the apartment, Iroh again places the moist cloth over his feverish nephew's forehead. Zuko is having a dream that he is the Fire Lord, with no scar on his eye. One red and one blue dragon appear and start circling around the pillars on each side of him. The blue dragon starts circling around Zuko.

speaker: Blue dragon
text: [In Azula's voice.] It's getting late. Are you planning to retire soon, my lord?

speaker: Zuko
text: I'm not tired.

speaker: Blue dragon
text: [Into Zuko's ear.] Relax, Fire Lord Zuko. Just let go. Give in to it. Shut your eyes for a while.
Zuko slowly starts to shut his eyes but widely opens them upon hearing the other dragon.

speaker: Red dragon
text: [In Iroh's voice.] No, Fire Lord Zuko! Do not listen to the blue dragon. You should get out of here right now. Go! Before it's too late! [Both dragons are poised to either side of Zuko.]

speaker: Blue dragon
text: Sleep now, Fire Lord Zuko.

The dragons disappear, and the room they're in, as well as the guards watching Zuko, crumble to nothing. The blue dragon reappears in front of him. Two golden eyes appear, followed by the face of the blue dragon, which closes rapidly.

speaker: Blue dragon
text: Sleep. [Voice grows louder and more hostile as it continues talking.] Just like mother!
Charges at Zuko and opens its mouth. Inside the dragon's mouth, Zuko sees his mother, Ursa. Within that darkness, the camera draws closer to Ursa, who drops her hood.

speaker: Ursa
text: Zuko! Help me! [A distraught Zuko is seen in her eyes.]
Zuko disappears through the floor. The sleeping Zuko starts sweating. Meanwhile, Team Avatar arrives at the Outer Wall and sees the drill.

speaker: Aang
text: [Points at the drill.] It's still there!

speaker: Kuei
text: [Shocked.] What is that?

speaker: Sokka
text: It's a drill. A giant drill [Cut to the drill.] made by the Fire Nation to break through your walls. [Cut to a close-up of the king who looks horrified.]
On top of the wall, they're looking down at the drill.

speaker: Kuei
text: I can't believe I never knew. [He looks to his right as he hears something.]

speaker: Long Feng
text: [Appears on an earth elevator with two Dai Li agents.] I can explain this, Your Majesty. [Walks toward the king.] This is nothing more than ... a construction project. [Gestures his hand to the drill.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Sarcastically.] Really? Then perhaps you could explain why there's a [Points to the drill as Kuei follows to where she is pointing. Cut to the Fire Nation insignia clearly shown on the drill.] Fire Nation insignia on your "construction project".

speaker: Long Feng
text: [The king looks at him suspiciously.] Well it's imported of course. You know you can't trust domestic machinery. [Looks at them worried.] Surely you don't believe these children instead of your most loyal attendant?

speaker: Kuei
text: [Looks at Team Avatar, who stare back innocently, then at Long Feng, who is glaring back.] Dai Li! Arrest Long Feng! I want him to stand trial for crimes against the Earth Kingdom.
Long Feng and Team Avatar look shocked. The two agents behind Long Feng share glances, launch shackles onto his arms and pull him in.

speaker: Long Feng
text: You can't arrest me! You all need me more than you know! [He is taken away.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Happily.] Looks like Long Feng is long gone! Ha! Ah, yeah, I've been waiting to use that one. [Aang smiles at him and Katara gives him an unimpressed look.]
That night at the Palace, the Earth King is talking with Team Avatar.

speaker: Kuei
text: I want to thank you, young heroes, for opening my eyes. All this time, what I thought was a great metropolis was merely a city of fools. And that makes me the king fool. [Buries his face in one of his hands.] We're at war. With the Fire Nation.

speaker: Sokka
text: That's why we came to Ba Sing Se, Your Highness: because we think you can help us end the war.

speaker: Aang
text: [Momo climbs up Kuei's arm.] We don't have much time. There's a comet coming this summer. Its energy will give the firebenders unbelievable strength. They'll be unstoppable.

speaker: Sokka
text: But there is hope. Before the comet comes, we have a window of opportunity: A solar eclipse is coming. The sun will be completely blocked out by the moon, and the firebenders will be helpless.

speaker: Kuei
text: What are you suggesting, Sokka?

speaker: Sokka
text: That's the day we need to invade the Fire Nation. [Cut to a close-up of the king. Cut back to Sokka.] The Day of Black Sun.

speaker: Kuei
text: I don't know. That would require moving troops out of Ba Sing Se. We'd be completely vulnerable.

speaker: Sokka
text: You're already vulnerable. The Fire Nation won't stop until Ba Sing Se falls. You can either sit back and wait for that to happen, or take the offensive and give yourself a fighting chance.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Thinks for a moment as everyone waits anxiously.] Very well. You have my support.
Team Avatar celebrates. Someone else arrives.

speaker: General How
text: Your Majesty. [Walks up to Team Avatar and bows to the king.] I apologize for the interruption.

speaker: Kuei
text: [To Team Avatar.] This is General How. He's the leader of the Council of Five, my highest ranking generals.

speaker: General How
text: We searched Long Feng's office. I think we found something that will interest everybody. [Team Avatar look at each other.]
In Long Feng's office, a soldier is carrying a box of papers to the desk.

speaker: General How
text: There are secret files on everyone in Ba Sing Se. Including you kids.

speaker: Aang
text: Secret files?

speaker: Kuei
text: [Takes out a scroll and reads the side.] "Toph Beifong." [Hands the scroll to General How, who hands it to Toph, who hands it to Katara.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Opens the scroll and reads it.] It's a letter from your mom. Your mom's here in the city. And she wants to see you. [Toph's eyes widen with shock.]

speaker: Toph
text: Long Feng intercepted our letters from home? [Shakes her head.] That's just sad.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Takes out another scroll and hands it to Aang.] Aang?

speaker: General How
text: This scroll was attached to the horn of your bison when the Dai Li captured it.

speaker: Aang
text: [Opens the scroll and reads it.] It's from the Eastern Air Temple.

speaker: Katara
text: Is there a letter for me and Sokka by any chance?

speaker: Kuei
text: [Looks in the box.] I'm afraid not.

speaker: Sokka
text: [He and Katara become downcast.] Oh.

speaker: General How
text: But there is an intelligence report that might interest you. [Hands a scroll to Katara.]

speaker: Katara
text: [Opens the scroll and reads it.] "A small fleet of Water Tribe ships."

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shocked. Appears on Katara's side.] What? That could be Dad!

speaker: Katara
text: [Reads the report with excitement.] "Protecting the mouth of Chameleon Bay. [Her and Sokka's eyes widen.] Led by Hakoda." [Katara and Sokka turn to each other in excitement.] It is Dad!
Meanwhile at the apartment, Iroh is pouring tea.

speaker: Iroh
text: You should know that this is not a natural sickness, but that shouldn't stop you from enjoying tea. [Feeds Zuko the tea.]

speaker: Zuko
text: What's happening?

speaker: Iroh
text: Your critical decision. What you did beneath that lake. It was in such conflict with your image of yourself that you are now at war within your own mind and body. [Feeds Zuko more tea.]

speaker: Zuko
text: What's that mean? [Coughs continuously and lies down.]

speaker: Iroh
text: You are going through a metamorphosis, my nephew. It will not be a pleasant experience, but when you come out of it, [Takes a cloth and wipes Zuko's head.] you will be the beautiful prince you were always meant to be.
Back in Long Feng's office.

speaker: Aang
text: I can't believe it. There's a man living at the Eastern Air Temple. He says he's a guru.

speaker: Sokka
text: What's a guru? Some kind of poisonous blow fish?

speaker: Aang
text: No, a spiritual expert. He wants to help me take the next step in the Avatar journey. He says he can teach me to control the Avatar State.

speaker: Katara
text: And I can't believe we know where our dad is now.

speaker: Toph
text: I know what you mean. My mom's in the city. And from her letter it sounds like she finally understands me.

speaker: Sokka
text: This is all such big news! Where do we even start?

speaker: Katara
text: I hate to say it, but we have to split up.

speaker: Aang
text: [Worriedly.] Split up? We just found Appa and got the family back together! Now you want us to separate?

speaker: Katara
text: You have to meet this guru, Aang. If we're going to invade the Fire Nation, you need to be ready.

speaker: Aang
text: Well, if I'm going to the Eastern Air Temple, Appa and I can drop you off at Chameleon Bay to see your dad.

speaker: Sokka
text: Someone has to stay here with the Earth King and help him plan for the invasion. [Stands up.] I guess that's me.

speaker: Katara
text: No, Sokka. I know how badly you wanna help Dad. You go to Chameleon Bay. I'll stay here with the king.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Overjoyed with tears welling in his eyes. Stands up and dances happily.] You are the nicest ... sister ... ever! [Throws his arms around Katara and kisses her on the cheek.]

speaker: Katara
text: Easy there, big brother ... [Gives a slight chuckle.] Though you're right. I am.
Outside the Palace, Team Avatar is preparing to leave. The king walks down to them. Katara is petting Appa. Aang turns to face her.

speaker: Aang
text: Katara? I need to tell you something. [Starts blushing.] I've been wanting to say it for a long time.

speaker: Katara
text: What is it, Aang?

speaker: Aang
text: [Rubs the back of his head.] Katara, I- [He is cut off by Sokka.]

speaker: Sokka
text: [Throws Aang in a headlock.] All right. Who's ready to get going on our little men-only man trip? [Noogies Aang. Katara looks at him, annoyed.]

speaker: Kuei
text: Aang and Sokka, [They look at him.] I wish you a good journey. Ba Sing Se owes you its thanks. We look forward to your safe return. [Aang, Katara, and Sokka bow.]
Sokka starts climbing atop Appa. A soldier walks up to the king.

speaker: Soldier
text: Your Majesty. There are three female warriors to see you. They're from the island of Kyoshi.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Shocked.] That's Suki! [Falls off Appa.]

speaker: Kuei
text: You know these warriors?

speaker: Sokka
text: [Gets up.] Oh yeah. The Kyoshi Warriors are a skilled group of fighters. Trustworthy too. They're good friends of ours.

speaker: Kuei
text: Then we shall welcome them as honored guests.

speaker: Katara
text: [Aang turns to Appa.] Wait. Aang. [She hugs him, which startles him, then kisses him on the cheek, causing him to blush.]

speaker: Toph
text: I'm really gonna miss you guys.

speaker: Katara
text: [Hugs Toph with Aang. Sokka looks away, crossing his arms.] Me too.

speaker: Aang
text: Yeah.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Everyone goes to hug him.] Aahh! Great. That's enough. [Smiles.] Okay, we love each other. [Pats Aang and Katara on the head.] Seriously.

Appa flies off. Back at the apartment, Iroh and Zuko are asleep. Zuko wakes up and walks into the bathroom. He washes his face with water. When he looks in the mirror, he sees himself with no scar, no hair and an arrow tattoo on his head, resembling Aang. He looks horrified. He screams himself awake and breathes heavily. He touches the scar on his face and closes his eyes. Meanwhile, Appa is flying Sokka and Aang. Sokka is resting across Appa's back.

speaker: Sokka
text: You see, Aang? A little positive thinking works wonders. We got the king on our side, we got Long Feng arrested, and when we get back, Suki's waiting for me.

speaker: Aang
text: [Dreamily.] Yeah. Girls are waiting for us. Thanks, positive attitude.

speaker: Sokka
text: Everything is gonna work out perfectly. From now on and forever. [Aang turns around and smiles at him.]
In a prison, Long Feng is sitting in his cell. A Dai Li agent appears outside of the cell.

speaker: Agent
text: [Slides a tray of food underneath the door.] Dinner. [Long Feng grabs some food.] The Council of Five and the military are loyal to the Earth King, [Long Feng looks at him.] but the Dai Li remains loyal to you, Long Feng, sir. [Walks away as Long Feng eats his food while smiling sinisterly.]
Meanwhile, at a random house, Toph is outside. She exhales deeply and knocks on the door. It opens on its own.

speaker: Toph
text: [Enters.] Hello? Mom? Anyone home? [Walks to the center of the room. She senses something, but is quickly captured in a metal box. In a scared voice.] Hey! Who do you think you're dealing with!?
Xin Fu and Master Yu appear.

speaker: Xin Fu
text: One loud-mouthed little brat who strayed too far from home.
Back at the palace, three Kyoshi Warriors are walking up to the king and bow.

speaker: Kuei
text: In our hour of need, it is with the highest honor that I welcome our esteemed allies, the Kyoshi Warriors!
The warriors look up.

speaker: Azula
text: We are the Earth King's humble servants.
The middle warrior is shown to have gold eyes, showing that it is really Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee disguised as Kyoshi Warriors, whom they have previously defeated.
Fade to credits.
The episode starts with a view of the exterior of Zuko and Iroh's apartment. Cut to the interior. Iroh is preparing food when Zuko awakens.

speaker: Zuko
text: What's that smell?

speaker: Iroh
text: It's jook. I'm sure you wouldn't like it.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Sniffs.] Actually, it smells delicious. I'd love a bowl, Uncle. [Holds a bowl up.]

speaker: Iroh
text: Now that your fever is gone, you seem different somehow.

speaker: Zuko
text: [Optimistically.] It's a new day. We've got a new apartment, new furniture, and today's the grand opening of your new tea shop. [Moves to a table and sits.] Things are looking up, Uncle. [Starts drinking the jook. Iroh's shocked expression changes to a smile.]
Aang and Sokka fly on Appa to a Water Tribe camp, where Hakoda is.

speaker: Aang
text: You haven't seen your dad in over two years. You must be so excited!

speaker: Sokka
text: [Almost throwing up.] I know I should be, but, I just feel sick to my stomach. [Holds his stomach.]

speaker: Aang
text: Don't be nervous. He's going to be so happy to see you! [He puts his hand on Sokka's shoulder who smiles.]

speaker: Sokka
text: So what about you? Are you nervous to meet this guru?

speaker: Aang
text: Not at all. I'm ready to master the Avatar State. I'll do whatever it takes. [Sokka gets off Appa.] See you in a week. Yip yip!
Aang and Appa fly away. Sokka arrives at the camp, where all the warriors greet him warmly.

speaker: Water Tribe warrior
text: Sokka, good to see you.

He looks and sees the main tent. Inside, Hakoda, Sokka's father, is looking at a map with more warriors, including Bato, now with scars on his arm. Bato nudges Hakoda and Hakoda becomes happy upon seeing Sokka.

speaker: Hakoda
text: Sokka.

speaker: Sokka
text: Hi, Dad.
The two embrace. Back at the Earth King's Royal Palace, the "Kyoshi Warriors", Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee in disguise, sit before King Kuei.

speaker: Kuei
text: Look Bosco! The Kyoshi Warriors are here to protect us! Aren't you excited? [Bosco yawns.] It's been a difficult week for me. My most trusted advisor, Long Feng, and his Dai Li agents tried to take control of Ba Sing Se from me.

speaker: Azula
text: It's terrible when you can't trust the people who are closest to you.

speaker: Kuei
text: [Pets Bosco.] But there is good news. As we speak, the Council of Five is meeting to plan an invasion of the Fire Nation this summer, on the day of a solar eclipse.
For a second, Azula's eyes slightly widen with shock and worry upon hearing this, but she quickly hides it.

speaker: Azula
text: Really? Now that sounds like a fascinating and brilliant plan. [Glances off as Mai and Ty Lee look at each other.]
Cut to the Council of Five meeting, where Katara and Momo are present.

speaker: General How
text: General Fong's base will serve as the launching point for the attack. In exactly two months, the army and navy will invade the Fire Nation on the Day of Black Sun.
Momo jumps on the map and begins knocking over the pieces.

speaker: Katara
text: Or we could send in Momo to do some damage! [Chuckles. The Council of Five are unamused.] 'Cause, the ... sorry.

speaker: General How
text: [Uses earthbending to stand the pieces back up, scaring Momo.] All we need is the Earth King's seal in order to execute the plan. [Sends the scroll across the table to Katara.]

speaker: Katara
text: I'll get these scrolls to him right away. Thank you, General How.
Aang continues his journey to the Eastern Air Temple. He spots Guru Pathik, who is meditating, and lands Appa.

speaker: Aang
text: Uhhh ... hello? You're Guru Pathik, right? [Aang approaches Pathik.] The person who attached the note to Appa's horn?

speaker: Pathik
text: Indeed. I was a spiritual brother of your people and a personal friend of Monk Gyatso. [Aang looks slightly surprised to hear this.]

speaker: Aang
text: In your note, [Aang sits.] you said you could teach me how to gain control of the Avatar State. How?

speaker: Pathik
text: You must gain balance within yourself, before you can bring balance to the world. And the first step to gaining balance begins with this. [Hands Aang a yellow beverage in a wooden cup.] Drink up!

speaker: Aang
text: [Takes it and looks at it. Drinks it and quickly spits it out to his left in disgust.] Uggh! It tastes like onion and banana juice!

speaker: Pathik
text: That's because it is! [Pathik empties another bowl and holds it over his head.] Yum yum!
Aang blinks in disbelief. Meanwhile, Xin Fu and Master Yu are working to bring Toph back to the Beifong Estate.

speaker: Yu
text: I believe we need to go right!

speaker: Xin Fu
text: What are you talking about? The Beifong Estate's this way!

speaker: Yu
text: I'm quite certain you're mistaken.

speaker: Toph
text: [Banging at the cell.] Hey! Can you two old ladies quit your bickering for a second? [Cut to inside the cell.] I got to go to the bathroom!

speaker: Yu
text: Oooh ... uhhh, okay, but make it quick! [Getting up with a key in hand.]

speaker: Xin Fu
text: [Stopping Yu.] What's wrong with you?

speaker: Yu
text: Ooh, very sneaky Toph! Nice try, but you can't trick me! [Sits down.]

speaker: Toph
text: Let me out of here so I can kick both your butts!

speaker: Xin Fu
text: Quit your banging! [Bangs the metal box.] You might think you're the greatest earthbender in the world, but even you can't bend metal!

Toph looks sad as she places her hand on a side of the metal box. The scene cuts to that night, and where Azula, Mai and Ty Lee are staying which is a small building in the Upper Ring. Mai and Ty Lee are removing their make-up. A smiling Ty Lee is looking in a mirror. She is wiping the last traces of her Kyoshi makeup from her face. Mai is seated next to Ty Lee, still working on her own face.

speaker: Azula
text: We have been presented with an extraordinary opportunity, girls.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: Mai finally gets to wear make-up that's not totally depressing? [Azula walks past toward a window.]

speaker: Mai
text: [With large, dark splotches of black makeup dripping down her eyes; Sarcastically.] Ha, ha.

speaker: Azula
text: I'm talking about conquering the whole Earth Kingdom. [The two girls turn with shocked looks.] For one hundred years, the Fire Nation has hammered away at Ba Sing Se from the outside. [Walks away from the girls and smirks while looking out of a window.] But now we're on the inside, and we can take it by ourselves.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: [Admiringly.] Gosh, you're so confident. I really admire that about you.

speaker: Azula
text: From the inside, we're in perfect position to organize a coup and overthrow the Earth King. The key is the Dai Li. Whoever controls the Dai Li [Turns back into the room.] controls Ba Sing Se.
Back to the Eastern Air Temple at a creek.

speaker: Pathik
text: In order to master the Avatar State, you must open all the chakras. Aang, tell me everything you know about chakras.

speaker: Aang
text: [Rubs eyes.] What are chakras?

speaker: Pathik
text: [Disappointedly.] Oh, I see. I guess we'll start with the basics. [As he explains he points to the water and the moss within.] The water flows through this creek, much like the energy flows through your body. As you see, there are several pools where the water swirls around before flowing on. These pools are like our chakras.

speaker: Aang
text: So chakras are pools of spiraling energy in our bodies?

speaker: Pathik
text: Exactly. If nothing else were around, this creek would flow pure and clear. However, life is messy, and things tend to fall in the creek. And then what happens?

speaker: Aang
text: The creek can't flow?

speaker: Pathik
text: Yes. But, if we open the ponds between the pools ... [He removes moss blocking the exit for the water.]

speaker: Aang
text: The energy flows! [The water that was blocked by the moss becomes clear. Aang and Pathik smile at each other.]
In another part of the temple, a cavern.

speaker: Pathik
text: There are seven chakras that go up the body. Each pool of energy has a purpose, and can be blocked by a specific kind of emotional muck. Be warned, opening the chakras is an intense experience, and once you begin the process, you cannot stop until all seven are open. Are you ready?

speaker: Aang
text: [Momentarily looks down.] I'll do whatever it takes.

speaker: Pathik
text: First we will open the Earth Chakra, located at the base of the spine. It deals with survival, and is blocked by fear. What are you most afraid of? Let your fears become clear to you.

Aang sees images of things that cause him great fear, including the Blue Spirit attacking him, General Fong sinking Katara into the ground, himself merging with La at the North Pole, Fire Lord Ozai, and Sozin's Comet, which make him scream.

speaker: Pathik
text: Aang, your vision is not real. You are concerned for your survival, but you must surrender those fears. Let your fears flow down the creek. [Aang clears the image away.] You have opened your Earth Chakra! [Aang wipes sweat off his forehead.]
Later, behind a waterfall.

speaker: Pathik
text: Next is the ...

speaker: Aang
text: Water Chakra?

speaker: Pathik
text: Brilliant! Maybe one day you will be a guru too! This chakra deals with pleasure and is blocked by guilt. Now, look at all the guilt which burdens you so. What do you blame yourself for?

speaker: Aang
text: [Sees the image of him leaving home.] I ran away. [Sees images of him in the Avatar State at General Fong's base.] I hurt all of those people.

speaker: Pathik
text: Accept the reality that these things happened, but do not let them cloud and poison your energy. If you are to be a positive influence on the world, you need to forgive yourself. [Aang takes a deep, focused breath, opening his Water Chakra.]
Scene cuts to the next day at the Water Tribe camp.

speaker: Hakoda
text: This bay leads directly to the outskirts of Ba Sing Se. We've been using these tangle mines to stop the Fire Nation ships from getting through.

speaker: Bato
text: [Filling the mine with skunk fish and seaweed before moving away.] Your father invented tangle mines himself.

speaker: Sokka
text: Destructive? Buoyant? And ... [Sniffs and immediately becomes disgusted.] Aggh, ehhh! Terrible smelling!

speaker: Hakoda
text: Very perceptive. The mines are filled with skunk fish and seaweed. When a ship detonates the mine, the seaweed tangles up the propeller and the foul smell forces people to abandon the ship. I call it the "stink and sink."

speaker: Sokka
text: [Laughs.] Good one, Dad!

speaker: Bato
text: [Nearby, unamused.] You're definitely your father's son.

speaker: Warrior
text: [Approaching.] Hakoda, our scouts have spotted four Fire Nation ships!

speaker: Hakoda
text: Bato, get these mines loaded up! The rest of you men, prepare for battle!
The warriors run off to prepare as Sokka looks around before looking back to his father.

speaker: Sokka
text: Uhhh ... what should I do, Dad?

speaker: Hakoda
text: Aren't you listening? I said, "The rest of you men, get ready for battle".
Sokka smiles, nods, and departs. Hakoda smiles proudly. Back in Ba Sing Se, at the Jasmine Dragon. Zuko and Iroh observe the happenings standing at the back.

speaker: Iroh
text: Who thought when we came to this city as refugees, that I'd end up owning my own tea shop? Follow your passion, Zuko, and life will reward you.

speaker: Zuko
text: Congratulations, Uncle.

speaker: Iroh
text: I am very thankful.

speaker: Zuko
text: You deserve it. The Jasmine Dragon will be the best tea shop in the city.

speaker: Iroh
text: No. I'm thankful because you decided to share this special day with me. It means more than you know. [The two embrace.]

speaker: Zuko
text: Now let's make these people some tea! [Walks away to the back.]

speaker: Iroh
text: [Overjoyed.] Yes, let's make some tea!
Back to the Eastern Air Temple, Aang and Pathik sit on a ledge.

speaker: Pathik
text: Third is the Fire Chakra, located in the stomach.

speaker: Aang
text: [Holding his stomach.] My Fire Chakra would like to eat something other than onion-banana juice.

speaker: Pathik
text: [Chuckles.] Good one! Moving on. This chakra deals with willpower, and is blocked by shame. What are you ashamed of? [Cuts to Aang's vision of his first attempt at firebending, which resulted in him accidentally burning Katara's hands.] What are your biggest disappointments in yourself?

speaker: Aang
text: I'm never going to firebend again. I can't.

speaker: Pathik
text: You will never find balance if you deny this part of your life. You are the Avatar and therefore, you are a firebender. [Aang breathes deeply.] Hmmm ... that chakra opened less like a flowing creek, and more like a ... burping bison.

speaker: Aang
text: [Loud belch.] Tastes like onions and bananas, but strangely something else. Pickles? [Pathik shrugs, and hums as if to say "I don't know".]

Back at the palace, two Dai Li agents hide on two pillars and secretly spy on a conversation between Mai and Ty Lee. The former is sitting on the stairs and the latter is practicing chi-blocking and acrobatics.

speaker: Mai
text: [Sighs.] I'm tired of wearing this girly disguise. I don't know how anyone could fight in this.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: Maybe that's why it was so easy to beat the Kyoshi Warriors and take their clothes. [Punches the air, imitating her chi-blocking.]

speaker: Mai
text: How much longer do we have to serve the Earth King? If I have to clean up one more pile of bear poop, I'm going to throw up.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: [Walks on her hands.] Princess Azula promised we would go back to the Fire Nation as soon as we captured the Avatar. We just have to be patient.

speaker: Mai
text: [Stands up.] Shush up! Do you want the whole palace to know we're Fire Nation?

speaker: Ty Lee
text: Sorry!
The agents smile and climb away. Azula, who was hiding behind another pillar, walks up to them.

speaker: Azula
text: Good work, girls. I'm sure the Dai Li will deliver the message.
Back at the Air Temple.

speaker: Pathik
text: The fourth chakra is located in the heart. It deals with love and is blocked by grief. [Aang smiles and looks at a Air Nomad statue nearby before looking sad.] Lay all your grief out in front of you.
Aang sees images of many airbenders, including Gyatso and Yangchen. He smiles upon seeing them, but becomes saddened as they start to vanish into smoke.

speaker: Pathik
text: You have indeed felt a great loss. [The airbenders appear floating in the clouds.] But love is a form of energy, and it swirls all around us. [Aang is lifted into the air and sees the Air Nomads floating in the smoke.] The Air Nomads' love for you has not left this world. It is still inside of your heart, and is reborn in the form of new love.
The smoke in front of Aang forms a face and shows the first thing he saw upon waking up from his iceberg: Katara. Back in the real world, Aang is starting to cry tears of joy.

speaker: Pathik
text: Let the pain flow away. [Aang wipes away his tears.] Very good.

speaker: Aang
text: [Choking up.] Can I have some onion-banana juice, please?
Inside another part of the temple.

speaker: Pathik
text: The fifth in the chain is the Sound Chakra, located in the throat. It deals with truth and is blocked by lies. The ones we tell ourselves.
Aang flashes back to when he, Katara, and Sokka first began their journey to the North Pole.

speaker: Katara (flashback)
text: Why didn't you tell us you were the Avatar?
Back to the real world, Aang finds himself answering the question.

speaker: Aang
text: Because I never wanted to be.

speaker: Pathik
text: You cannot lie about your own nature. You must accept that you are the Avatar. [Aang inhales and, seeing an image of himself on a cliff looking down at the ground, exhales, and accepts his nature.] Very good, Aang. You have opened the chakra of truth.
Outside the temple interior.

speaker: Pathik
text: The sixth pool of energy is the light chakra, located in the center of the forehead. It deals with insight and is blocked by illusion. The greatest illusion of this world is the illusion of separation. Things you think are separate and different are actually one and the same.

speaker: Aang
text: [An image is shown of the world, with the four nations' territories marked.] Like the four nations.

speaker: Pathik
text: [The image changes so the territories become the same color.] Yes. We are all one people, [The territories become separate again.] but we live as if divided.

speaker: Aang
text: We're all connected. Everything is connected.

speaker: Pathik
text: That's right! Even the separation of the four elements is an illusion. If you open your mind, you will see that all the elements are one. Four parts of the same whole. Even metal is just a part of earth that has been purified and refined.

As Pathik speaks, the camera fades to Xin Fu and Yu trying to take Toph home. She feels around the metal cage with seismic sense and feels tiny particles of earth in the metal. She smiles, exhales deeply and begins to push against the metal.

speaker: Toph
text: [Struggling.] Come on, metal. Budge! [She punches a hole in the metal and shakes her hand in pain.] Wooo! Toph, you rule.
She takes another punch as we cut back to Ba Sing Se. Katara walks by the Jasmine Dragon.

speaker: Katara
text: What do you say, Momo? A cup of tea before we get back to the king? [Arrives at the shop.] Table for two, please.

speaker: Zuko
text: Uncle! I need two jasmine, one green, and one lychee!

speaker: Iroh
text: I'm brewing as fast as I can!
Katara notices Zuko and Iroh. Stunned, she runs away from the shop.
The scene returns to Aang and Pathik, who sit at the top of the temple at night.

speaker: Aang
text: This is the last chakra, isn't it?

speaker: Pathik
text: Yes. Once you open this chakra, you will be able to go in and out of the Avatar State at will and when you are in the Avatar State, you will have complete control and awareness of all your actions.

speaker: Aang
text: [Smiles with determination.] Let's do this.

speaker: Pathik
text: The Thought Chakra is located at the crown of the head. It deals with pure cosmic energy, and is blocked by earthly attachment. Meditate on what attaches you to this world. [Images of Katara appear before Aang.] Now, let all of those attachments go. Let them flow down the river, forgotten.

speaker: Aang
text: [Coming out of his meditation.] What? Why would I let go of Katara? I ... I love her!

speaker: Pathik
text: Learn to let her go, or you cannot let the pure cosmic energy flow in from the universe.

speaker: Aang
text: Why would I choose cosmic energy over Katara? [Aang throws his hands up.] How could it be a bad thing that I feel an attachment to her? Three chakras ago that was a good thing!

speaker: Pathik
text: You must learn to let go. [Aang contemplates worriedly.]
Back at the palace, Katara runs to inform the Earth King, only to encounter the "Kyoshi Warriors".

speaker: Katara
text: Thank goodness you're here, Suki. Something terrible is going on. The Fire Nation has infiltrated the city, I just saw Prince Zuko and his uncle! [Azula widens her eyes in surprise and smiles slyly.] We have to tell the Earth King right away!

speaker: Azula
text: Oh, don't worry, I'll be sure to let him know.

Katara notices "Suki" has gold eyes and is shocked upon realization that the "Kyoshi Warriors" are actually Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee. She prepares to attack, but Ty Lee quickly jumps forward and blocks her chi.

speaker: Azula
text: [While the three girls gather around the fallen Katara; pans to camera looking up to the three girls.] So, Zuzu's in the city, too? I think it's time for a family reunion. [Momo flies off.]
Back at the temple.

speaker: Aang
text: I'm sorry, but I can't let go of Katara.

speaker: Pathik
text: Aang, to master the Avatar State, you must open all the chakras. Surrender yourself.

speaker: Aang
text: Okay, I'll try.

speaker: Pathik
text: Now think of your attachments and let them go. Let the pure cosmic energy flow.

Aang sees an image of him letting Katara go, and a bridge that will lead him to Avatar State mastery. His image looks down, smiles at the bridge, and walks up to the Avatar Spirit, which is an enlarged image of himself in the Avatar State. The Avatar Spirit is holding a ball of energy, and Aang walks directly inside of it. As he does so, his tatooes glow, and he closes his eyes. Right before he is able to completely open the final chakra and master the Avatar State, however, he hears a shriek from Katara and sees a vision of her in chains. At this, he jumps out of the energy sphere and runs away from the Avatar Spirit. The energy bridge that lead him there slowly vanishes behind him until it catches up and falls from underneath him, causing his image to plummet toward Earth. This cuts his connection to the Avatar State, which forces him back to reality.

speaker: Aang
text: Katara's in danger! I have to go! [Prepares to exit.]

speaker: Pathik
text: No, Aang! By choosing attachment, you have locked the chakra! If you leave now, you won't be able to go into the Avatar State at all!

Aang hesitates but leaves anyway, leaving Pathik concerned and disappointed. Meanwhile, the journey to take Toph back to her home is stopped when Xin Fu and Yu hear a loud noise. They go to investigate, and notice a hole in the cage and that Toph is gone.

speaker: Yu
text: It's another one of her tricks!

speaker: Xin Fu
text: There's a giant hole in the box! How is that a trick!?

speaker: Toph
text: [From behind them.] It's not! It's the real deal!
She earthbends the two men together, throws them in the cage, and metalbends the cage shut.

speaker: Toph
text: [Jumps on top of the box.] I am the greatest earthbender in the world! Don't you two dunderheads ever forget it! [Stomps on the box and exits using earth surfing.]

speaker: Xin Fu
text: [Inside the box.] I'm going to be stuck in here forever with you, aren't I?

speaker: Yu
text: I have to go the bathroom. [Xin Fu groans and slams his head against the box.]
Back at the Water Tribe camp, Hakoda approaches Sokka.

speaker: Hakoda
text: Ready to go knock some Fire Nation heads?

speaker: Sokka
text: You don't know how much this means to me, Dad. I'll make you proud and I'll finally prove to you what a great warrior I am.

speaker: Hakoda
text: [Placing his hand on Sokka's shoulder.] Sokka, you don't have to prove anything to me. I'm already proud of you and I've always known you're a great warrior.

speaker: Sokka
text: Really?

speaker: Hakoda
text: Why do you think I trusted you to look after our tribe when I left?
Just as the two are boarding the ship, Aang and Appa appear. Aang shows a clear look of concern.

speaker: Sokka
text: This can't be good news.

Aang and Sokka depart. Just as they're leaving, Sokka looks back at Hakoda, who looks back and grins. Back in Ba Sing Se, Azula is led into a prison by two Dai Li agents. She is taken to Long Feng's cell.

speaker: Azula
text: What is this about? Your agents show up in the middle of the night and drag me down here? You will not treat a Kyoshi Warrior this way!

speaker: Long Feng
text: But you're not a Kyoshi Warrior, are you, [Standing.] Princess Azula of the Fire Nation?

speaker: Azula
text: What do you want?

speaker: Long Feng
text: I want to make a deal. It's time that I regain control of Ba Sing Se and you have something I need.

speaker: Azula
text: Oh?

speaker: Long Feng
text: The Earth King's trust.

speaker: Azula
text: Why should I help you?

speaker: Long Feng
text: Because I can get you the Avatar.

speaker: Azula
text: [Smirks.] I'm listening ...
Long Feng smiles. Back at the Jasmine Dragon, a royal messenger enters.

speaker: Royal messenger
text: A message from the Royal Palace.

speaker: Iroh
text: [Reads through, becomes shocked, and smiles.] I ... I can't believe it!

speaker: Zuko
text: What is it, Uncle?

speaker: Iroh
text: [Excited.] Great news! We've been invited to serve tea to the Earth King! [Runs off.]
Zuko smiles as he continues sweeping. Back in the prison hold, the door to Long Feng's cell is closed. Azula leaves Long Feng's presence and gives a smirk. Fade to credits.
Ostrich horses are drinking water from a river as Appa, Aang, and Sokka fly over them.

speaker: Sokka
text: So, what kind of trouble is Katara in?

speaker: Aang
text: I don't know. In my vision, I just knew she needed help.

speaker: Sokka
text: It would be nice if your Avatar powers could be just a little more specific from time to time. [He looks down and notices a mound of earth passing nearby, heading to the wall.] What is that?
They fly down and follow the mound. Toph is seen still earth surfing. Aang and Sokka come down beside her.

speaker: Sokka
text: Need a ride?
Toph becomes startled at the sound of Sokka's voice and falls backward off of the mound. Sokka and Aang cringe upon seeing her fall. Scene changes to Azula speaking to the Dai Li.

speaker: Azula
text: [While pacing back and forth.] The Earth King and the Council of Five do not trust the Dai Li. They imprisoned your leader, Long Feng. Soon they will turn on all of you and eliminate you. Seizing power today is a matter of life and death. [As she talks, an agent with a mustache starts looking nervous and slightly lowers his head.] This coup must be swift and decisive. The Earth King and each of the five generals must be taken out simultaneously. Long Feng has placed you in my command while we overthrow the government. [Walks over to her left, to another agent with a tiny, vertical scar on his right cheek. When she nears him, she stares sideways at the agent while still addressing all the agents.] If I sense any disloyalty, any hesitation, any weakness at all, [She stops right in front of the scarred agent.] I will snuff it out. [She continues walking, with the eyes of the now nervous scarred agent following her.] That is all.
The Dai Li leave, and Azula walks up to Ty Lee, who is pouring tea.

speaker: Ty Lee
text: Nice speech, Azula. It was pretty and poetic, but also scary in a good way. [She hands the cup to Azula. Camera pans over to a close-up of Mai.]

speaker: Mai
text: [Amused.] Yeah. I thought you were going to make that one guy pee his pants.

speaker: Azula
text: There are still a few loose ends. The Avatar, and my brother and uncle.
Scene fades to outside the Royal Palace, where Zuko and Iroh begin walking toward it.

speaker: Iroh
text: Many times I imagined myself here, at the threshold of the palace. [Camera pans to show the Earth Kingdom Emblem above the palace doors.] But I always thought I would be here as a conqueror. Instead, we are the Earth King's personal guests, here to serve him tea. Destiny is a funny thing.

speaker: Zuko
text: It sure is, Uncle.
Scene changes back to Appa, Toph, Aang, and Sokka still flying back to the Palace. Toph is seen holding onto Sokka's arm so she does not fall.

speaker: Toph
text: So how did it go with the guru? Did you master the Avatar State?

speaker: Aang
text: Uh ...
Aang looks down and thinks back to what Guru Pathik said before he left.

speaker: Pathik
text: If you leave now, you won't be able to go into the Avatar State at all!
Fades back to the present.

speaker: Sokka
text: Aang, are you okay?

speaker: Aang
text: I'm great! It went great with the guru. I completely mastered the Avatar State. [He laughs nervously and looks down.] Yeah.
Scene changes back to the Royal Palace, where Zuko and Iroh are sitting at a table in a room, waiting for the Earth King. Iroh pours some tea into a cup.

speaker: Zuko
text: What's taking so long?

speaker: Iroh
text: Maybe the Earth King overslept.
Dai Li agents begin to circle around the two.

speaker: Zuko
text: Something's not right.
Azula walks past the Dai Li and comes in front of her brother outside the circle of Dai Li agents.

speaker: Azula
text: It's tea time!

speaker: Zuko
text: [He quickly stands up.] Azula!

speaker: Azula
text: Have you met the Dai Li? They're earthbenders, but they have a killer instinct that's so firebender. I just love it.
Camera pans over to show Iroh picking up his cup of tea.

speaker: Iroh
text: Did I ever tell you how I got the nickname "The Dragon of the West"?

speaker: Azula
text: I'm not interested in a lengthy anecdote, Uncle. [She looks at her nails condescendingly.]

speaker: Iroh
text: It's more of a demonstration, really.

Iroh begins drinking his tea. Zuko looks over at him and smiles before going behind him. Iroh begins breathing fire. Cut to a corridor outside the room as a fire blast makes a hole in the wall, allowing Iroh and Zuko to escape. The Dai Li agents begin shooting some rock gloves at them, but miss as Zuko and Iroh turn around the corner. Iroh generates lightning and destroys the wall in front before jumping down, yelling, into a bush below. Zuko stops at the edge.

speaker: Iroh
text: Come on! You'll be fine!

speaker: Zuko
text: No! I'm tired of running! It's time I faced Azula!
Zuko turns around and walks back. Iroh smacks his head upon hearing this and runs away.

speaker: Azula
text: You're so dramatic. What? Are you going to challenge me to an Agni Kai?

speaker: Zuko
text: Yes! I challenge you!

speaker: Azula
text: No thanks.

Zuko shoots a fire blast toward her, but two Dai Li agents intervene and pull up a section of the floor, making a wall. They shoot some rock gloves at Zuko's feet, making him lose his balance. He puts his right hand down, but another rock glove traps that one. Azula turns around smiling and walks away as the agents capture him. Scene changes to inside the throne room, where Sokka, Toph, and Aang confront Kuei.

speaker: Kuei
text: Katara's fine. You have nothing to worry about.

speaker: Aang
text: But, in my vision, I felt so sure she was in trouble.

speaker: Kuei
text: Well, she met with the Council of Generals to plan the invasion, and since then, she been off with your friends, the Kyoshi Warriors.

speaker: Sokka
text: See, Aang? She's with Suki. They're probably back at our apartment right now talking about make-up or something.

speaker: Aang
text: Okay. Maybe you're right.

speaker: Kuei
text: Believe me, if there was any danger at all, Bosco's animal instincts would sense it.
Bosco lifts up his head from sleeping to look at the three. Scene changes to inside the Crystal Catacombs, where Katara is pacing back and forth. She stops pacing upon hearing a hole open up above.

speaker: Dai Li agent
text: You've got company.
He throws Zuko in, who rolls down and lands in front of Katara.

speaker: Katara
text: Zuko!

Katara's shocked face becomes an angry one as Zuko sits up, looking back at her with surprise, and the hole closes behind him. The scene changes to Toph, Aang, and Sokka reaching their house on Appa. The three jump off and run inside to see if Katara was in there. Momo runs up to them.

speaker: Aang
text: Momo!
Momo climbs up Aang onto his shoulders. Toph looks around.

speaker: Toph
text: There's no one else here.

speaker: Aang
text: Katara is in trouble! I knew it!

speaker: Sokka
text: Oh, no!

speaker: Toph
text: Wait! Someone's at the door. [Someone knocks on the door a second later.] Actually, I know who it is. It's an old friend of mine. [She walks over to the door and opens it, showing Iroh behind the door.] Glad to see you're okay.

speaker: Iroh
text: I need your help.
Sokka and Aang become shocked and angry upon seeing him, and get into a fighting stance. Toph calmly smiles and waves at him. Momo flies away upon seeing him.

speaker: Aang
text: You guys know each other?

speaker: Toph
text: I met him in the woods once and knocked him down. [Iroh smiles sheepishly and rubs the back of his head.] Then he gave me some tea and some very good advice.

speaker: Iroh
text: May I come in? [Toph nods, and he walks in before turning to the group.] Princess Azula is here in Ba Sing Se.

speaker: Aang
text: She must have Katara.

speaker: Iroh
text: She has captured my nephew as well.

speaker: Aang
text: Then we'll work together to fight Azula, and save Katara and Zuko.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Approaching Aang and pointing at him.] Whoa there! You lost me at "Zuko".

speaker: Iroh
text: I know how you must feel about my nephew. [Moving forward to place his hands on Sokka's shoulders.] But believe me when I tell you that there is good inside him.

speaker: Sokka
text: [Pushing Iroh away.] "Good inside him" isn't enough! Why don't you come back when it's outside him too, okay?

speaker: Aang
text: Katara's in trouble. All of Ba Sing Se is in trouble. Working together is our best chance.
Sokka understands, and nods. Iroh begins walking back to the door.

speaker: Iroh
text: I brought someone along who might help us.

They all walk outside. Toph puts a couple earth pillars around the nervous Dai Li agent and makes him stand up. Iroh walks over to him and takes the gag off his mouth, revealing this to be the scarred agent.

speaker: Captured agent
text: Azula and Long Feng are plotting a coup! They're going to overthrow the Earth King!

speaker: Sokka
text: My sister! Where are they keeping Katara?

speaker: Captured agent
text: In the Crystal Catacombs of Old Ba Sing Se, deep beneath the palace.

Iroh, Aang, Toph, and Sokka run away to help Katara and the Earth King, leaving the captured agent bound. Scene fades to the jail where Long Feng is. He meditates in his cell while a Dai Li agent informs him of what is going on.

speaker: Head of the Dai Li
text: The movements of the Earth King and all the generals have been plotted out step-by-step.

speaker: Long Feng
text: Good. And the Fire Nation princess is cooperating?

speaker: Head of the Dai Li
text: Oh, yes. More than cooperating. She's really taken charge. She's terrifying and inspirational at the same time. It's hard to explain.
The Dai Li agent walks away. Scene changes to inside the Crystal Catacombs, where Katara is yelling at Zuko, who sits with his back turned.

speaker: Katara
text: Why did they throw you in here? [Zuko says nothing.] Oh, wait, let me guess. It's a trap. So that when Aang shows up to help me, you can finally have him in your little Fire Nation clutches!
Zuko turns his head to look at her, turns back, and looks at the ground again.

speaker: Katara
text: [Continuing to lament.] You're a terrible person! You know that? Always following us! Hunting the Avatar! Trying to capture the world's last hope for peace! But what do you care? You're the Fire Lord's son. Spreading war and violence and hatred is in your blood!

speaker: Zuko
text: [Looks back at her.] You don't know what you're talking about!

speaker: Katara
text: [Enraged.] I don't? How dare you! You have no idea what this war has put me through! [Sits down.] Me personally! [She sits down and touches her necklace, begins to cry.] The Fire Nation took my mother away from me.

speaker: Zuko
text: [He turns around to face Katara.] I'm sorry. [Pauses. Katara is now sobbing.] That's something we have in common.
Katara looks back, surprised, and wipes away the tears from her eyes. The scene changes to Toph feeling the ground below, finding the Crystal Catacombs.

speaker: Toph
text: Well, what'd you know? There is an ancient city down there. But it's deep.
She makes a tunnel through the ground, beginning to lead to the catacombs. Sokka is seen thinking of a plan.

speaker: Sokka
text: We should split up. Aang, you go with Iroh to look for Katara and the angry jerk, [Remembers Iroh is there and places his left hand on Iroh's right shoulder.] no offense.

speaker: Iroh
text: [Shrugging.] None taken.

speaker: Sokka
text: And I'll go with Toph to warn the Earth King of Azula's coup.
Aang and Iroh are seen walking through the tunnel down to the Catacombs. Iroh is bending a small fire for light, and Aang is earthbending the way down.

speaker: Aang
text: So, Toph thinks you give pretty good advice, and great tea!

speaker: Iroh
text: The key to both is proper aging. What's on your mind?
Aang earthbends again before replying.

speaker: Aang
text: Well, I met with this guru who was supposed to help me master the Avatar State and control this great power, but to do it, I had to let go of someone I love. [He and Iroh stop.] And I just couldn't.

speaker: Iroh
text: Perfection and power are overrated. I think you were very wise to choose happiness and love.

speaker: Aang
text: [Earthbends again.] What happens if we can't save anyone and beat Azula? Without the Avatar State, what if I'm not powerful enough?

speaker: Iroh
text: I don't know the answer. Sometimes, life is like this dark tunnel. You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving, [Aang earthbends the rocks away one last time. Iroh's fire blows out. He smiles.] you will come to a better place.
